article_content: On the day of his wedding, 23-year-old Timothy Thompson from Valparaiso, Indiana, ended up behind bars instead of at the altar — all because he was rushing to get to his ceremony on time. According to police reports, Thompson was spotted driving at speeds of up to 100 mph around 6:30 p.m., weaving between lanes and nearly crashing his Jeep Grand Cherokee. As officers pursued him, they watched him enter the parking lot of Nativity of Our Savior Church, where he performed a spinning tire maneuver — commonly called a 'doughnut' — creating a cloud of smoke. Relatives nearby were frantically waving and shouting, but Thompson kept going. When he finally stopped, he told officers he was late for his own wedding. He also revealed he’d been released from jail earlier that day. Thompson claimed he had his hazard lights on and was honking to warn other drivers, saying he was driving about 90 mph. After being pulled over, he reportedly got back in his car and tried to drive off again, telling police he thought they were finished and he was now late for a party in Chicago. He was arrested on charges including reckless driving, criminal recklessness, resisting arrest, speeding, and improper passing. His wedding was canceled, and he remained jailed without bond.
translated_content: Pada hari pernikahannya, Timothy Thompson, 23 tahun, dari Valparaiso, Indiana, berakhir di balik jeruji besi alih-alih di altar — semua karena ia terburu-buru ingin sampai ke upacaranya tepat waktu. Menurut laporan polisi, Thompson terlihat mengemudi dengan kecepatan hingga 100 mph sekitar pukul 18.30, berpindah-pindah lajur dan nyaris menabrak mobil Jeep Grand Cherokee-nya. Saat petugas mengejarnya, mereka menyaksikan ia memasuki halaman Gereja Nativity of Our Savior, di mana ia melakukan manuver putaran roda — biasa disebut 'doughnut' — menciptakan awan asap. Kerabat di dekatnya berteriak dan melambaikan tangan, tetapi Thompson tetap melanjutkan. Ketika akhirnya berhenti, ia memberi tahu petugas bahwa ia terlambat untuk pernikahannya sendiri. Ia juga mengungkapkan baru saja keluar dari penjara pada hari itu. Thompson mengklaim lampu daruratnya menyala dan klakson dinyalakan untuk memperingatkan pengendara lain, mengatakan ia mengemudi sekitar 90 mph. Setelah dihentikan, ia dilaporkan kembali masuk ke mobil dan mencoba melarikan diri lagi, mengatakan kepada polisi bahwa ia mengira mereka sudah selesai dan sekarang ia terlambat untuk sebuah pesta di Chicago. Ia ditangkap atas tuduhan mengemudi sembarangan, kecerobohan kriminal, perlawanan terhadap petugas, pelanggaran kecepatan, dan pelewatansaluran yang tidak benar. Pernikahannya dibatalkan, dan ia tetap ditahan tanpa jaminan.

article_content: Rampoldi, a legendary Monaco restaurant founded in 1946, has opened its first U.S. outpost in New York City—directly across from Lincoln Center. Its arrival feels less like an expansion and more like a statement. Led by Chef Antonio Salvatore—a native of Basilicata and the visionary behind both the original Rampoldi in Monaco and his acclaimed La Table d’Antonio Salvatore Au Rampoldi—the New York branch is a true extension of its European counterpart. MC Hospitality Group, which also operates Casa Limone and The Atlantic Grill, oversees the venture, with Salvatore as a partner. The menu is nearly identical to Monaco’s: a refined 'modern Monegasque' blend of French and Italian influences, featuring premium imports like Salvatore’s private-label caviar and abundant black truffles. Dishes such as crab and avocado tartare ($42), octopus carpaccio ($24), and truffle-infused risotto ($47) showcase both technique and luxury. Interiors echo Monaco’s opulence: high ceilings, Rosso Imperiale marble floors, custom Fratelli Boffi furnishings, Murano glass chandeliers, and ambient lighting designed to illuminate every corner. Artist Domingo Zapata’s Mona Lisa triptych pays homage to Grace Kelly—an evocative, if slightly cryptic, nod. Wine selection rivals the city’s finest, and portions are generously proportioned. Yet not everything delivers: the Sole à la meunière ($79), while priced like Dover sole, arrived with a mealy texture, falling short of its premium label. Desserts shine: chocolate fondant with pear sorbet ($18), Tarte Tatin ($18), profiteroles ($19), and lemon meringue ($17) are classically executed and beautifully presented. Service, however, remains uneven. And while the restaurant aspires to attract A-list patrons, no celebrities were spotted during the visit—though perhaps they’re hiding in plain sight. Chef Salvatore flies in monthly, but his absence during this visit was palpable. For Rampoldi to truly thrive in New York, his presence must be more frequent—engaging with media, chefs, and diners to build authentic local credibility. With sharper service and a visible chef, this could become a defining destination—not just a glamorous imitation.
translated_content: Rampoldi, restoran legendaris Monaco yang didirikan pada tahun 1946, telah membuka cabang pertamanya di Amerika Serikat di New York City—tepat di seberang Lincoln Center. Kedatangannya terasa lebih seperti pernyataan daripada ekspansi biasa. Dipimpin oleh Chef Antonio Salvatore—warga asli Basilicata dan sang visioner di balik Rampoldi asli di Monaco serta La Table d’Antonio Salvatore Au Rampoldi yang terkenal—cabang New York ini adalah perpanjangan otentik dari versi Eropa-nya. MC Hospitality Group, yang juga mengelola Casa Limone dan The Atlantic Grill, mengawasi proyek ini, dengan Salvatore sebagai mitra. Menu hampir identik dengan yang ada di Monaco: campuran halus 'Monegasque modern' antara pengaruh Prancis dan Italia, menampilkan bahan-bahan impor premium seperti kaviar merek pribadi Salvatore dan truffle hitam yang melimpah. Hidangan seperti tartar kepiting dan alpukat ($42), carpaccio gurita ($24), dan risotto bertruffle ($47) memamerkan teknik dan kemewahan. Interior mencerminkan kemewahan Monaco: langit-langit tinggi, lantai marmer Rosso Imperiale, perabotan kustom Fratelli Boffi, lampu gantung kaca Murano, dan pencahayaan ambient yang dirancang untuk menerangi setiap sudut. Triptyk Mona Lisa karya seniman Domingo Zapata menghormati Grace Kelly—sebuah simbol yang kuat, meskipun sedikit ambigu. Daftar anggur setara dengan yang terbaik di kota, dan porsinya sangat besar. Namun, tidak semua hidangan memenuhi harapan: Sole à la meunière ($79), meski dihargai seperti Dover sole, datang dengan tekstur yang melempem, jauh dari kualitas premium yang dijanjikan. Hidangan penutup bersinar: chocolate fondant dengan sorbet pir ($18), Tarte Tatin ($18), profiteroles ($19), dan lemon meringue ($17)—semuanya dibuat secara klasik dan disajikan dengan indah. Layanan, bagaimanapun, masih tidak konsisten. Dan meskipun restoran ini bercita-cita menarik pelanggan selebriti, tidak ada selebritas yang terlihat selama kunjungan ini—meskipun mungkin mereka bersembunyi di balik kerumunan. Chef Salvatore terbang ke sini setiap bulan, tetapi ketidakhadirannya selama kunjungan ini terasa nyata. Agar Rampoldi benar-benar sukses di New York, kehadirannya harus lebih sering—berinteraksi dengan media, koki, dan pelanggan untuk membangun kredibilitas lokal yang otentik. Dengan layanan yang lebih tajam dan chef yang terlihat, ini bisa menjadi destinasi utama—bukan sekadar tiruan glamor.

article_content: Less than two months after their wedding, Muhammad Siddique brutally attacked his wife, Memoona Bibi, in Shahpur, Punjab, Pakistan. According to local reports, the assault began with him beating her with a stick before using an axe to amputate both of her legs. The attack reportedly followed weeks of escalating abuse, beginning shortly after their marriage in early March. Neighbors, horrified by the violence, intervened and subdued Siddique before handing him over to authorities. Memoona Bibi was rushed to a nearby hospital for emergency treatment. Authorities are now investigating the case as a severe act of domestic violence.

Menurut laporan lokal, serangan itu bermula ketika ia memukul istriya dengan tongkat, lalu menggunakan kapak untuk memotong kedua kakinya. Serangan itu dilaporkan terjadi setelah pelecehan berkelanjutan yang dimulai tak lama setelah pernikahan mereka pada awal Maret. Para tetangga yang terkejut melihat kekerasan itu langsung menghentikan Siddique dan menyerahkannya kepada polisi. Memoona Bibi segera dilarikan ke rumah sakit terdekat untuk mendapatkan perawatan darurat. Otoritas setempat kini sedang menyelidiki kasus ini sebagai bentuk kekerasan domestik yang sangat berat.

article_content: Washington (CNN) — Former U.S. Representative Gary Condit's semen was found on underwear belonging to Chandra Levy, according to FBI biologist Alan Giusti, who testified Wednesday in the trial of Ingmar Guandique, accused of murdering the Washington intern in 2001. The underwear was retrieved in May 2001 by investigators searching Levy’s apartment shortly after her parents reported her missing. Her body was discovered more than a year later in Washington’s Rock Creek Park. Giusti testified for prosecutors that the sperm DNA profile matched Gary Condit, addressing longstanding speculation about whether Condit — then a sitting congressman from California — had an affair with Levy, who had just turned 24 when she disappeared. Condit, who testified on November 1, declined to confirm or deny any intimate relationship with Levy. When asked by prosecutor Amanda Haines if they had been intimate, he responded, 'We've lost our feeling for common decency. I didn't commit any crime. I didn't do anything wrong.' No DNA was recovered from a separate pair of underwear and sports tights found at the scene. Prosecutors believe Guandique, a reputed member of the Salvadoran gang Mara Salvatrucha, attacked Levy while she was jogging and killed her after she screamed. Guandique denies involvement. There is no physical evidence directly linking Guandique to the attack. Consequently, prosecutors are relying primarily on his alleged jailhouse confession. As a result, prosecutors requested that the judge dismiss two of the six original charges against Guandique — including first-degree sexual assault. He remains charged with first-degree murder, kidnapping, and robbery. The judge denied the defense’s motion to acquit Guandique on the remaining charges.

Celana dalam itu diambil pada Mei 2001 oleh penyelidik yang mencari apartemen Levy tak lama setelah orang tuanya melaporkan dia menghilang. Mayatnya ditemukan lebih dari satu tahun kemudian di Taman Rock Creek, Washington. Giusti bersaksi untuk jaksa bahwa profil DNA sperma tersebut cocok dengan Gary Condit, menjawab spekulasi panjang tentang apakah Condit — yang saat itu merupakan anggota Kongres dari California — memiliki hubungan asmara dengan Levy, yang baru berusia 24 tahun ketika ia menghilang. Condit, yang bersaksi pada 1 November, menolak mengonfirmasi atau membantah hubungan intim apa pun dengan Levy. Ketika ditanya jaksa Amanda Haines apakah mereka pernah bercinta, ia menjawab, 'Kita telah kehilangan rasa kesusilaan. Saya tidak melakukan kejahatan. Saya tidak melakukan sesuatu yang salah.' Tidak ada DNA yang ditemukan dari sepasang celana dalam dan pakaian olahraga lainnya yang ditemukan di lokasi kejadian. Jaksa percaya Guandique, seorang anggota dugaan geng El Salvador Mara Salvatrucha, menyerang Levy saat ia sedang jogging dan membunuhnya setelah ia berteriak. Guandique membantah keterlibatannya. Tidak ada bukti fisik yang secara langsung menghubungkan Guandique dengan serangan tersebut. Akibatnya, jaksa sangat bergantung pada pengakuan yang diduga dilakukan Guandique di penjara. Sebagai hasilnya, jaksa meminta hakim untuk mencabut dua dari enam tuduhan awal terhadap Guandique — termasuk tuduhan pelecehan seksual tingkat pertama. Ia tetap diadili atas tuduhan pembunuhan tingkat pertama, penculikan, dan perampasan. Hakim menolak permohonan pertahanan agar Guandique dibebaskan dari semua tuduhan yang tersisa.

article_content: MUMBAI: The G20 THINQ quiz competition reached its climax on Saturday with the national finals held at the Gateway of India. Eight top student teams competed in a thrilling display of knowledge and quick thinking. DAV Public School, Gurugram, emerged as the champion, followed by GMHSS Malappuram as first runner-up and Bhavan’s Vidya Mandir, Kochi, as second runner-up. Kushagra Om Sharma and Ronit Bothra from GD Goenka Public School, Siliguri, were honored as the best individual quizzers among the finalists. Vanshaj Arora and Khushmeet Narwal from DAV Public School, Gurugram, have been selected to represent India as 'Team Bharat' in the international finals, scheduled for November 23 at India Gate in New Delhi. In related news, New York State Governor Kathy Hochul has signed legislation making Diwali an official public school holiday in New York City. The law requires all public schools to close on Diwali, which falls on the 15th day of the eighth month in the Indian lunar calendar. Hochul stated the move aims to honor cultural diversity and give students the opportunity to learn about and participate in global traditions. The NYC school district — the largest in the U.S. — served over one million students in 2022–23, with 16.5% identifying as Asian. Meanwhile, the hit Korean historical drama 'My Dearest' has been extended to 21 episodes due to its immense popularity. Production house MBC confirmed that filming for the finale will wrap on November 18, with heightened attention to detail to ensure a powerful conclusion. The series will air its final episode on November 18. Shah Rukh Khan, owner of the Kolkata Knight Riders IPL team, publicly cheered for Team India following their victory in the World Cup semi-finals. He shared messages of support on social media ahead of the finals. Other Bollywood stars including Rajinikanth, Sidharth Malhotra, Kiara Advani, and Ranbir Kapoor were spotted in the crowd. Sidharth Malhotra praised the team’s performance, while Ranbir Kapoor was seen promoting his upcoming film, 'Animal.'

article_content: Forget real food—this feast is entirely made of sponge cake. From a juicy-looking roast turkey with tomato garnish to a frosty glass of Coca-Cola beside a beef burger and fries, every detail is painstakingly crafted from edible batter. Even a Chanel handbag, a diamond ring, and Harry Potter’s owl Hedwig? All cake. Welcome to the surreal world of Rosebud Cakes, a Beverly Hills bakery run by Elin Katz for over 25 years. Katz doesn’t just bake desserts—she builds illusions. One Thanksgiving, a guest literally pulled off the turkey’s leg, convinced it was real. 'We aim to surprise, delight, and sometimes shock,' she says. Before starting, she meets clients to understand their vision, then sketches, selects flavors, colors, and decides what parts are meant to be eaten versus purely decorative. Each cake can take up to three days to complete. With a team of four handling everything from structural molding to paint-like icing work, no two creations are alike. Her most challenging build? A life-sized Darth Vader and Storm Trooper duo—three grueling days of precision. Prices range from $300 for simpler designs to $10,000 for museum-worthy masterpieces. Surprisingly, her peak season isn’t Valentine’s Day or wedding season—it’s Halloween. 'It’s chaotic, nerve-wracking, but pure joy,' Katz laughs. 'Every morning, I wake up thrilled I get to do this.' Her secret? Never make just a cake—make a memory. Whether it’s a pug that looks like it’ll wag its tail, or a grapefruit slice that tricks your taste buds, Katz turns sugar and flour into stories that make people laugh, gasp, or cry.
translated_content: Lupakan makanan asli—jamuan ini seluruhnya terbuat dari kue spons. Dari ayam panggang yang terlihat juicy dengan hiasan tomat hingga gelas Coca-Cola dingin di samping burger dan keripik, setiap detail dibuat dengan teliti dari adonan yang bisa dimakan. Bahkan tas Chanel, cincin berlian, dan burung hantu Hedwig dari Harry Potter? Semuanya kue. Selamat datang di dunia surealis Rosebud Cakes, sebuah toko kue di Beverly Hills yang dikelola oleh Elin Katz selama lebih dari 25 tahun. Katz tidak hanya membuat makanan penutup—dia membangun ilusi. Suatu Thanksgiving, seorang tamu benar-benar menarik kaki ayam karena mengira itu ayam asli. 'Kami bertujuan untuk mengejutkan, menyenangkan, dan kadang membuat terkejut,' katanya. Sebelum mulai, ia bertemu klien untuk memahami visi mereka, lalu membuat sketsa, memilih rasa, warna, dan memutuskan bagian mana yang bisa dimakan dan mana yang hanya dekoratif. Setiap kue bisa memakan waktu hingga tiga hari untuk diselesaikan. Dengan tim empat orang yang menangani segala hal mulai dari pemodelan struktural hingga hiasan seperti cat, tidak ada dua kreasi yang sama. Pembuatan paling menantang? Pasangan Darth Vader dan Storm Trooper berukuran asli—tiga hari penuh ketelitian ekstrem. Harganya berkisar dari $300 untuk desain sederhana hingga $10.000 untuk karya seni layak museum. Yang mengejutkan, musim puncaknya bukan Hari Valentine atau musim pernikahan—tetapi Halloween. 'Ini kacau, penuh tekanan, tapi sangat menyenangkan,' tertawa Katz. 'Setiap pagi, saya bangun dengan senang karena bisa melakukan pekerjaan ini.' Rahasia utamanya? Jangan pernah membuat sekadar kue—buatlah kenangan. Entah itu pug yang terlihat seperti akan menggoyangkan ekornya, atau setengah jeruk bali yang membuat lidah Anda terkecoh, Katz mengubah gula dan tepung menjadi cerita yang membuat orang tertawa, terkesima, atau bahkan menangis.

article_content: By John Stevens. Published: 18:54 EST, 6 May 2013. | Updated: 10:09 EST, 8 May 2013. Nick Milligan had been enjoying a break at his £2 million dream home overlooking Daymer Bay in Cornwall when he and his eight-year-old daughter, Emily, tragically died in a boating accident. The Sky Media executive, 51, had taken his wife Victoria, 41, and their four children — Amber, 12; Olivia, 10; Emily, 8; and Kit, 4 — out on their rigid inflatable boat, nicknamed 'Milly'. The boat capsized in the estuary near Padstow. His younger brother, Max Milligan, 48, described him as 'an extremely loving father, husband, son, and brother.' He added that knowing Nick and Emily died in their favorite place at the end of a sunny bank holiday offered a 'tiny glimmer of light.' Milligan built the coastal home after spending childhood summers and New Year’s Eves in Polzeath, Cornwall. The family spent most holidays at the property in Trebetherick, a quiet village near Polzeath and home to poet John Betjeman’s grave. They kept 'Milly' — a £60,000 RIB — moored in Rock, across the estuary from Padstow. Milligan held a permit to use it for waterskiing. Colleagues at Sky Media, where he served as managing director on a seven-figure salary, called him a 'wonderful man' and 'well-respected boss.' Guy Zitter, managing director of Mail Newspapers, praised Milligan as 'one of the most respected and loved people in the industry,' noting his charm, humor, and deep business insight. Neighbors in their £6 million West London home described the family as 'one of the nicest in the area.' Olivia Henderson, a longtime neighbor, recalled Emily as a sweet, smiling girl often seen riding her scooter in her school uniform. She said Victoria was a devoted mother, and the family was always polite and well-kept. Milligan was known in the media world for being 'almost obsessively competitive' with an 'intense desire to win.'

Eksekutif Sky Media, berusia 51 tahun, membawa istri Victoria, 41 tahun, dan keempat anak mereka — Amber, 12; Olivia, 10; Emily, 8; dan Kit, 4 — naik perahu karet kaku bernama 'Milly'. Perahu itu terguling di muara dekat Padstow. Saudaranya yang lebih muda, Max Milligan, 48 tahun, menggambarkannya sebagai 'ayah, suami, anak, dan saudara yang sangat penuh cinta.' Ia menambahkan bahwa mengetahui Nick dan Emily meninggal di tempat favorit mereka pada akhir hari libur yang cerah memberikan 'sedikit cahaya.' Milligan membangun rumah tepi pantai itu setelah menghabiskan musim panas dan Malam Tahun Baru masa kecilnya di Polzeath, Cornwall. Keluarga itu menghabiskan sebagian besar liburan mereka di properti di Trebetherick, sebuah desa tenang dekat Polzeath dan lokasi makam penyair John Betjeman. Mereka menyimpan 'Milly' — perahu RIB senilai £60.000 — di dermaga di Rock, di seberang muara dari Padstow. Milligan memiliki izin untuk menggunakannya berselancar air. Rekan-rekan di Sky Media, tempat ia menjabat sebagai direktur utama dengan gaji tujuh angka, menyebutnya sebagai 'pria luar biasa' dan 'bos yang dihormati.' Guy Zitter, direktur utama Mail Newspapers, memuji Milligan sebagai 'salah satu orang paling dihormati dan dicintai di industri ini,' mencatat pesonanya, humor, dan pemahaman mendalam tentang bisnis. Tetangga di rumah mereka senilai £6 juta di West London menggambarkan keluarga itu sebagai 'salah satu keluarga terbaik di daerah itu.' Olivia Henderson, tetangga lama, mengenang Emily sebagai gadis kecil yang manis dan selalu tersenyum, sering terlihat bermain skuter dalam seragam sekolahnya. Ia mengatakan Victoria adalah ibu yang sangat perhatian, dan keluarga itu selalu sopan dan rapi. Milligan dikenal di dunia media sebagai seseorang yang 'hampir obsesif kompetitif' dengan 'keinginan kuat untuk menang.'

article_content: According to Ben Mezrich’s book 'Breaking Twitter', Esther Crawford—one of Elon Musk’s closest aides after he took over X (formerly Twitter)—received unusual guidance early in her tenure. Shortly after meeting Musk, Jehn Balajadia, an operations coordinator at the Boring Company, quietly pulled her aside at Twitter headquarters and said: 'Elon is a very special guy. Since you’ll be close to him, your job is to help take care of him, protect him, and make sure things run smoothly.' Balajadia reportedly added that others would try to reach Musk through her, warning her to be extremely cautious. Crawford, widely recognized for a viral photo of her sleeping on the floor of X’s office, held the role of director of product management and oversaw the launch of Twitter Blue before being laid off in February. She later called her termination 'the best gift' she’d ever received. In a July video posted on X, Crawford criticized Musk’s leadership style, stating he operated in an 'echo chamber' surrounded by 'yes men' and frequently relied on instinct rather than data-driven analysis. Still, she acknowledged his unique charm, humor, and the valuable lessons she learned working alongside him.

Tak lama setelah bertemu Musk, Jehn Balajadia, koordinator operasi di Boring Company, secara diam-diam menariknya ke sudut ruangan di kantor Twitter dan berkata: 'Elon itu orang yang sangat istimewa. Karena kamu akan dekat dengannya, tugasmu adalah membantu merawatnya, melindunginya, dan memastikan semuanya berjalan lancar.' Balajadia dikabarkan juga memperingatkannya bahwa banyak orang akan mencoba menghubungi Musk melalui dirinya, dan dia harus sangat berhati-hati. Crawford, yang dikenal luas karena foto viralnya sedang tidur di lantai kantor X, menjabat sebagai direktur manajemen produk dan mengawasi peluncuran Twitter Blue sebelum diberhentikan pada Februari. Ia kemudian menyebut pemecatannya sebagai 'hadiah terbaik' yang pernah ia terima. Dalam video Juli yang diunggah di X, Crawford mengkritik gaya kepemimpinan Musk, menyatakan bahwa ia beroperasi dalam 'echo chamber' yang dipenuhi 'para pengikut setia' dan sering mengandalkan insting daripada analisis berbasis data. Namun, ia tetap mengakui pesona unik, kecerdasan humorisnya, serta pelajaran berharga yang ia dapatkan dari bekerja bersamanya.

article_content: Rachel Farrell, a former English teacher at Bangor Area High School in Pennsylvania, pleaded guilty to engaging in sexual relationships with a 17-year-old student she taught. The encounters, which occurred between August 2010 and January 2011, took place in her car and at least twice at a Ramada Inn in Tannersville, Monroe County, according to police. Farrell, who was 25 at the time and had been married for only two months, resigned from her teaching job and later divorced. She faces three felony charges of corrupting the morals of a minor. Investigators believe she may have had similar relationships with up to three other students. The victim, now 18, told authorities the relationship began via Facebook and involved repeated sexual encounters in secluded locations, including a Walmart parking lot. Farrell admitted the conduct to school colleagues and later to Monroe County Detective Robert Righi. Upon receiving the allegations, the Bangor Area School District promptly referred the case to county prosecutors. This incident is part of a troubling pattern in the district: in 2009, a biology teacher died of a heroin overdose; in 2010, a male teacher’s aide was jailed for supplying drugs to students — one of whom later died by suicide — and a nude photo of a female staff member was shared among students. In a separate, nationally significant case, Georgia elementary teacher Shannon Alicia Schmieder was sentenced to 40 years in prison last week — the longest sentence ever handed down in the United States to an educator convicted of sexual contact with a minor — underscoring a growing commitment to holding teachers accountable for exploiting their positions of trust.

Pertemuan-pertemuan tersebut terjadi antara Agustus 2010 dan Januari 2011, di mobilnya dan setidaknya dua kali di Ramada Inn di Tannersville, Monroe County, menurut laporan polisi. Farrell, yang berusia 25 tahun pada saat itu dan baru menikah selama dua bulan, mengundurkan diri dari jabatannya sebagai guru dan kemudian bercerai. Dia menghadapi tiga tuduhan kejahatan serius atas pencemaran moral anak di bawah umur. Penyelidik percaya bahwa ia mungkin juga memiliki hubungan serupa dengan hingga tiga siswa lainnya. Korban, yang kini berusia 18 tahun, memberi tahu otoritas bahwa hubungan itu dimulai melalui Facebook dan melibatkan hubungan seksual berulang kali di lokasi terpencil, termasuk tempat parkir Walmart. Farrell mengakui perilaku tersebut kepada rekan-rekannya di sekolah dan kemudian kepada Detektif Robert Righi dari Kantor Polisi Monroe County. Setelah menerima dugaan tersebut, Distrik Sekolah Bangor Area segera menyerahkan kasus ini kepada jaksa wilayah. Insiden ini merupakan bagian dari pola yang mengkhawatirkan di distrik tersebut: pada tahun 2009, seorang guru biologi meninggal karena overdosis heroin; pada tahun 2010, seorang asisten guru laki-laki dipenjara karena menyediakan narkoba kepada siswa — salah satu di antaranya kemudian bunuh diri — dan sebuah foto bugil seorang staf perempuan tersebar di kalangan siswa. Dalam kasus terpisah yang signifikan secara nasional, guru sekolah dasar di Georgia, Shannon Alicia Schmieder, dihukum 40 tahun penjara minggu lalu — hukuman terpanjang yang pernah dijatuhkan di Amerika Serikat terhadap seorang pendidik yang dihukum karena kontak seksual dengan anak di bawah umur — menunjukkan komitmen yang semakin kuat untuk menahan para guru yang menyalahgunakan kepercayaan yang diberikan kepada mereka.

article_content: SINGAPORE — Prince William arrived Sunday in Singapore for the Earthshot Prize awards, the first to be held in Asia, to support environmental innovators developing solutions to combat climate change and protect the planet. Dozens of people waving British flags welcomed him with loud cheers. William, 41, shook hands, signed autographs, and sportingly took selfies with many during a walkabout. "It’s fantastic to be back in Singapore for this year’s Earthshot Prize ceremony, after eleven years," he said in a statement upon landing. "Singapore’s bold vision to lead in environmental innovation sets a standard for others to follow." "He has this charm," said Johanes Mario, a Singaporean welcoming William at the airport. "He really fights for the climate. I believe this is a crucial cause for the future of our generation," he added. At Singapore’s Changi Airport, before greeting the crowd, William stood on an upper floor to admire the stunning 40-meter-high Rain Vortex — the world’s largest indoor waterfall — illuminated green to mark his arrival. He was also shown a tree planted in his honor in the indoor garden at the waterfall’s base. The heir to the British throne last visited Singapore with his wife, Princess Catherine, in 2012. Traveling solo this time, William’s focus is on the Earthshot Prize, which he and his Royal Foundation launched in 2020 to promote innovative solutions and technologies to combat global warming and reduce its environmental impact. Five winners will be announced at an award ceremony on Tuesday. Each will receive £1 million ($1.2 million) to scale their projects for global impact. This year, 15 finalists — selected from 1,300 nominees across six continents — compete in five categories: nature protection, clean air, ocean revival, waste elimination, and climate change. William will address the star-studded ceremony, hosted by English actress Hannah Waddingham. Attendees include wildlife conservationist Robert Irwin and celebrities such as Oscar-winner Cate Blanchett, actress Lana Condor, and actor Nomzamo Mbatha. The inaugural ceremony was held in London in 2021, followed by Boston last year. The prize’s name references former U.S. President John F. Kennedy’s 1962 'moonshot' speech, which challenged Americans to land on the moon by the end of the decade. Similarly, the Earthshot Prize aims to achieve tangible environmental breakthroughs by 2030. Singapore’s Foreign Ministry confirmed that William will meet with President Tharman Shanmugaratnam and Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loon at The Istana — one of Singapore’s oldest heritage sites — during his four-day visit. A keen sportsman, William will also try dragon boating, a popular activity in Singapore and beyond, and meet local leaders to learn how community organizations are restoring the environment. Kensington Palace stated that Singapore was chosen to host this year’s ceremony due to its role as a regional hub for innovation in Southeast Asia. William will also attend the United for Wildlife summit, featuring law enforcement, conservation groups, and corporations working to combat the $20-billion-a-year illegal wildlife trade.

Lima pemenang akan diumumkan pada upacara penghargaan pada hari Selasa. Setiap pemenang akan menerima £1 juta ($1,2 juta) untuk mengembangkan proyek mereka secara global. Demikian pula, Earthshot Prize bertujuan mencapai terobosan lingkungan yang nyata pada tahun 2030. Kementerian Luar Negeri Singapura mengonfirmasi bahwa William akan bertemu dengan Presiden Tharman Shanmugaratnam dan Perdana Menteri Lee Hsien Loon di The Istana — salah satu situs warisan tertua Singapura — selama kunjungan empat harinya. Sebagai olahragawan yang antusias, William juga akan mencoba perahu naga, aktivitas populer di Singapura dan di mana saja, serta bertemu para pemimpin lokal untuk mempelajari bagaimana organisasi masyarakat memulihkan lingkungan. Kantor Kensington Palace menyatakan bahwa Singapura dipilih sebagai tuan rumah upacara tahun ini karena perannya sebagai pusat inovasi di Asia Tenggara. William juga akan menghadiri pertemuan United for Wildlife, yang menampilkan lembaga penegak hukum, kelompok konservasi, dan perusahaan yang bekerja sama untuk memerangi perdagangan ilegal satwa liar senilai $20 miliar per tahun.

article_content: Jeff Bauman, a survivor of the 2013 Boston Marathon bombing, is writing a memoir titled 'Stronger,' set to be published in April 2014 — the anniversary of the attack. The 27-year-old from New Hampshire lost both legs below the knees in the explosion and has since learned to walk with prosthetics, launching a new career as a motivational speaker. A widely circulated photo taken moments after the blast shows Bauman pale and bleeding, with only exposed bone below his knees — an enduring image of the day’s horror. Despite immense trauma, he has maintained a hopeful outlook. Grand Central Publishing will release 'Stronger,' a book detailing his survival, recovery, and the support he received from the people of Boston. Matthew Ballast, Vice President of Publicity at Grand Central, said, 'He’s telling his story for the first time — his experiences, his recovery, and how the city of Boston helped him heal.' Before the bombing, Bauman worked at a Costco deli to pay off student loans. He was at the marathon to cheer on his girlfriend when he was near one of the bombs planted by the Tsarnaev brothers. After the blast, he was found in a pool of blood, his legs shattered. A stranger in a cowboy hat, Carlos Arredondo, rushed to his aid, applying tourniquets and wheeling him to an ambulance. The two formed a deep bond and have since appeared together at public events, including throwing the first pitch at Fenway Park. Bauman underwent emergency amputations at the knees and further surgery to remove damaged tissue up to four inches above the knees. He also suffered significant hearing loss in one ear. Authorities credit Bauman with helping identify the bombers. Even while injured and in shock, he tried to tell responders, 'I knew who did it.' His identification was instrumental in the manhunt. Today, Bauman focuses on healing and moving forward. Doctors have marveled at his rapid recovery, jokingly calling him 'Wolverine.' He says dwelling on what might have been is pointless — instead, he chooses to live with purpose.
translated_content: Jeff Bauman, seorang selamat dari serangan Maraton Boston 2013, sedang menulis memoar berjudul 'Stronger,' yang akan diterbitkan pada April 2014 — tepat pada peringatan serangan itu. Pria berusia 27 tahun dari New Hampshire kehilangan kedua kakinya di bawah lutut akibat ledakan dan kini telah belajar berjalan dengan prostesis, serta memulai karier baru sebagai pembicara motivasi. Sebuah foto yang tersebar luas diambil beberapa saat setelah ledakan menunjukkan Bauman pucat dan berdarah, dengan hanya tulang yang terlihat di bawah lututnya — gambar abadi dari kengerian hari itu. Meskipun mengalami trauma hebat, ia tetap mempertahankan sikap optimis. Grand Central Publishing akan merilis 'Stronger,' sebuah buku yang menceritakan kelangsungan hidup, pemulihan, dan dukungan yang ia terima dari warga Boston. Matthew Ballast, Wakil Presiden Publisitas di Grand Central, berkata, 'Dia menceritakan kisahnya untuk pertama kalinya — pengalamannya, pemulihannya, dan bagaimana kota Boston membantunya sembuh.' Sebelum serangan itu, Bauman bekerja di counter deli Costco untuk membayar utang kuliahnya. Ia berada di maraton untuk menyemangati pacarnya ketika ia berada dekat salah satu bom yang ditanam oleh saudara-saudara Tsarnaev. Setelah ledakan, ia ditemukan dalam genangan darah, kakinya hancur. Seorang asing dengan topi koboi, Carlos Arredondo, bergegas membantunya, mengikat tourniquet dan mengangkutnya ke ambulans dengan kursi roda. Keduanya membentuk ikatan yang dalam dan sejak itu sering muncul bersama di acara publik, termasuk melempar bola pertama di Fenway Park. Bauman menjalani operasi amputasi darurat di lutut dan operasi lanjutan untuk mengangkat jaringan yang rusak hingga empat inci di atas lutut. Ia juga mengalami gangguan pendengaran signifikan di satu telinga. Otoritas memberi kredit kepada Bauman karena membantu mengidentifikasi para pelaku. Bahkan saat terluka dan syok, ia berusaha memberi tahu petugas, 'Saya tahu siapa yang melakukannya.' Identifikasinya sangat penting dalam pengejaran mereka. Saat ini, Bauman fokus pada penyembuhan dan melangkah maju. Para dokter kagum dengan pemulihannya yang cepat, bahkan bercanda memanggilnya 'Wolverine.' Ia mengatakan bahwa merenungkan apa yang seharusnya terjadi tidak ada gunanya — sebaliknya, ia memilih untuk hidup dengan tujuan.

article_content: It’s not everyday you see two elephants standing side by side on a quiet London street — but this isn’t real wildlife, it’s art. Meet Tim Bushe, a 60-year-old architect from Highbury, North London, who turned hedge trimming into a passion project with a purpose. Four years ago, his wife Philippa asked him to shape their front bushes into a cat. He didn’t have time for a feline, so instead, he carved a steam engine — and never looked back. Since then, Tim has crafted an ever-growing collection of living sculptures: serpents winding through gardens, owls perched on hedges, a clucking chicken, even a towering Chinese dragon. His most popular pieces? A family of elephants — now a local landmark. Each sculpture takes weeks of careful pruning using his trusty 42-inch Black & Decker electric cutter. But there’s more than beauty here. Tim donates all proceeds from his work to Hft, a charity that supports people with learning disabilities — especially his younger sister Martha, who has Down’s syndrome. He charges £250 for the first design and £75 for each additional shape, turning greenery into generosity. Neighbors stop to take photos. Children point and smile. Tim says the best part isn’t the praise — it’s how these hedges bring people together. 'They spark conversations,' he says. 'And sometimes, they help change lives.'
translated_content: Tidak setiap hari Anda melihat dua gajah berdiri berdampingan di jalan tenang di London — tapi ini bukan satwa liar nyata, ini seni. Temui Tim Bushe, arsitek berusia 60 tahun dari Highbury, London Utara, yang mengubah pemangkasan semak menjadi proyek penuh gairah dengan tujuan mulia. Empat tahun lalu, istrinya Philippa meminta dia membentuk semak depan rumah menjadi bentuk kucing. Dia tidak punya waktu untuk kucing, jadi dia malah membuat lokomotif uap — dan tak pernah berhenti. Sejak itu, Tim telah menciptakan koleksi patung hidup yang terus bertambah: ular melilit kebun, burung hantu bertengger di semak, ayam berkokok, bahkan naga Cina yang menjulang. Karya paling populer? Keluarga gajah — kini menjadi landmark lokal. Setiap patung membutuhkan berminggu-minggu pemangkasan hati-hati menggunakan pemotong listrik Black & Decker 42 inci miliknya. Tapi ada lebih dari keindahan di sini. Tim menyumbangkan semua hasil penjualan karyanya ke Hft, sebuah yayasan yang mendukung orang-orang dengan disabilitas intelektual — terutama adiknya Martha, yang memiliki sindrom Down. Dia mematok harga £250 untuk desain pertama dan £75 untuk setiap bentuk tambahan, mengubah hijaunya tanaman menjadi kebaikan. Tetangga berhenti untuk mengambil foto. Anak-anak menunjuk dan tersenyum. Tim mengatakan bagian terbaik bukan pujian — tapi bagaimana semak-semak ini menyatukan orang-orang. 'Mereka memicu percakapan,' katanya. 'Dan terkadang, mereka membantu mengubah hidup.'

article_content: Professor Sir Bruce Keogh has warned that a Yes vote in the Scottish independence referendum could severely disrupt cross-border healthcare. He described a potential outcome as a 'Hadrian’s Wall of health' between England and Scotland. In an exclusive article for the Daily Mail, Sir Bruce highlighted that 44,000 Scottish patients received treatment in England last year — including critical services like heart, lung, and liver transplants. A confidential document reviewed by the Scottish Daily Mail reveals that NHS Scotland is planning £400 million to £450 million in budget cuts for 2015–17, driven by reduced funding growth, pension contribution increases, and rising costs for rare and ultra-rare drugs. Sir Bruce challenged Alex Salmond’s claim that a No vote threatens Scotland’s NHS, noting that 'the people of Wales, England, or Northern Ireland cannot privatise the Scottish NHS even if they wanted to.' NHS England CEO Simon Stevens stated that while the Scottish Parliament has managed its own NHS since 1999, independence would necessitate a new bilateral agreement to maintain patient access to specialist services in England. Former Prime Minister Gordon Brown accused the SNP of 'perpetrating a lie' by suggesting they lack the power to protect the NHS without independence, asserting that Holyrood already controls all health funding and policy. Scottish Labour leader Johann Lamont claimed the SNP concealed plans for NHS cuts until after the referendum, contradicting Salmond’s campaign promises. The Scottish Government responded that its £12.1 billion resource budget reflects a real-terms increase for 2014–15 and 2015–16, and that efficiency savings have redirected over £1.5 billion to frontline care since 2008. Liberal Democrat figures Charles Kennedy and Danny Alexander cited the leaked document as evidence that the SNP cannot be trusted with public services — positioning Kennedy as a unifying figure in the Union campaign.

Sebuah dokumen rahasia yang ditinjau oleh Scottish Daily Mail mengungkap bahwa NHS Skotlandia merencanakan pemotongan anggaran sebesar £400 juta hingga £450 juta pada 2015–17, akibat penurunan pertumbuhan pendanaan, kenaikan kontribusi pensiun, serta meningkatnya biaya obat-obatan langka dan ultra-langka. Sir Bruce menantang klaim Alex Salmond bahwa suara Tidak mengancam NHS Skotlandia, dengan menyatakan bahwa 'orang-orang di Wales, Inggris, atau Irlandia Utara tidak bisa memprivatisasi NHS Skotlandia, bahkan jika mereka ingin melakukannya.' CEO NHS Inggris, Simon Stevens, menyatakan bahwa meskipun Parlemen Skotlandia telah mengelola NHS-nya sendiri sejak 1999, kemerdekaan akan memerlukan kesepakatan bilateral baru agar pasien Skotlandia tetap dapat mengakses layanan spesialis di Inggris. Mantan Perdana Menteri Gordon Brown menuduh SNP 'mempertahankan kebohongan' dengan menyiratkan bahwa mereka tidak memiliki wewenang untuk melindungi NHS tanpa kemerdekaan, menegaskan bahwa Holyrood sudah sepenuhnya mengendalikan pendanaan dan kebijakan kesehatan. Pemimpin Partai Buruh Skotlandia, Johann Lamont, mengklaim bahwa SNP menyembunyikan rencana pemotongan NHS hingga setelah referendum, bertentangan dengan janji kampanye Salmond. Tokoh-tokoh Liberal Demokrat, Charles Kennedy dan Danny Alexander, mengutip dokumen bocor sebagai bukti bahwa SNP tidak dapat dipercaya dalam mengelola layanan publik — menempatkan Kennedy sebagai figur penyatu dalam kampanye Uni.

article_content: On your first day at university, rushing to room 9-209 across a sprawling 168-acre campus can feel overwhelming — like searching for one specific grain of sand on a beach. But now, there’s a new helper in town: SkyCall, a small flying robot designed by MIT’s Senseable City Lab to guide lost students through the maze of buildings. All you need is the SkyCall app: you request it, enter your destination, and the drone flies to you, hovering nearby as it leads the way with spoken directions and landmark cues. Traveling at just 6 km/h, it’s slow enough to keep pace with a walking student, and its sonar sensors help it dodge obstacles. If you lag behind, it waits. If you’re running late, it won’t leave you stranded. Developed as an experimental tool during orientation week, SkyCall has already become a hit among students who describe it as a quirky, friendly travel buddy. While it currently has a 1-mile range and 15-minute battery life, researchers believe scaling up the power source could unlock broader uses — from guiding tourists in unfamiliar cities to aiding emergency responders in disaster zones. Equipped with a camera, SkyCall could even stream live aerial views to your phone. Carlo Ratti, head of the lab, emphasizes that this isn’t about replacing humans, but enhancing their experience. 'We want to show drones aren’t just surveillance tools,' he says. 'They can be helpers — under human control, for human benefit.' SkyCall is part of a larger vision at MIT to reimagine urban tech as something intuitive, playful, and genuinely useful — turning everyday challenges into opportunities for innovation.

Bergerak dengan kecepatan hanya 6 km/jam, ia cukup lambat untuk mengikuti langkah mahasiswa, dan sensor sonarnya membantunya menghindari rintangan. Jika Anda tertinggal, ia akan menunggu. Jika Anda terlambat, ia tidak akan meninggalkan Anda. Dikembangkan sebagai alat eksperimen selama minggu orientasi, SkyCall sudah menjadi favorit di kalangan mahasiswa yang menyebutnya teman perjalanan yang unik dan ramah. Dilengkapi kamera, SkyCall bahkan bisa menyiarkan tampilan udara secara langsung ke ponsel Anda. Carlo Ratti, kepala laboratorium, menekankan bahwa ini bukan tentang menggantikan manusia, tapi memperkuat pengalaman mereka. 'Kami ingin menunjukkan bahwa drone bukan sekadar alat pengawasan,' katanya. 'Mereka bisa menjadi penolong — di bawah kendali manusia, untuk kepentingan manusia.' SkyCall adalah bagian dari visi besar di MIT untuk membayangkan teknologi perkotaan sebagai sesuatu yang intuitif, menyenangkan, dan benar-benar berguna — mengubah tantangan sehari-hari menjadi peluang inovasi.

article_content: In 1981, Freddie Mercury and Michael Jackson stepped into the studio together to record a haunting duet titled 'There Must Be More To Life Than This' — originally intended for Queen’s album 'Hot Space'. Though Mercury laid down his vocals during a visit to Jackson, the track was shelved and never completed by the band. Years later, in 1985, Mercury released a solo version on his album 'Mr. Bad Guy'. Now, over four decades after that initial session, Queen’s remaining members, guitarist Brian May and drummer Roger Taylor, are bringing the original duet back to life. It will be part of 'Queen Forever', a new compilation of the band’s romantic ballads set for release this November. Alongside it, two previously unheard Mercury recordings will also make their debut. British producer William Orbit, who worked on restoring the tracks, described the experience as discovering a hidden treasure trove from two musical giants. 'Hearing Michael’s voice felt like he was right there in the room — so alive, so soulful,' May shared. 'And Freddie’s solo take on the mixing board? It reminded me why I’ve spent my whole life chasing that kind of magic.' Mercury passed away in 1991 at age 45; Jackson followed in 2009 at 50. Their voices, once frozen in time, now echo anew.
translated_content: Pada tahun 1981, Freddie Mercury dan Michael Jackson masuk ke studio bersama untuk merekam duet yang mengharukan berjudul 'There Must Be More To Life Than This' — awalnya ditujukan untuk album Queen 'Hot Space'. Meskipun Mercury telah merekam vokalnya selama kunjungan ke Jackson, lagu ini ditinggalkan dan tidak pernah selesai oleh band. Bertahun-tahun kemudian, pada 1985, Mercury merilis versi solonya di album 'Mr. Bad Guy'. Kini, lebih dari empat dekade setelah sesi awal itu, anggota tersisa Queen, gitaris Brian May dan drummer Roger Taylor, membawa kembali duet aslinya ke panggung. Lagu ini akan menjadi bagian dari 'Queen Forever', sebuah kompilasi baru balada cinta band yang akan dirilis bulan ini. Bersama dengannya, dua rekaman Mercury yang sebelumnya belum pernah dirilis juga akan debut. Produser Inggris William Orbit, yang bekerja pada pemulihan lagu-lagu tersebut, menggambarkan pengalaman ini sebagai menemukan harta karun tersembunyi dari dua raksasa musik. 'Mendengar suara Michael terasa seperti dia ada tepat di ruangan itu — sangat hidup, sangat penuh jiwa,' kata May. 'Dan vokal solo Freddie di meja mixing? Itu mengingatkan saya mengapa sepanjang hidup saya mengejar keajaiban semacam itu.' Mercury meninggal pada 1991 di usia 45 tahun; Jackson menyusul pada 2009 di usia 50. Suara mereka, yang dulu terpaku dalam waktu, kini bergema kembali.

article_content: By Tim Shipman. Warning: William Hague branded the unrest in Egypt 'the greatest crisis of the 21st century.' Foreign Secretary William Hague has warned that turmoil in Egypt could persist for decades, as it emerged that former dictator Hosni Mubarak is set to be released from prison. Hague described the situation in Cairo as 'very bleak,' stating that Egypt’s drift toward civil war—the most populous Arab nation—is the most critical crisis of the 21st century. Violence erupted again yesterday with reports of two new atrocities: at least 24 police officers loyal to the military regime were shot execution-style by Islamist militants in the Sinai Desert. Separately, 36 Islamist prisoners suffocated after tear gas was fired into their transport van during transfer out of Cairo. The Muslim Brotherhood called the van incident 'murder'; authorities claimed it was an attempted jailbreak. Further unrest is expected upon Mubarak’s release. The 85-year-old former ruler, who governed Egypt from 1981 to 2011, was convicted in 2012 for failing to prevent protester deaths during the 2011 uprising that ousted him. He was sentenced to life imprisonment. However, new developments indicate Mubarak has been cleared of those charges and is pending final judicial review for release—a move many fear will reignite bloodshed. Since the military-backed government forcibly dispersed Muslim Brotherhood sit-ins in Cairo on July 8, 2013, at least 850 people—including 70 police and soldiers—have been killed. Hague told the BBC: 'It is a very bleak situation. It’s hard to overstate the levels of hatred and mistrust between the various sides in Egypt. This is an extremely difficult scenario. There may be years, perhaps decades, of turbulence—not just in Egypt, but across nations grappling with profound questions about democracy and religion’s role in society.' 'What’s unfolding in the Middle East is the most significant event of the 21st century so far—even more consequential than the global financial crisis—in terms of its impact on world affairs. It will likely take years, if not decades, to resolve.' Mubarak, pictured in court earlier this year, is scheduled for release pending final judicial approval. Hague said he would consult EU partners on potentially withdrawing aid to pressure Egypt’s military-backed government to halt violence and pursue a political compromise. Egypt’s ambassador to Britain, Ashraf ElKholy, likened the military’s crackdown on the Muslim Brotherhood to Britain’s response to the 2011 London riots—but noted it turned violent when Islamists opened fire on security forces. ElKholy accused the Brotherhood of attempting to dominate all aspects of Egyptian society, comparing them to Nazi Germany: 'Morsi was elected president and held office for one year. In that time, he sought to impose Muslim Brotherhood control over every institution. Egypt’s 5,000-year culture is a blend of religions and civilizations, with Islam as one element. The Muslim Brotherhood are like a Nazi group demanding total conformity.' Mubarak was arrested after the 2011 uprising that ended his three-decade rule amid regional upheaval. During his trial, he appeared in a courtroom cage, facing charges ranging from corruption to complicity in protester deaths. His lawyer, Fareed el-Deeb, stated that the only remaining legal basis for detention is an administrative corruption case, which should be resolved within 48 hours. 'He should be freed by the end of the week,' el-Deeb said. However, Egyptian judicial sources indicated Mubarak will remain detained for another two weeks pending a final ruling on the outstanding case. Mubarak’s release is widely seen as a symbolic reversal of the Arab Spring’s democratic momentum.

'Apa yang sedang terjadi di Timur Tengah adalah peristiwa paling signifikan sejauh ini di abad ke-21—bahkan lebih berdampak daripada krisis keuangan global—dalam hal dampaknya terhadap urusan dunia. Ini kemungkinan akan membutuhkan bertahun-tahun, bahkan puluhan tahun, untuk diselesaikan.' Hague mengatakan ia akan berkonsultasi dengan mitra Uni Eropa tentang kemungkinan menarik bantuan guna memberi tekanan pada pemerintah Mesir yang didukung militer agar menghentikan kekerasan dan mencari kompromi politik. Duta Besar Mesir untuk Inggris, Ashraf ElKholy, membandingkan operasi militer melawan Ikatan Muslim dengan respons Inggris terhadap kerusuhan London 2011—tetapi mencatat bahwa situasi menjadi berdarah ketika kaum Islamis mulai menembaki pasukan keamanan. ElKholy menuduh Ikatan Muslim berusaha menguasai semua aspek masyarakat Mesir, membandingkannya dengan Nazi Jerman: 'Morsi terpilih sebagai presiden dan menjabat selama satu tahun. Dalam waktu itu, ia berusaha menempatkan kendali Ikatan Muslim atas setiap lembaga. Budaya Mesir yang berusia 5.000 tahun adalah campuran agama dan peradaban, dengan Islam sebagai salah satu unsurnya. Ikatan Muslim seperti kelompok Nazi yang menuntut keseragaman total.' Mubarak ditangkap setelah pemberontakan 2011 yang mengakhiri pemerintahannya selama tiga dekade di tengah gejolak regional. Selama persidangannya, ia muncul di sangkar pengadilan, menghadapi tuduhan mulai dari korupsi hingga keterlibatan dalam pembunuhan demonstran. Pengacaranya, Fareed el-Deeb, menyatakan satu-satunya dasar hukum yang tersisa untuk penahanannya adalah kasus korupsi administratif, yang seharusnya selesai dalam 48 jam. 'Ia harus dibebaskan pada akhir minggu ini,' kata el-Deeb. Namun, sumber yudisial Mesir mengindikasikan Mubarak akan tetap ditahan selama dua minggu lagi menunggu keputusan akhir atas kasus yang masih tertunda. Pembebasan Mubarak secara luas dianggap sebagai simbol mundurnya kemajuan demokrasi dari Musim Semi Arab.

article_content: By Tracey Cox. 'Living in sin' turns out to be just what’s needed for a happy marriage, according to the results of a major U.S. study released last week. The study upends previous research suggesting couples who live together before marriage are more likely to split — instead finding the opposite: relationships can last eight years longer when couples cohabit before tying the knot. This is great news for those considering moving in — but a reality check is still essential. Set aside emotion, put on your objective hat, and honestly assess how many of the following you can answer 'yes' to. If you can’t say 'yes' to most, consider waiting longer — or rethinking the decision entirely. Absolutely must answer 'yes' to: 1. Do they make you feel good about yourself? Are you happier since you met them? 2. Are you able to be your true self around them? 3. Have you seen how they behave in various situations — daily life, happy moments, workplace stress, or family/friend pressures? Did they handle crises well? 4. Are you similar in tastes, values, and preferred activities? 5. Do you connect on at least three of these crucial areas: chemistry (you’re deeply attracted), compatibility (shared backgrounds and interests), common goals (aligned life visions), pace (both are 'fast' or 'slow' types), and timing (both ready for commitment)? 6. Do you communicate well — or at least believe you can learn to? If most answers are 'no,' Tracey smells trouble. 7. Do you trust them to be faithful? When they go out alone or with friends, do they reassure you with details about where they’ve been and who they saw? 8. Do you get along with each other’s friends and family? If neither of you can stand the other’s loved ones, that’s a red flag. 9. Do you both want the same things from life — and around the same time? Similar views on marriage, kids, and the future? 10. Does your gut instinct tell you this is right? 11. Do you like them as much as you love them? Important to answer 'yes' to: 1. Are they reliable? 2. Do you make decisions together? 3. Have you had disagreements — and were you satisfied with how you resolved them? The number of arguments matters less than how well you fix them. 4. Are you both able to admit when you’re wrong? 5. Are they emotionally stable? If they’re excessively jealous, overprotective, or struggling with alcohol or drug use, address those issues before moving in. 6. Are you both happy with the level of emotional and physical intimacy? Ensure sharing secrets, feelings, and anxieties isn’t one-sided. 7. Do you laugh together? Do you share a sense of humor and can joke about yourselves without taking offense? 8. Are you sexually compatible? If your libidos differ, have you found a compromise that works for both? 9. Are you both content with the balance of time spent together versus apart? Is there healthy space for 'us' and 'me'? 10. Do you trust each other to keep promises — not just about fidelity, but also about finances, showing up during hard times, and doing the right thing? 11. Can you live with each other’s flaws? Everyone has annoying habits — but if something really grates on you now, it’ll only intensify after moving in. 12. Are you together because you genuinely want to be — not because of a ticking biological clock or fear that no one else will want you? If most answers are 'yes,' start packing. If there are more than a few 'no's,' hold off on signing that lease. For more relationship advice, visit traceycox.com. Read more of Tracey’s MailOnline blog here.
translated_content: Oleh Tracey Cox. 'Hidup berzina' ternyata justru dibutuhkan untuk pernikahan yang bahagia, menurut hasil studi besar di Amerika Serikat yang dirilis minggu lalu. Studi ini menyangkal penelitian sebelumnya yang menyatakan pasangan yang tinggal bersama sebelum menikah lebih cenderung bercerai — justru menemukan sebaliknya: hubungan bisa bertahan delapan tahun lebih lama jika pasangan tinggal bersama sebelum resmi menikah. Ini adalah kabar baik bagi mereka yang mempertimbangkan untuk pindah bersama — tetapi tetap perlu melakukan evaluasi realistis. Tinggalkan emosi, kenakan topi objektif Anda, dan jujurlah menilai seberapa banyak pertanyaan berikut ini Anda bisa jawab 'ya'. Jika Anda tidak bisa menjawab 'ya' untuk sebagian besar pertanyaan ini, pertimbangkan untuk menunda lebih lama — atau memikirkan ulang keputusan Anda sama sekali. Harus benar-benar menjawab 'ya' untuk: 1. Apakah mereka membuat Anda merasa baik tentang diri sendiri? Apakah Anda lebih bahagia sejak mengenal mereka? 2. Apakah Anda bisa menjadi diri sendiri di depan mereka? 3. Apakah Anda sudah melihat bagaimana mereka bersikap dalam berbagai situasi — sehari-hari, saat bahagia, di bawah tekanan kerja, atau dari keluarga/teman? Apakah mereka menangani krisis dengan baik? 4. Apakah Anda memiliki kesamaan dalam selera, nilai, dan aktivitas yang disukai? 5. Apakah Anda terhubung pada setidaknya tiga hal penting ini: kimia (Anda sangat tertarik satu sama lain), kompatibilitas (berlatar belakang dan minat serupa), tujuan bersama (menginginkan hal yang sama dalam hidup), ritme (keduanya 'cepat' atau 'lambat'), dan waktu (keduanya siap untuk komitmen)? 6. Apakah Anda berkomunikasi dengan baik — atau setidaknya yakin bisa belajar melakukannya? Jika sebagian besar jawaban Anda 'tidak', Tracey mencium ada masalah. 7. Apakah Anda percaya mereka akan setia? Ketika mereka pergi sendiri atau bersama teman-teman, apakah mereka memberi tahu Anda secara rinci siapa yang ditemui, ke mana mereka pergi, dan siapa yang mereka temui? 8. Apakah Anda cocok dengan teman dan keluarga masing-masing? Jika kalian berdua tidak suka dengan orang-orang terdekat satu sama lain, itu tanda buruk. 9. Apakah Anda berdua menginginkan hal yang sama dalam hidup — dan pada waktu yang hampir bersamaan? Pandangan serupa tentang pernikahan, anak-anak, dan masa depan? 10. Apakah naluri Anda mengatakan ini benar? 11. Apakah Anda menyukai mereka sebanyak Anda mencintai mereka? Penting untuk menjawab 'ya' untuk: 1. Apakah mereka dapat diandalkan? 2. article_content: When her baby naps—or when sleep eludes her—Sarah Andrews, a 32-year-old stay-at-home mom from suburban Rochester, New York, sheds her everyday identity to become a 'virtual deputy' patrolling the U.S.-Mexico border. From her living room, she watches grainy live feeds from BlueServo.net, a Texas-funded platform offering 24/7 surveillance of remote border areas. With over 43,000 registered users worldwide, the site lets anyone spot suspicious movement—a shadow crossing the desert, figures wading through the Rio Grande—and alert local law enforcement via email. Launched in November with a $2 million state grant, BlueServo.net was created by the Texas Border Sheriff's Coalition to engage the public in border security. The program targets areas where physical barriers are absent or patrols are sparse, using 15 hidden cameras mounted on private property. Since its debut, 20 million visitors have tuned in, drawing national attention amid rising concerns over drug violence. Supporters hail the initiative as an innovative, low-cost extension of border protection. 'It may take many small efforts to achieve a big result,' says Rob Abernethy, a North Carolina factory worker who checks the feed during breaks. But critics argue the program is largely symbolic—and potentially dangerous. Texas Senator Eliot Shapleigh warns it 'panders to extremist groups,' while experts like immigration law professor Stephen Legomsky note there's no evidence surveillance deters border crossings; instead, increased enforcement pushes migrants toward deadlier routes. So far, the program has led to just four arrests—all involving marijuana trafficking and roughly 2,000 pounds of seized drugs. Don Reay, the coalition’s executive director, insists the real value lies in deterrence: 'The cameras don’t let bad actors operate under the cloak of darkness.' Yet he admits no hard data supports claims of declining crime. Users like Andrews remain uncertain. 'I wonder if it's a waste of time,' she says, though she continues watching, driven by curiosity and hope that her alerts might help stop drugs from reaching her community. For Abernethy, it’s just another way to pass the time—'like watching reruns of 'Everybody Loves Raymond.' But for others, it’s a glimpse into a new frontier of civic participation: one where a mother in New York helps police a border thousands of miles away—with no feedback, no recognition, and no clear outcome.

Dari ruang tamunya, ia menyaksikan feed langsung yang buram dari BlueServo.net, sebuah platform yang didanai negara bagian Texas dan menayangkan pengawasan 24 jam di wilayah perbatasan yang terpencil. Dengan lebih dari 43.000 pengguna terdaftar di seluruh dunia, situs ini memungkinkan siapa pun untuk melihat gerakan mencurigakan—bayangan melintasi gurun, orang-orang berenang melintasi Sungai Rio Grande—dan melaporkannya ke aparat penegak hukum setempat melalui email. Diluncurkan pada November dengan dana hibah negara sebesar $2 juta, BlueServo.net dibuat oleh Texas Border Sheriff's Coalition untuk melibatkan masyarakat dalam keamanan perbatasan. Program ini menargetkan area-area di mana tidak ada penghalang fisik atau patroli yang jarang, menggunakan 15 kamera tersembunyi yang dipasang di properti pribadi. Sejak peluncurannya, 20 juta pengunjung telah mengakses situs ini, menarik perhatian nasional di tengah meningkatnya kekhawatiran akan kekerasan narkoba. Para pendukung memuji inisiatif ini sebagai perpanjangan inovatif dan hemat biaya dari perlindungan perbatasan. 'Mungkin butuh banyak usaha kecil untuk mencapai hasil besar,' kata Rob Abernethy, seorang pekerja pabrik dari Carolina Utara yang memeriksa feed saat istirahat. Tetapi para kritikus berpendapat program ini sebagian besar bersifat simbolis—dan berpotensi berbahaya. Senator Texas Eliot Shapleigh memperingatkan bahwa program ini 'menggoda kelompok ekstremis,' sementara pakar seperti profesor hukum imigrasi Stephen Legomsky mencatat tidak ada bukti bahwa pengawasan dapat mencegah pelintasan perbatasan; sebaliknya, penegakan yang lebih ketat mendorong para migran menuju rute yang lebih mematikan. Sejauh ini, program ini telah menghasilkan hanya empat penangkapan—semua terkait perdagangan mariyuana dan sekitar 2.000 pon obat yang disita. Don Reay, direktur eksekutif koalisi tersebut, bersikeras bahwa nilai sebenarnya terletak pada pencegahan: 'Kamera tidak membiarkan pelaku jahat beroperasi di balik kedok kegelapan.' Namun ia mengakui tidak ada data nyata yang mendukung klaim penurunan kejahatan. Pengguna seperti Andrews tetap ragu-ragu. 'Saya bertanya-tanya apakah ini buang-buang waktu,' katanya, meskipun ia terus mengawasi, didorong oleh rasa ingin tahu dan harapan bahwa laporannya bisa membantu menghentikan narkoba sampai ke komunitasnya. Bagi Abernethy, ini hanyalah cara lain untuk menghabiskan waktu—'seperti menonton ulangan 'Everybody Loves Raymond.' Tapi bagi orang lain, ini adalah gambaran tentang perbatasan baru partisipasi sipil: di mana seorang ibu di New York membantu mengawasi perbatasan ribuan mil jauhnya—tanpa umpan balik, tanpa pengakuan, dan tanpa hasil yang jelas.

article_content: By Richard Alleyne in Oakland. Published: 17:08 EST, 3 January 2014. Updated: 19:37 EST, 3 January 2014. Declared dead: A California court allowed Jahi McMath’s parents to remove her from the hospital and keep her alive elsewhere—only after a coroner issued a death certificate. Today, a court heard that Jahi’s mother, Nailah Winkfield, may take her daughter out of the hospital while still on a ventilator, provided she assumes full responsibility for her care. This arrangement became possible only after the Alameda County Coroner issued a death certificate for the 13-year-old, legally permitting the hospital to release her body as if for burial or cremation. Children’s Hospital in Oakland and Jahi’s family reached an agreement on transferring her to a long-term care facility. Under the protocol, Ms. Winkfield must be wholly and exclusively responsible for Jahi’s welfare, including providing all medical equipment and expert care. Jahi suffered complications following a routine tonsillectomy on December 9, 2013. Her heart stopped, leading to severe brain damage. Hospital physicians declared her brain dead, stating she had no chance of recovery without mechanical ventilation. Three independent doctors and the court concurred with the diagnosis. The hospital sought to discontinue life support, but Jahi’s parents, led by Ms. Winkfield and her uncle Omari Sealey, refused to accept the prognosis, claiming she responded to her mother’s voice. They obtained a temporary injunction preventing the hospital from turning off the ventilator, which was set to expire at 5 p.m. on Tuesday. Initially, the hospital refused transfer, citing ethical and legal concerns about releasing a legally deceased patient. However, after the coroner’s certificate, it accepted a plan proposed by the family’s attorney, Chris Dolan. 'There are no winners in this,' said Sam Singer, hospital spokesperson. 'This young woman is dead, and it is very sad.' Doug Strauss, the hospital’s lawyer, emotionally urged the family to accept Jahi’s death. Meanwhile, Mr. Dolan called the agreement a step forward. The Alameda County Coroner confirmed issuing a 'generic' death certificate but provided no further details. The California Department of Public Health continues its investigation into the incident.

Dinyatakan meninggal: Pengadilan California mengizinkan orang tua Jahi McMath untuk memindahkan putri mereka dari rumah sakit dan menjaga kehidupannya di tempat lain—hanya setelah seorang ahli forensik menerbitkan sertifikat kematian. Hari ini, pengadilan mendengar bahwa ibu Jahi, Nailah Winkfield, dapat membawa putrinya keluar dari rumah sakit sambil tetap terhubung dengan ventilator, selama ia menerima tanggung jawab penuh atas perawatannya. Kesepakatan ini hanya mungkin terwujud setelah Ahli Forensik Kabupaten Alameda menerbitkan sertifikat kematian untuk remaja berusia 13 tahun itu, secara hukum mengizinkan rumah sakit untuk melepaskan tubuhnya seolah-olah akan dimakamkan atau dikremasi. Rumah Sakit Anak di Oakland dan keluarga Jahi mencapai kesepakatan untuk memindahkannya ke fasilitas perawatan jangka panjang. Menurut protokol tersebut, Ibu Winkfield harus bertanggung jawab sepenuhnya dan eksklusif atas kesejahteraan Jahi, termasuk menyediakan semua peralatan medis dan keahlian medis yang diperlukan. Jahi mengalami komplikasi setelah operasi rutin pengangkatan amandel pada 9 Desember 2013. Jantungnya berhenti, menyebabkan kerusakan otak yang parah. Dokter rumah sakit menyatakan ia mengalami kematian otak, dengan tidak ada kemungkinan pemulihan tanpa ventilator mekanis. Tiga dokter independen dan pengadilan sepakat dengan diagnosis tersebut. Rumah sakit berusaha menghentikan dukungan hidup, tetapi orang tua Jahi, dipimpin oleh Ibu Winkfield dan pamannya Omari Sealey, menolak menerima prognosa itu, mengklaim bahwa ia merespons suara ibunya. Mereka memperoleh perintah sementara yang mencegah rumah sakit mematikan ventilator, yang akan berakhir pada pukul 17.00 hari Selasa. Awalnya, rumah sakit menolak pemindahan itu, dengan alasan etis dan hukum tentang melepaskan pasien yang secara hukum telah meninggal. Namun, setelah sertifikat kematian dikeluarkan, rumah sakit menerima rencana yang diajukan oleh pengacara keluarga, Chris Dolan. 'Tidak ada pemenang dalam kasus ini,' kata Sam Singer, juru bicara rumah sakit. 'Wanita muda ini sudah meninggal, dan ini sangat menyedihkan.' Doug Strauss, pengacara rumah sakit, secara emosional mendesak keluarga untuk menerima kematian putri mereka. Sementara itu, Mr. Dolan menyebut kesepakatan itu sebagai langkah maju. Ahli Forensik Kabupaten Alameda mengonfirmasi telah menerbitkan sertifikat kematian 'generik' tetapi tidak memberikan rincian lebih lanjut. Departemen Kesehatan California terus menyelidiki insiden tersebut.

article_content: An American imprisoned in the United Arab Emirates after posting a video that parodied Dubai teens will be released this week, a family spokeswoman said Tuesday. Shezanne Cassim plans to fly back to the United States on Thursday, according to family spokeswoman Jennifer Gore. There was no immediate response from the UAE government to the family's announcement, nor to previous requests for comment on Cassim's case. U.S. State Department spokeswoman Jen Psaki said Tuesday that, after receiving credit for time served and good behavior, Cassim was transferred to a deportation facility for processing. 'We understand processing will take a few days, at which point he will be returning to the United States,' Psaki said, adding that U.S. diplomats have visited Cassim regularly while in custody and plan to visit again Wednesday. Cassim, 29, of Woodbury, Minnesota, moved to Dubai in 2006 after graduating from college to work for PricewaterhouseCoopers. His family says he was arrested in April after uploading a 19-minute video that humorously portrays a clique of Dubai teens influenced by hip-hop culture. In December, he was sentenced to one year in prison and a fine of approximately $2,700. The specific charges were not read aloud in court, but the UAE’s main English-language newspaper reported he was accused of defaming the country’s international image. UAE officials stated only that Cassim 'was charged under the UAE’s penal code' and 'is entitled to the fair trial protections contained in the UAE’s constitution.' In the 1990s, the term 'Satwa G' emerged to describe a group of suburban teens known for exaggerating their toughness. Cassim’s video depicts a fictional 'combat school' in Dubai’s Satwa district, where these youths are comically trained in skills like throwing sandals at targets, using accessories as whips, and calling for backup via phone. Cassim’s family said they were not informed of the charges against him for five months. 'He tries to put on a brave face,' his brother, Shervon Cassim, said in December. 'He said he was doing fine, not to worry about him—but I could sense he was a little depressed. My impression is he’s going a little crazy in his cell.' Shervon added that the video was made 'just for fun.' 'He’s a big fan of SNL, Funny or Die, and similar shows. He and his friends wanted to make a funny sketch comedy in their spare time. There was no indication in local law that making a comedy video mocking suburban teens constituted a threat to national security.' Online comedy platform Funny or Die rallied behind Cassim, launching the #FreeShez campaign in observance of U.N. Human Rights Day on December 10. Cassim served nine months—more than half of his sentence before being formally charged—before being moved to the deportation facility, according to his family. The family reached out to U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry ahead of his Middle East trip last week, and Senator Amy Klobuchar also advocated for his release. 'The disregard for freedom of expression, the arbitrary application of this cybercrime law, and the constant delays reveal the UAE legal system as archaic and unfair by modern standards,' said Susan Burns, the family’s U.S.-based lawyer. 'However, we are relieved that the UAE finally recognized that Shezanne deserved to be released.'

Cassim, 29 tahun, dari Woodbury, Minnesota, pindah ke Dubai pada 2006 setelah lulus kuliah untuk bekerja di PricewaterhouseCoopers. Keluarganya mengatakan ia ditangkap pada April setelah mengunggah video berdurasi 19 menit yang menggambarkan secara lucu sekelompok remaja Dubai yang terpengaruh budaya hip-hop. Tuntutan hukum tidak dibacakan di pengadilan, tetapi surat kabar utama berbahasa Inggris di UEA melaporkan bahwa Cassim dituduh mencemarkan citra negara di kancah internasional. Pejabat UEA hanya menyatakan bahwa Cassim 'dikenakan tuntutan di bawah kode pidana UEA' dan 'berhak atas perlindungan persidangan yang adil yang tercantum dalam konstitusi UEA.' Pada tahun 1990-an, istilah 'Satwa G' muncul untuk menggambarkan sekelompok remaja pinggiran kota yang dikenal sering memperbesar-besar kegagahannya. Video Cassim menggambarkan sebuah 'sekolah pertempuran' fiktif di distrik Satwa, Dubai, di mana para remaja ini dilatih secara lucu dalam keterampilan seperti melempar sandal ke target, menggunakan aksesori pakaian sebagai cambuk, dan menelepon untuk meminta bantuan. Keluarga Cassim mengatakan mereka tidak diberi tahu tentang tuduhan terhadapnya selama lima bulan. 'Dia berusaha tampak kuat,' kata saudaranya, Shervon Cassim, pada Desember. 'Dia bilang dia baik-baik saja, jangan khawatir tentang dirinya—tapi saya bisa merasakan dia sedikit depresi. Kesannya, dia mulai gila di selnya.' Shervon menambahkan bahwa video itu dibuat 'hanya untuk bersenang-senang.' 'Dia penggemar berat SNL, Funny or Die, dan acara serupa. Dia dan teman-temannya ingin membuat sketsa komedi lucu di waktu luang mereka. Tidak ada indikasi dalam hukum lokal bahwa membuat video komedi yang mengejek remaja pinggiran merupakan ancaman terhadap keamanan nasional.' Platform komedi daring Funny or Die mendukung Cassim, meluncurkan kampanye #FreeShez dalam rangka Hari Hak Asasi Manusia PBB pada 10 Desember. Cassim menjalani sembilan bulan hukuman—lebih dari separuh masa hukumannya sebelum secara resmi dituntut—sebelum dipindahkan ke fasilitas deportasi, menurut keluarganya. Keluarga tersebut menghubungi Menteri Luar Negeri AS John Kerry sebelum perjalanan Timur Tengahnya minggu lalu, dan Senator Amy Klobuchar juga mendesak pembebasannya. 'Tidak adanya penghormatan terhadap kebebasan berekspresi, penerapan sewenang-wenang terhadap undang-undang siber ini, serta penundaan berulang menunjukkan sistem hukum UEA sebagai kuno dan tidak adil menurut standar modern,' kata Susan Burns, pengacara keluarga yang berbasis di AS. 'Namun, kami lega bahwa UEA akhirnya menyadari bahwa Shezanne pantas dibebaskan.'

article_content: Oscar-winning composer Andrew Lloyd Webber, known for musicals like Jesus Christ Superstar, Cats, and Evita, is proposing an ambitious plan to install Wi-Fi in every church across the UK. His goal is to reinvigorate these often-underused buildings by making them hubs of community activity. Lloyd Webber, whose father served as music director at a London church, has discussed the idea with Culture Minister Ed Vaizey, who is actively considering the proposal. Under the plan, local businesses and residents could access high-speed internet beamed from church steeples or use Wi-Fi inside the buildings. Churches could also develop apps to showcase hidden architectural gems—such as stained-glass windows—to attract visitors. In a recent interview with Event magazine, Lloyd Webber expressed deep admiration for Nicole Scherzinger, the former Pussycat Doll now starring in his revival of Cats. He called her 'the most exciting musical theatre artist I have worked with in many years.' The Bishop of Norwich, the Rt Rev Graham James, welcomed the idea, noting his diocese already uses church steeples to deliver broadband to remote areas. 'It’s an imaginative way of using our network of ancient buildings for community purposes,' he said. Vaizey confirmed that his department is already equipping 1,000 public buildings with broadband and is exploring ways to extend the program to churches, possibly through a dedicated funding stream. 'We are keen to ensure our heritage is preserved,' he added.

article_content: In Oberursel, Germany, police discovered the body of a 66-year-old woman who had passed away more than six months earlier. She was found seated on her sofa, still wearing her nightgown, with the television still running and a September TV guide resting beside her. The lights in her apartment remained on, and her remains showed signs of partial mummification due to the extended time since her death from natural causes. Neighbors became concerned when their mail began piling up in her mailbox, prompting them to contact authorities. When officers arrived and forced entry, they encountered the unsettling scene. Chief Inspector Ulrich Demmer of the Hesse police noted that such incidents are becoming more common, reflecting deeper shifts in how people live — increasingly isolated, even in densely populated areas. In a separate case earlier this year, mummified remains believed to be those of 49-year-old Pia Farrenkopf were found in the back seat of her Jeep inside a garage in Pontiac, Michigan. Despite evidence of distinctive dental work that could help confirm her identity, officials have yet to locate her former dentists. No signs of criminal activity were found in either case.
