article_content: Ashley Williams, 49, was sentenced to life in prison after being convicted of murdering his 24-year-old lover, Julie Beattie, in a horrific act of revenge. After she planned to leave him for his 18-year-old son, Williams attacked her with a hammer, doused her in petrol and diesel, and set her on fire inside their South London home. Julie, barely conscious, staggered out of the house engulfed in flames, whispering, 'Ashley did this to me,' before collapsing. She later died from her injuries. Two of Williams’ young children — aged four and five — witnessed the attack and became the youngest-ever witnesses in a UK murder trial. Her sister, Lucie Beattie, arrived at the scene to find Williams calmly putting on his coat as Julie burned behind him. Neighbors rushed to help, dousing her with water and wrapping her in wet blankets, but it was too late. Williams had grown increasingly controlling, forbidding Julie from getting tattoos or wearing revealing clothes. When he discovered her affair with his son, Ashley Jr., he threatened to 'break every bone in his body' if his son didn’t leave London. On the day of the murder, Williams sent Julie desperate texts pleading for forgiveness: 'I wish you nothing but the best... I’ll always love you.' He also sent disturbing messages to his own children, cursing them for the breakup. He claimed he didn’t intend to kill her — saying he thought they were in a 'water fight' — but jurors rejected his defense. He showed no emotion during the verdict, even smiling at times, prompting the judge to call him 'a very dangerous man.' Judge Charles Ward QC condemned the brutality of the crime, noting Williams did nothing to help Julie as she burned. He emphasized the presence of children and family members during the attack, calling it 'a terrible, terrible crime.' Julie’s mother, Linda Beattie, described her daughter as 'beautiful, bubbly, caring, and selfless' — a 'large ball of positive energy' whose death has left the family 'completely destroyed.' Williams, who had eight children with his ex-wife Monica and four with Julie Beattie, received a life sentence with a minimum term of 25 years before parole eligibility.

article_content: By Kieran Gill. Follow @kie1410. Roberto Martínez believes Gerard Deulofeu has the talent to break into Barcelona’s first team, but the Everton manager admits the forward may struggle to secure regular playing time amid fierce competition from stars like Lionel Messi, Neymar, Pedro, and Alexis Sánchez. Deulofeu, a regular starter for Everton, caught the attention of Barcelona coach Luis Enrique after helping the Toffees finish fifth in the Premier League — prompting Barcelona to recall the 20-year-old to the Nou Camp. However, Martínez feels another year in the Premier League would have better prepared Deulofeu for the demands of Barça, where he will face constant pressure to earn minutes. VIDEO: Scroll down to watch Gerard Deulofeu freestyling at Barcelona’s Nou Camp. Youngster: Gerard Deulofeu was recalled by Barcelona but may struggle to hold down a first-team spot. Control: Deulofeu maintained a regular starting role at Everton, helping them finish fifth in the Premier League. Career Stats: 2011–2013 — Barcelona B (68 apps, 27 goals); 2011–present — Barcelona (2 apps, 0 goals); 2013–2014 — Everton (loan, 25 apps, 3 goals); 2014–present — Spain (1 app, 0 goals). The challenge is undeniably steep, given Barcelona’s attacking depth. Yet Martínez believes Deulofeu is ready. 'He has special talent — certain qualities that make him stand out,' Martínez told Spanish newspaper Mundo Deportivo. 'I was delighted when Del Bosque called him up for the World Cup friendly. They’d been monitoring him during his year at Everton and saw he was performing at a very high level.' 'It would have been good for Gerard and for Everton if he had stayed for another year. He would have had a bigger role here than he likely will at Barcelona, given the competition there.' 'It would have been fantastic to keep him at Everton — another year in the Premier League would have made him even better prepared for the jump to Barcelona. But they didn’t want that, and I presume Luis Enrique — who knows him well — recognized his potential.' Martínez will also lose Romelu Lukaku next season, as the Belgian striker returns to parent club Chelsea after scoring 15 goals for Everton. However, Lukaku is reportedly on Atlético Madrid’s radar — especially if Diego Costa departs for Chelsea. 'Romelu is a bit like Gerard — a great young player who arrived in Liverpool without much tactical discipline but has improved immensely without losing his physical or technical edge,' Martínez said. 'If he ends up at Atlético, knowing Diego Simeone’s methods, it will benefit both Simeone and the club. His characteristics suit Simeone — and vice versa.' On his way? Romelu Lukaku is thought to be on Atlético Madrid’s wishlist should they lose Diego Costa.

article_content: If you're looking for a Rolex, you're in luck—there are almost always a few available at Unclaimed Baggage. In fact, the most expensive item ever sold there was a platinum Rolex, appraised at $64,000 and sold for $32,000 in 2014. Planning to fly this week? You're not alone. The Transportation Security Administration expects to screen 30 million passengers over the Thanksgiving holiday. That’s a lot of suitcases—and unfortunately, some will get lost. So where does all that lost luggage end up? At Unclaimed Baggage, a 50,000-square-foot store in Scottsboro, Alabama, about 150 miles northwest of Atlanta. Every suitcase lost by a U.S. airline—or sometimes a train or bus—eventually arrives here, and everything is for sale at deep discounts. Unlike a typical warehouse, Unclaimed Baggage is laid out like a full-service department store: clothing, shoes, books, formal wear, and jewelry—all neatly organized. 'The most popular area of the store is the mezzanine,' says Sonni Hood, who started working here as a teen and is now the public relations manager. 'That’s where our electronics department is—cell phones, laptops, tablets, headphones—you name it.' All electronics are wiped clean of personal data and tested to ensure they work. Laptops, iPads, and Nintendo Switches sell for about half the price of new models. But the mezzanine holds even stranger treasures: skis, snowboards, a bin of skateboards, a sled, a women’s pole-vaulting pole, a Bates Kimberly stock saddle, and brand-new riding boots. The electronics department is consistently a hit. Latest smartphones, iPads, and laptops are priced at roughly half the cost of new ones. Employees ensure all devices are fully functional and data-free. None of this surprises Hood. 'Anything you can imagine, someone has probably packed it—and lost it.' When an airline permanently loses a bag, it compensates the owner up to $3,800. Airlines spend up to three months trying to reunite luggage with its owner before forfeiting it. In fact, 99.5% of checked bags are successfully returned. But that 0.5% adds up—and that’s where Unclaimed Baggage comes in. The business began in 1970 when Bryan Owens’ father heard a friend working for Trailways Bus Lines didn’t know what to do with unclaimed bags. He borrowed $300 and a pickup truck, drove to Washington, D.C., bought the bags, and brought them home to sell. People lined up outside his store—even though it was only open two days a week. When his boss told him to choose between his insurance job and this new venture, he didn’t hesitate. His mother wasn’t convinced—but 53 years later, Unclaimed Baggage draws a million visitors annually. People come from all 50 states, many making it an annual pilgrimage. It’s the only store in the U.S. dedicated to selling items travelers accidentally leave behind. Rarely, lost items make it back to their owners. One man from Atlanta bought ski boots at the annual ski sale—only for his fiancée to discover her name inside. She’d lost them on a previous trip. Some shipments hold astonishing finds. Owens recalls opening a crate with a device suspended by rubber grommets and a label reading, 'Handle with extreme caution—I’m worth my weight in gold.' It turned out to be a guidance system from an F-14 Tomcat fighter jet. The military thought Iran had stolen it—but it had been sitting in Scottsboro all along. The Navy reclaimed it. When a camera from a space shuttle arrived, they contacted NASA directly. Among the oddities: a centuries-old violin possibly crafted by a student of Antonio Stradivari, ancient Egyptian artifacts, a full suit of armor, and a giant puppet named Hoggle from the movie Labyrinth—given to them by Jim Henson himself. They’ve even created a museum to display these extraordinary finds. Ben Foster of Chattanooga and his friend Josh Elliott of Atlanta were amazed by the store’s organization. 'This is a lot better than Goodwill,' Elliott said. 'At Goodwill, people donate things they don’t want. Here, people took these items on vacation because they loved them.' Many clothes still have tags—they were bought new for travel. Luxury brands like Rolex, Chanel, Louis Vuitton, and Prada regularly appear. One of this year’s Best Director Oscar winners, Daniel Scheinert, wore a tuxedo bought here to accept his award. A dress believed to have belonged to Marie Osmond is also on display. But Owens emphasizes this isn’t just shopping—it’s anthropology. 'Opening a bag is like an archaeological dig. You see fashion, technology, cosmetics—what people carry reveals who they are. It’s a cross-section of America—and the world, since airlines are global.' There’s also the quiet joy of imagining the stories: Was the pole-vaulter an Olympian? Did the owner of that wedding dress get lost on the way home? Why are so many canes and crutches left behind? Staff call this section the 'Miraculous Recovery Department.' And the jewelry counter? More men’s wedding rings go missing than women’s. That’s a story for another day.
translated_content: Jika Anda mencari jam tangan Rolex, Anda beruntung—hampir selalu ada beberapa tersedia di Unclaimed Baggage. Faktanya, barang paling mahal yang pernah dijual di sana adalah Rolex platinum, dievaluasi seharga $64.000 dan terjual seharga $32.000 pada tahun 2014. Berencana terbang minggu ini? Anda tidak sendiri. Administrasi Keamanan Transportasi memperkirakan akan memeriksa 30 juta penumpang selama liburan Thanksgiving. Itu banyak koper—dan sayangnya, beberapa akan hilang. Jadi, ke mana semua koper yang hilang itu berakhir? Di Unclaimed Baggage, sebuah toko seluas 50.000 kaki persegi di Scottsboro, Alabama, sekitar 150 mil barat laut Atlanta. Setiap koper yang hilang dari maskapai penerbangan AS—atau kadang kereta atau bus—akhirnya tiba di sini, dan semuanya dijual dengan diskon besar. Tidak seperti gudang biasa, Unclaimed Baggage disusun seperti toko departemen lengkap: pakaian, sepatu, buku, pakaian formal, dan perhiasan—semuanya rapi dan teratur. 'Area paling populer di toko ini adalah mezanin,' kata Sonni Hood, yang mulai bekerja di sini saat remaja dan kini menjabat sebagai manajer hubungan masyarakat. 'Di situlah kami memiliki departemen elektronik—ponsel, laptop, tablet, headphone—apa pun yang Anda bisa bayangkan.' Semua perangkat elektronik dibersihkan dari data pribadi dan diuji untuk memastikan berfungsi dengan baik. Laptop, iPad, dan Nintendo Switch dijual sekitar separuh harga baru. Tetapi mezanin menyimpan harta yang lebih aneh lagi: ski, papan salju, satu peti penuh skateboard, sebuah luncur, tiang tolak poling wanita, pelana berkuda Bates Kimberly, dan sepatu berkuda baru. Departemen elektronik selalu sangat diminati. Ponsel, iPad, dan laptop terbaru dihargai sekitar separuh harga baru. Karyawan departemen teknologi memastikan semua perangkat berfungsi sempurna dan bebas data pribadi. Tidak ada yang mengejutkan Hood. 'Apa pun yang bisa Anda bayangkan, seseorang pasti telah membawanya—dan kehilangannya.' Ketika maskapai penerbangan kehilangan koper secara permanen, mereka memberi kompensasi kepada pemilik hingga $3.800. Maskapai menghabiskan waktu hingga tiga bulan untuk mencoba mengembalikan koper kepada pemiliknya sebelum melepaskan hak kepemilikan. Faktanya, 99,5% koper yang diperiksa berhasil dikembalikan. Tapi 0,5% itu jumlahnya banyak—dan di situlah peran Unclaimed Baggage. Bisnis ini dimulai pada tahun 1970 ketika ayah Bryan Owens mendengar temannya yang bekerja di Trailways Bus Lines tidak tahu harus berbuat apa dengan koper-koper tak terklaim. Ia meminjam $300 dan truk pick-up, pergi ke Washington, D.C., membeli koper-koper itu, lalu membawanya pulang untuk dijual. Orang-orang antre di luar tokonya—meskipun toko itu hanya buka dua hari seminggu. Ketika bosnya menyuruhnya memilih antara pekerjaan asuransinya atau usaha barunya, ia tidak ragu-ragu. Ibunya tidak yakin—tapi 53 tahun kemudian, Unclaimed Baggage menarik satu juta pengunjung setiap tahun. Orang-orang datang dari semua 50 negara bagian, banyak yang menjadikannya perjalanan tahunan. Ini adalah satu-satunya toko di AS yang khusus menjual barang-barang yang secara tidak sengaja ditinggalkan oleh para pelancong. Jarang sekali barang yang hilang kembali ke pemiliknya. Seorang pria dari Atlanta membeli sepatu ski di acara jualan ski tahunan—hanya untuk pasangannya menemukan namanya di dalamnya. Ia sebelumnya telah kehilangan sepatu itu saat perjalanan ski. Beberapa kontainer pengiriman menyimpan temuan menakjubkan. Owens ingat membuka peti dengan perangkat yang digantung oleh grommet karet dan label bertuliskan, 'Penanganan dengan sangat hati-hati—saya bernilai emas seberat saya.' Ternyata itu adalah sistem panduan dari pesawat tempur F-14 Tomcat. Militer mengira Iran telah mencurinya—tetapi ternyata perangkat itu sudah lama berada di gudang Scottsboro. Angkatan Laut mengambilnya kembali. Ketika kamera dari pesawat ulang-alik tiba, mereka langsung menghubungi NASA. Di antara barang-barang aneh lainnya: biola berusia berabad-abad yang mungkin dibuat oleh murid Antonio Stradivari, artefak Mesir kuno, baju zirah lengkap, dan boneka raksasa bernama Hoggle dari film Labyrinth—yang diberikan kepada mereka oleh Jim Henson sendiri. Mereka bahkan membuat museum untuk memajang temuan luar biasa ini. Ben Foster dari Chattanooga dan temannya Josh Elliott dari Atlanta terkesan dengan organisasi toko ini. 'Ini jauh lebih baik daripada Goodwill,' kata Elliott. 'Di Goodwill, orang menyumbangkan barang yang tidak mereka inginkan. Di sini, orang membawa barang-barang ini saat liburan karena mereka menyukainya.' Banyak pakaian masih memiliki label baru—karena banyak orang membeli pakaian baru sebelum bepergian. Merek mewah seperti Rolex, Chanel, Louis Vuitton, dan Prada sering muncul. Salah satu pemenang Oscar untuk Pengarah Terbaik tahun ini, Daniel Scheinert, memakai jas tuxedo yang dibeli di sini saat menerima penghargaannya. Gaun yang diyakini pernah dimiliki oleh Marie Osmond juga dipajang. Tetapi Owens menekankan bahwa ini bukan hanya soal konsumsi—ini adalah antropologi. 'Membuka sebuah koper seperti melakukan penggalian arkeologis. Anda melihat mode, teknologi, kosmetik—barang yang dibawa seseorang mengungkap siapa dirinya. Ini adalah gambaran tentang apa yang terjadi di Amerika—dan dunia, karena maskapai penerbangan bersifat global.' Ada juga kesenangan sederhana membayangkan kisah di balik barang-barang ini: Apakah penolak poling itu seorang olimpiade? Apakah pemilik gaun pengantin itu tersesat di jalan pulang dari pernikahan? Mengapa begitu banyak tongkat dan kruk ditinggalkan? Staf menyebut bagian ini sebagai 'Departemen Pemulihan Ajaib.' Dan meja perhiasan? Lebih banyak cincin kawin pria yang hilang daripada wanita. Itu cerita lain lagi.

article_content: A 19-year-old man has been charged with the murder of a 10-year-old boy who was fatally shot during a robbery at his parents' nail salon in Miami. Aaron Vu died from his injuries after two armed men burst into the Hong Kong Nail Salon on Northwest 7th Avenue and opened fire, also wounding his 42-year-old father, Hai Vu. Miami-Dade Police arrested and charged Anthawn Ragan Jr. with first-degree murder with a firearm, attempted murder with a firearm, armed robbery with a firearm, and aggravated assault with a firearm. Ragan was apprehended at around 6 a.m. on his 19th birthday at a family member’s home and is being held without bond. He is also accused of battery on a law enforcement officer after allegedly becoming violent during arrest. Surveillance footage captured two intruders — one wearing a mask — entering the salon with firearms at approximately 7:30 p.m. on Friday, stealing purses, cell phones, and an unspecified amount of cash before fleeing in a black Dodge Ram pickup truck. Aaron and his father were transported to Jackson Memorial Hospital, where Aaron was pronounced dead shortly after arrival. Hai Vu is recovering in the hospital. Police are actively searching for a second suspect and have offered a $25,000 reward through Miami-Dade Crime Stoppers for information leading to an arrest. In a statement from the hospital, Hai Vu said: 'Why did this have to happen? Why couldn’t it just have been me? They killed an innocent child.' Hundreds of community members gathered at the salon for a heartfelt tribute to Aaron, leaving flowers, stuffed animals, and notes at a makeshift memorial. Aaron’s fifth-grade classmate, Paul Namphy, described him as funny and outgoing, saying he loved making everyone laugh — even his teachers. Salon employees and neighbors confirmed that Hai and Lynn Vu have operated the popular business for at least five years. Lieutenant Jim Tietz of the Miami-Dade Police urged the public: 'These people need to be caught. If they’ve done it once, they’ll do it again — and anyone could be a victim.' Police have distributed flyers to local businesses and released the surveillance video to aid the investigation.

article_content: Just six months after winning American Idol, David Cook released his self-titled debut album — a deeply personal project shaped by his rock roots and family bonds. The Missouri native, who holds a degree in graphic design, wrote or co-wrote 10 of the album’s 12 tracks and even helped direct its artwork. 'It was a busy summer,' he joked. Cook collaborated with former Soundgarden frontman Chris Cornell on the lead single, 'Light On,' and poured emotional depth into tracks like 'Heroes' — a tribute to his family — and 'A Daily AntheM' and 'Permanent,' which honor his older brother, currently fighting brain cancer. 'A Daily AntheM' was written three years before his Idol audition, during his early days as a grassroots musician. In a candid CNN interview, Cook emphasized his commitment to authenticity: 'I wanted these songs to translate live — to move people, to feel epic, to leave space for something real.' Though 'Light On' debuted at No. 17 on the Billboard charts before dropping to No. 80, Cook remains unfazed. 'I’m not focused on immediate numbers. I want this song to find its people — even if it takes four months.' He dismissed rumors of a feud with runner-up David Archuleta, calling them 'absolute garbage.' 'David is one of the most down-to-earth people I’ve ever met. He doesn’t even seem to realize how big he is.' Cook acknowledged the sudden loss of privacy — 'It’s weird going from anonymity to strangers shoving cameras in your face' — but sees it as a fair trade: 'If this lets me make the music I believe in, I’ll take it.'

'Ini musim panas yang sibuk,' katanya bercanda. Cook berkolaborasi dengan mantan vokalis Soundgarden, Chris Cornell, pada lagu utama 'Light On,' dan menyalurkan kedalaman emosional ke lagu-lagu seperti 'Heroes' — penghormatan kepada keluarganya — serta 'A Daily AntheM' dan 'Permanent,' yang menghormati kakaknya yang sedang berjuang melawan kanker otak. 'A Daily AntheM' ditulis tiga tahun sebelum audisi Idolnya, saat ia masih sebagai musisi jalanan. Dalam wawancara jujur dengan CNN, Cook menekankan komitmennya terhadap keaslian: 'Saya ingin lagu-lagu ini bisa diterjemahkan secara langsung — untuk menggerakkan orang, terasa epik, dan memberi ruang bagi sesuatu yang nyata.' Meskipun 'Light On' debut di posisi No. 17 di tangga lagu Billboard sebelum turun ke No. 80, Cook tetap tenang. 'Saya tidak fokus pada angka segera. Saya ingin lagu ini menemukan orang-orangnya — bahkan jika butuh empat bulan.' Dia menyangkal rumor perseteruan dengan runner-up David Archuleta, menyebutnya 'sampah total.' 'David adalah salah satu orang paling rendah hati yang pernah saya temui. Dia bahkan tampaknya tidak sadar betapa besarnya dirinya.' Cook mengakui hilangnya privasi mendadak — 'Aneh sekali pergi dari ketidakdikenalan ke orang-orang yang mendorong kamera ke wajahmu' — tapi melihatnya sebagai pertukaran yang adil: 'Jika ini memungkinkan saya membuat musik yang saya percayai, saya akan mengambilnya.'

article_content: On New Year’s Eve 2012, veteran actor Steven Berkoff — best known for portraying General Orlov in the James Bond film 'Octopussy' — struck 75-year-old pedestrian Fiona Scully on Oxford Street in central London. As she lay injured on the pavement, Berkoff reportedly jumped from his Volkswagen Beetle and declared, 'I didn’t touch you,' showing no signs of concern or offering help. Scully, who suffered severe bruising and swelling, required hospital treatment and used a walking stick for ten days. She later told the court she was stunned by his cold reaction — no question about her wellbeing, no apology, just dismissal. Witnesses confirmed that Scully had been crossing safely after a car had stopped to let her pass, when Berkoff pulled out to overtake and collided with her. Police later discovered he was driving on an expired California license, invalid in the UK. In court, Berkoff represented himself and claimed Scully had suddenly stepped into the road, insisting his speed and reflexes had prevented a worse outcome. He even suggested she must have been running. The magistrate dismissed his version as inconsistent with the facts. Dr. Andrew Pairmley, chair of the bench, stated Berkoff’s driving fell far below what’s expected of a reasonable driver. He was found guilty of driving without due care and attention, as well as driving without a valid UK license. Berkoff was fined £400, issued three penalty points (to be applied once his UK license is reinstated), ordered to pay £250 in prosecution costs and a £35 victim surcharge. This marks his second driving ban in under a year — he’d previously been suspended for running a red light in February 2013.

Saat ia terbaring terluka di trotoar, Berkoff dikabarkan melompat keluar dari mobil Volkswagen Beetle-nya dan berkata, 'Saya tidak menyentuh Anda,' tanpa menunjukkan kepedulian atau menawarkan bantuan apa pun. Ia kemudian memberi tahu pengadilan bahwa ia terkejut dengan sikap dinginnya — tidak ada pertanyaan tentang kesejahteraannya, tidak ada permintaan maaf, hanya penyangkalan. Saksi mata mengonfirmasi bahwa Scully sedang menyeberang dengan aman setelah mobil lain berhenti untuk membiarkannya lewat, ketika Berkoff mencoba mendahului dan menabraknya. Ia dinyatakan bersalah atas mengemudi tanpa perhatian yang cukup, serta mengemudi tanpa izin mengemudi Inggris yang sah. Ini merupakan larangan mengemudi keduanya dalam waktu kurang dari satu tahun — sebelumnya ia pernah dihukum karena melanggar lampu merah pada Februari 2013.

article_content: With Hurricane Gustav bearing down, New Orleans Mayor Ray Nagin issued a mandatory evacuation order effective Sunday at 8 a.m., urging residents to leave immediately — calling it 'the mother of all storms' and warning that this could be the most dangerous hurricane in decades. As the storm intensified over western Cuba with sustained winds nearing 150 mph, Nagin stressed the urgency: 'You need to be scared. Get your butts moving.' By Saturday, around 10,000 people had already been relocated via buses, trains, and flights, with additional transport running until midnight and resuming at 6 a.m. Sunday. Thousands more fled independently, clogging major highways like I-10, I-55, and I-59 as they headed inland. At the Union Passenger Terminal, hundreds lined up before dawn, some waiting over two hours under the blazing sun. Officials set up 17 pickup points across the city for those without cars, directing them to the terminal for onward travel to shelters. But technical issues and overcrowding caused confusion — prompting Governor Jindal to halt on-site registrations and direct evacuees to sign up once at shelters. The state planned to implement contraflow on interstates starting Sunday morning, converting both lanes to outbound traffic to speed up departures. Meanwhile, Amtrak arranged for over 7,000 seats to evacuate elderly residents, with about 1,500 already headed to Memphis. The airport remained open until Sunday evening, with Delta and AirTran continuing flights until closure. Louisiana Governor Bobby Jindal, while stopping short of a statewide evacuation order, implored everyone to act fast: 'Don’t wait until 8 a.m. — leave now.' He warned that flooding could surpass what was seen during Katrina. Mississippi also began evacuating residents living in mobile homes along its coast. Crucially, officials confirmed there would be no 'shelter of last resort' — unlike in 2005, when the Superdome became a refuge for thousands who stayed. Nagin made it clear: once the storm hits, emergency services won’t be able to reach those who remain. 'We don’t have the resources to rescue you,' he said. As Gustav moved into the Gulf, forecasters predicted a landfall between late Monday and Tuesday as either a Category 3 or 4 storm. Memories of Katrina — which claimed over 1,500 lives in Louisiana alone — loomed large, driving unprecedented compliance with evacuation orders.

Saat badai memperkuat di atas Kuba barat dengan kecepatan angin berkelanjutan mendekati 150 mph, Nagin menekankan urgensi: 'Kamu harus takut. Segera pergi dari sini.' Pada hari Sabtu, sekitar 10.000 orang telah dievakuasi melalui bus, kereta api, dan pesawat, dengan layanan transportasi tambahan berjalan hingga tengah malam dan dimulai kembali pada pukul 06.00 Minggu. Pemerintah negara bagian berencana menerapkan sistem kontraflow di jalan raya mulai Minggu pagi, mengubah kedua lajur menjadi arah keluar saja untuk mempercepat keberangkatan. Sementara itu, Amtrak menyediakan lebih dari 7.000 kursi untuk mengevakuasi warga lansia, dengan sekitar 1.500 orang sudah berangkat ke Memphis. Bandara tetap buka hingga malam Minggu, dengan Delta dan AirTran melanjutkan penerbangan hingga ditutup. Gubernur Louisiana Bobby Jindal, meski tidak mengeluarkan perintah evakuasi wajib tingkat negara bagian, mendesak semua orang untuk bertindak cepat: 'Jangan menunggu sampai pukul 08.00 — pergilah sekarang.' Dia memperingatkan bahwa banjir bisa lebih buruk daripada yang terjadi saat Katrina. Mississippi juga mulai mengevakuasi penduduk yang tinggal di rumah mobil di sepanjang pantainya. Yang sangat penting, pejabat menegaskan tidak akan ada 'tempat perlindungan terakhir' — berbeda dengan tahun 2005, ketika Superdome menjadi tempat penampungan ribuan orang yang tetap tinggal. Nagin menegaskan: begitu badai datang, layanan darurat tidak akan bisa menjangkau mereka yang tetap tinggal. 'Kami tidak punya sumber daya untuk menyelamatkanmu,' katanya. Saat Gustav bergerak ke Teluk Meksiko, para prakira cuaca memprediksi daratan antara akhir Senin dan Selasa sebagai badai Kategori 3 atau 4. Kenangan akan Katrina — yang menewaskan lebih dari 1.500 orang di Louisiana saja — sangat kuat, mendorong kepatuhan tanpa contoh terhadap perintah evakuasi.

article_content: A study analyzing hotel reviews by travelers has produced a list of the world's best cities for accommodation. Surprisingly, some of the most visited cities — including Paris, New York, and London — do not appear in the top 25. Instead, lesser-known destinations such as Gdansk in Poland and Sofia in Bulgaria have risen to the top. Cape Town, South Africa, was named the best city in the world for hotels. The research, conducted by hotel booking platform Agoda.com, analyzed nearly seven million customer reviews to rank destinations based on value for money, location, staff performance, room comfort and cleanliness, and food and dining. Cape Town scored 8.43 out of 10, ranking highest globally in both staff performance and room quality. Zermatt, Switzerland, came in third and earned the highest score for hotel cleanliness and condition. Budapest, Hungary, offered the best value for money and ranked sixth. Bruges, Belgium, topped the food and dining category, while Australia’s Sunshine Coast received the highest rating for location, placing 17th overall. The full top 25 includes: 1. Cape Town, South Africa; 2. Maldives; 3. Zermatt, Switzerland; 4. Queenstown, New Zealand; 5. Seychelles; 6. Budapest, Hungary; 7. Santorini, Greece; 8. Bruges, Belgium; 9. Gdansk, Poland; 10. Hoi An, Vietnam; 11. Sofia, Bulgaria; 12. Crete Island, Greece; 13. Verona, Italy; 14. Rotorua, New Zealand; 15. Khao Lak, Thailand; 16. Hualien, Taiwan; 17. Sunshine Coast, Australia; 18. Edinburgh, Scotland; 19. Cuzco, Peru; 20. Chicago, United States; 21. Kraków, Poland; 22. Nagano, Japan; 23. Durban, South Africa; 24. Granada, Spain; 25. Marrakech, Morocco. Two New Zealand cities (Queenstown and Rotorua) and two Polish cities (Gdansk and Kraków) feature in the top 25. Edinburgh is the only UK city represented, and Chicago is the sole U.S. entry. Agoda.com evaluated all destinations worldwide with over 100 hotels, using reviews submitted by its customers after their stays. Meanwhile, for those considering a staycation in England in 2015, highlights include: the Rugby World Cup (Sept–Oct), the 40th anniversary of the Cricket World Cup (June 7), the first-ever combined Men’s and Women’s Boat Race (April 11), the 800th anniversary of the Magna Carta, and the spring 2015 reopening of Dreamland Margate — a beloved amusement park redesigned by Wayne Hemingway OBE. Other notable events include the 150th anniversary of Alice in Wonderland, the bicentenary of the Battle of Waterloo, and the opening of The Gainsborough Bath Spa and Magic Garden at Hampton Court Palace.

article_content: A shocking video has emerged showing George Simpson, a 41-year-old NJ Transit bus driver, masturbating while driving a fully loaded bus through the Lincoln Tunnel in New York. The incident was recorded just before 8 p.m. on June 24, 2013, by a Manhattan librarian who was a passenger on the bus. She filmed the act on her cell phone, horrified as Simpson used only one hand to steer while exposing himself. The video was later shared publicly, prompting immediate action from NJ Transit. Simpson was removed from duty without pay. He has since been charged with reckless endangerment, lewdness, and risking widespread injury. Patrick Metz, the lawyer for the anonymous passenger who recorded the footage, condemned the behavior: 'The danger he put passengers and other commuters in is unspeakable.' 'This would be an affront to anyone who witnessed it,' Metz told the New York Daily News. A NJ Transit spokesperson, John Durso, confirmed: 'The bus operator in question was immediately removed from service due to this disturbing and grossly irresponsible conduct.' article_content: A man who claimed his wife was killed by a carjacker early Friday morning has been charged with her murder. Ryan Holness, 28, faces charges of first- and second-degree murder in the death of his wife, Serika Dunkley Holness, 26, according to Maryland State Police. Her body was discovered around 6 a.m. Friday in a field in Crumpton, Maryland. Investigators say inconsistencies emerged in Holness’ account of the events, leading to his arrest. Holness told police that he and his wife were carjacked by a man armed with a knife and a gun on the New Jersey Turnpike while returning to Maryland from New York on Thursday night. He claimed the suspect assaulted him, forced him to drive to Crumpton, and bound his hands and feet with duct tape before attacking his wife, who had attempted to flee. Police interviewed witnesses and launched a nationwide search for the suspect and the couple’s 2007 blue Honda Accord. However, details provided by Holness throughout the day Friday did not align with witness statements or physical evidence, authorities said. Shortly after 11 p.m. Friday, a D.C. police officer spotted the missing vehicle on a street in Washington, D.C. Maryland State Police homicide detectives have since taken custody of the car. It remains unclear how the vehicle ended up in the nation’s capital.

article_content: George Carlin was 'the total package of what a comedian's skills could be,' Jerry Seinfeld said Monday during a tribute on 'Larry King Live.' 'He was a brilliant writer and performer,' Seinfeld told CNN's Larry King. 'He could take something mundane — like a couch pillow — and turn it into comedy, or tackle weighty topics like abortion, politics, or religion. There was no subject his mind couldn’t dissect and satirize. He had an incredible range.' Seinfeld called Carlin 'one of the Mount Rushmore figures in our profession.' Carlin, who died of heart failure on Sunday at age 71, was renowned for his sharp observational humor and command of language. His iconic routines contrasted baseball with football, 'maniac' drivers with 'idiots,' and listed 'people I can do without.' He fearlessly used profanity, scatology, and irreverence to expose the absurdities of modern life. His legendary routine 'Seven Words You Can Never Say on Television' sparked a landmark indecency case that reached the U.S. Supreme Court. In November, Carlin was scheduled to receive the 2008 Mark Twain Prize for American Humor from the Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts. 'I think the things he said — and the courage it took to say them — were just breathtaking,' comedian Roseanne Barr told King. 'He didn’t care if he rubbed people the wrong way,' Seinfeld added, crediting Carlin as a major influence. 'I used to love his bit about how audiences laugh at UFO believers, but become reverent when talking about God. Which one is really more absurd?' Bill Maher, known for stirring controversy himself, noted Carlin likely would’ve mocked the posthumous praise: 'I bet if he were here, he’d say, 'Why do people say nice things when you’re dead? That’s stupid — you can’t hear them.' But Maher added, 'For me, there’s nobody higher in comedy. His jokes weren’t just funny — they were profound. Take the jokes away, and you still have a compelling speech.' Though Carlin often appeared angry onstage, friends say he was personally warm. Lewis Black recalled receiving an unexpected call from Carlin when he was a struggling comic. 'He said, 'Listen, Lewis, this is George Carlin. First, let me tell you — I can’t help your career. But I heard your stuff, and you made me laugh. If you ever record anything else, send it to me — my friends like to laugh.' That meant everything to me. It even shut my mother up,' Black said. Carlin’s daughter, Kelly Carlin McCall, called him 'a great dad.' 'People saw his onstage persona — grumpy, cynical — but in person, he was the kindest, most generous man,' she said. The family plans a private memorial this weekend, followed by a public tribute in coming weeks. Carlin’s death shocked those close to him. Though he was in early-stage congestive heart failure, McCall said his health had been 'in a good place.' He had performed in Las Vegas just days before his passing. Seinfeld said he spoke with Carlin shortly after the death of Tim Russert. 'We joked about death — how celebrities seem to die in clusters. Bo Diddley, Russert… now I feel safe for a while,' Carlin reportedly said. Seinfeld marveled at Carlin’s output: 'Fourteen HBO specials — I’ve done two. Few comics do more than three or four. Plus his books. We’ll never see anyone create so much comedy in a lifetime.' Patrick Carlin, George’s brother, described their bond as 'two peas in a pod.' 'He was born hip and never stopped growing,' Patrick said. 'He never forgot the people he loved. He left a beautiful trail across the universe. I’m going to miss him — forever, man.'

'Dia adalah penulis dan pemain brilian,' kata Seinfeld kepada Larry King dari CNN. 'Dia bisa mengambil sesuatu yang biasa — seperti bantal sofa — dan menjadikannya lucu, atau membahas topik berat seperti aborsi, politik, atau agama. Tidak ada topik yang tidak bisa dia analisis dan ejek. Dia punya jangkauan luar biasa.' Seinfeld menyebut Carlin 'salah satu tokoh di Gunung Rushmore di dunia kita.' Carlin, yang meninggal karena gagal jantung pada Minggu di usia 71 tahun, terkenal karena humor observasionalnya yang tajam dan penguasaan bahasa. Rutinitas ikoniknya membandingkan bisbol dengan sepak bola, pengemudi 'gila' dengan 'bodoh,' dan membuat daftar 'orang-orang yang saya tidak suka.' Dia tanpa ragu menggunakan bahasa kasar, tema tubuh, dan sikap tak terhormat untuk mengekspos absurditas kehidupan modern. Rutinitas legendarisnya 'Tujuh Kata yang Tak Boleh Diucapkan di Televisi' memicu kasus pelanggaran indeks yang mencapai Mahkamah Agung AS. Pada bulan November, Carlin dijadwalkan menerima Penghargaan Mark Twain untuk Humor Amerika 2008 dari Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts. 'Saya pikir hal-hal yang dia katakan — dan keberanian yang dibutuhkan untuk mengatakannya — benar-benar menakjubkan,' kata komedian Roseanne Barr kepada King. 'Dia tidak peduli jika membuat orang kesal,' tambah Seinfeld, yang mengakui Carlin sebagai pengaruh besar. 'Saya dulu suka rutinitasnya tentang bagaimana penonton tertawa saat orang-orang UFO muncul di TV, tapi menjadi sangat hormat saat bicara tentang Tuhan. Mana yang lebih absurd?' Bill Maher, yang dikenal sering memicu kontroversi, mencatat Carlin kemungkinan akan menertawakan pujian pasca-kematian: 'Saya yakin jika dia ada di sini sekarang, dia akan berkata, 'Mengapa orang-orang bilang hal-hal bagus setelah kamu mati? Itu hal paling bodoh. Mereka tidak bisa mendengarmu, kan?' Tapi Maher menambahkan, 'Bagi saya, tidak ada yang lebih tinggi di panteon komedi. Lepaskan saja leluconnya, dan Anda masih punya pidato yang sangat menarik.' Meskipun Carlin sering tampak marah di atas panggung, teman-temannya mengatakan dia pribadi hangat. Lewis Black mengingat menerima panggilan tak terduga dari Carlin saat dia masih komedian muda. 'Dia bilang, 'Hai, Lewis, ini George Carlin. Pertama-tama, biarkan saya katakan — saya tidak bisa bantu kariermu. Tapi saya dengar karyamu, dan kamu bikin saya tertawa. Kalau kamu rekam sesuatu lagi, kirim ke saya — teman-teman saya suka tertawa.' Itu sangat berarti buat saya. Bahkan membuat ibu saya diam,' kata Black. Putri Carlin, Kelly Carlin McCall, menyebut ayahnya 'ayah yang hebat.' 'Orang-orang melihat persona panggungnya — kesal, sinis — tapi secara pribadi, dia orang yang paling baik dan murah hati,' katanya. Keluarga merencanakan peringatan pribadi akhir pekan ini, diikuti oleh acara publik dalam beberapa minggu. Kematian Carlin mengejutkan orang-orang dekatnya. Meski dia dalam tahap awal gagal jantung kongestif, McCall mengatakan kesehatannya 'dalam kondisi baik.' Dia baru saja tampil di Las Vegas beberapa hari sebelum meninggal. Seinfeld mengatakan dia berbicara dengan Carlin tak lama setelah kematian Tim Russert. 'Kami bercanda tentang kematian — bagaimana selebritas seolah mati berkelompok. Bo Diddley, Russert... sekarang saya merasa aman untuk sementara waktu,' kata Carlin. Seinfeld kagum pada produksi Carlin: 'Empat belas spesial HBO — saya hanya dua. Sedikit komedian yang melakukan lebih dari tiga atau empat. Ditambah buku-bukunya. Kita tidak akan pernah melihat orang yang menciptakan begitu banyak komedi sepanjang hidupnya.' Patrick Carlin, saudara laki-laki George, menggambarkan hubungan mereka sebagai 'dua kacang dalam satu polong.' 'Dia lahir keren dan tidak pernah berhenti berkembang,' kata Patrick. 'Dia tidak pernah melupakan orang-orang yang dicintainya. Dia meninggalkan jejak indah di alam semesta. Saya akan merindukannya — selamanya, bro.'

article_content: Japanese writer and director Hideo Nakata has been hailed as a modern master of macabre. Though he did not begin his career aiming to make horror films, his 1998 film 'Ringu'—adapted from the novel by Koji Suzuki, often compared to Japan’s Stephen King—redefined the horror genre, catapulted Nakata into international fame, and soon drew interest from Hollywood. Born in Okayama, Japan, in 1961, Nakata studied journalism at the University of Tokyo. After graduation, he joined Nikkatsu Studios—the same studio where legendary director Akira Kurosawa began his career. It was at Nikkatsu that he met Hiroshi Takahashi, the screenwriter of 'Ringu'. 'Ringu,' an international hit, centers on a cursed videotape that kills anyone who watches it. Released at a time when mainstream Western horror relied heavily on graphic violence to shock audiences, Nakata’s film stood apart with its artful direction and pervasive sense of dread. Instead of blood-soaked slashers, viewers encountered slow-burning terror rooted in silence, suggestion, and psychological unease. Western audiences expecting teenage victims in a flurry of gore were confronted with something far more unsettling. For Hollywood producers, Nakata became a goldmine of remake potential. When it was announced that Naomi Watts would star in a Hollywood adaptation of 'Ringu,' many fans feared the original’s haunting essence would be lost. Yet Nakata himself was entrusted with directing the sequel, 'The Ring 2,' in 2005. The franchise’s success led to a third installment, set for release in 2009, which Nakata also directed. Rejecting CGI monsters and buckets of fake blood, Nakata’s films—including 'Dark Water,' also remade by Hollywood in 2005—rely on fleeting, abstract imagery: a distorted reflection in a TV screen, an inexplicably spreading water stain—to amplify fear. Critics and fans have drawn parallels between his atmospheric tension and the works of Roman Polanski, particularly 'Rosemary’s Baby' and 'The Tenant'. Nakata has been credited with introducing global audiences to Asian horror through a subtler, more cerebral approach to fear. He shares insights into his craft in an upcoming interview with Anjali Rao on Talk Asia.

article_content: KFAR CHABAD, Israel (CNN) — Thousands of mourners and emissaries from the ultra-Orthodox Jewish Chabad movement gathered in an Israeli village on Tuesday for the funerals of two individuals killed in the Mumbai terrorist attacks. Israeli girls mourned Rabbi Gavriel Holtzberg and his wife, Rivkah, who were slain during the attacks in Mumbai. A deep sense of grief and anger permeated the funeral in Kfar Chabad, a village of about 900 families just outside Tel Aviv. Speakers at the service stated that the attackers deliberately targeted the Chabad House in Mumbai because of the victims’ faith. The two individuals laid to rest were Rabbi Gavriel Holtzberg and his wife, Rivkah — directors of the Chabad House in Mumbai, which functioned as both a home and a Jewish community center open to anyone seeking prayer, kosher meals, or holiday observance. Three former Israeli prime ministers attended the funeral: Ehud Barak, now defense minister; Shimon Peres, then president of Israel; and Benjamin Netanyahu, leader of the Likud Party. After the ceremony, the Holtzbergs were buried on the Mount of Olives in Jerusalem. Earlier, Rabbi Leibish Teitelbaum, a kosher supervisor from New York, had been interred there as well. Separate funerals were held for Teitelbaum, Rabbi Bentzion Kruman — another kosher supervisor — Israeli grandmother Yocheved Orpaz, and Mexican citizen Norma Shvarzblat Rabinovich. The building, known as the Nariman House, served as the local headquarters of the Chabad community, a Hasidic Jewish movement. The Holtzbergs had two children. One, a 2-year-old boy named Moshe, was in the house when terrorists stormed in. A woman who worked as a nanny and cook managed to escape with him. The couple’s other surviving son was not in Mumbai at the time, according to Rabbi Yehuda Krinsky, chairman of the educational and social services arms of the Chabad-Lubavitch movement. That child suffers from Tay-Sachs, a fatal genetic disorder, according to The Associated Press. In an emotional moment before departing India for Israel on Monday, Moshe repeatedly cried for his mother during a memorial service at a Mumbai synagogue. His cries were replayed extensively on Israeli television. 'You don’t have a mother who will hug you and kiss you,' Rabbi Kotlarsky said, adding that the community would raise the boy. 'You are the child of all of Israel,' he told the toddler, according to AP. The Holtzbergs’ other surviving son, also affected by Tay-Sachs, lives in an institution in Israel. Their eldest son previously died from the same disease. The Holtzbergs moved to Mumbai five years ago to serve the city’s small Jewish population and the thousands of Israeli visitors and businesspeople who travel there, according to Chabad.org. About 5,000 Jews live in India, with roughly 3,000 residing in Mumbai, according to The Jewish Press. The Holtzbergs operated a synagogue, taught Torah classes, and officiated weddings for local Jewish couples. Gavriel Holtzberg, 29, was born in Israel and moved to Brooklyn, New York, at age nine. He studied in New York and Argentina and traveled to Thailand and China as a rabbinical student. His wife, Rivkah, 28, was a native of Israel. In Mumbai, they ran the Nariman House, which welcomed all seeking spiritual or communal support. In footage filmed two years prior, Gavriel said visitors were always welcome. Rivkah noted that hosting 30 guests for dinner was common. The Chabad-Lubavitch movement was founded over two centuries ago in Russia. Today, it claims 4,000 full-time emissary families managing more than 3,300 centers worldwide. Kruman was in India assisting Teitelbaum in supervising a mushroom packing plant under kosher certification. A native of Israel, he had visited China monthly over the past year to oversee food packaging facilities and survived the May 12, 2008 earthquake in Sichuan Province. He leaves behind a widow and three children. CNN's Paula Hancocks contributed to this report. Associated Press also contributed.
translated_content: KFAR CHABAD, Israel (CNN) — Ribuan orang yang berduka dan utusan dari gerakan Yahudi ultra-Orthodoks Chabad berkumpul di sebuah desa Israel pada Selasa untuk pemakaman dua orang yang tewas dalam serangan teroris Mumbai. Gadis-gadis Israel berduka atas Rabbi Gavriel Holtzberg dan istrinya, Rivkah, yang tewas dalam serangan di Mumbai. Suasana duka dan kemarahan menyelimuti pemakaman di Kfar Chabad, sebuah desa dengan sekitar 900 keluarga di luar Tel Aviv. Para pembicara dalam acara tersebut menyatakan bahwa para penyerang sengaja menargetkan Chabad House di Mumbai karena keyakinan korban. Dua orang yang dimakamkan adalah Rabbi Gavriel Holtzberg dan istrinya, Rivkah — direktur Chabad House di Mumbai, yang berfungsi sebagai rumah sekaligus pusat komunitas Yahudi yang terbuka bagi siapa pun yang ingin berdoa, makan makanan halal, atau merayakan hari raya Yahudi. Tiga mantan perdana menteri Israel hadir dalam pemakaman itu: Ehud Barak, kini menteri pertahanan; Shimon Peres, presiden Israel saat itu; dan Benjamin Netanyahu, pemimpin Partai Likud. Setelah upacara, jenazah Holtzberg dimakamkan di Bukit Zaitun di Yerusalem. Sebelumnya, Rabbi Leibish Teitelbaum, seorang pengawas halal dari New York, juga telah dimakamkan di sana. Pemakaman terpisah diadakan untuk Teitelbaum, Rabbi Bentzion Kruman — pengawas halal lainnya — nenek Israel Yocheved Orpaz, dan warga Meksiko Norma Shvarzblat Rabinovich. Bangunan itu, dikenal sebagai Nariman House, menjadi kantor pusat komunitas Chabad, sebuah gerakan Yahudi Hasidik. Holtzberg memiliki dua anak. Salah satunya, seorang bocah laki-laki berusia 2 tahun bernama Moshe, berada di dalam gedung saat para teroris menyerbu. Seorang perempuan yang bekerja sebagai pengasuh dan juru masak berhasil melarikan diri bersamanya. Anak laki-laki lain dari pasangan ini tidak berada di Mumbai saat kejadian, menurut Rabbi Yehuda Krinsky, ketua lembaga pendidikan dan layanan sosial gerakan Chabad-Lubavitch. Anak itu menderita Tay-Sachs, sebuah gangguan genetik mematikan, menurut The Associated Press. Dalam momen emosional sebelum berangkat dari India ke Israel pada Senin, Moshe terus-menerus menangis memanggil ibunya selama upacara peringatan di sebuah sinagoge Mumbai. Tangisan itu diputar ulang secara ekstensif di stasiun televisi Israel. "Kamu tidak punya ibu yang akan memeluk dan menciummu," kata Rabbi Kotlarsky, menambahkan bahwa komunitas akan membesarkan anak itu. "Kamu adalah anak dari seluruh Israel," katanya kepada bayi itu, menurut AP. Anak laki-laki lain yang masih hidup dari keluarga Holtzberg, yang juga menderita Tay-Sachs, tinggal di lembaga di Israel. Anak sulung mereka sebelumnya meninggal akibat penyakit yang sama. Holtzberg pindah ke Mumbai lima tahun lalu untuk melayani komunitas Yahudi kecil di kota itu dan ribuan pengunjung serta pebisnis Israel yang sering datang ke wilayah itu, menurut Chabad.org. Sekitar 5.000 orang Yahudi tinggal di India, dengan sekitar 3.000 di antaranya tinggal di Mumbai, menurut The Jewish Press. Holtzberg mengelola sebuah sinagoge, mengajar kelas Taurat, dan memimpin pernikahan bagi pasangan Yahudi lokal. Gavriel Holtzberg, 29 tahun, lahir di Israel dan pindah ke Brooklyn, New York, saat berusia sembilan tahun. Ia belajar di New York dan Argentina serta melakukan perjalanan ke Thailand dan Tiongkok sebagai mahasiswa rabi. Istrinya, Rivkah, 28 tahun, adalah asli Israel. Di Mumbai, mereka mengelola Nariman House, yang menerima semua orang yang mencari dukungan spiritual atau komunal. Dalam rekaman yang dibuat dua tahun sebelumnya, Gavriel mengatakan semua pengunjung diterima. Rivkah mencatat bahwa mengundang 30 tamu untuk makan malam bukan hal langka. Gerakan Chabad-Lubavitch didirikan lebih dari dua abad lalu di Rusia. article_content: Under the blazing sun in the small Austrian town of Bad Wimsbach, Ronny Deila’s first match as Celtic’s new manager began with a flourish — a 70-second goal by striker Anthony Stokes. It was a promising start to his tenure, though Deila knows the real tests lie ahead. The intimate Hofmaninger Stadion, packed with just 200 fans, offered a stark contrast to the grand stages of the Champions League that Celtic hopes to reach this season. Yet it was here that Deila launched his preparation for the crucial qualifiers against KR Reykjavik in just 11 days. Fielding an entirely different lineup in each half, Deila used the match to evaluate his squad. His first goal came from a slick build-up: Mikael Lustig delivered a precise cross from the right, allowing Stokes to outpace the defense and slot home calmly past the goalkeeper. Krasnodar, who finished fifth in Russia’s top division last season, responded with a well-worked equalizer after 19 minutes, capitalizing on a poor pass from Kris Commons that left Charlie Mulgrew exposed. Odil Akhmedov pounced and beat keeper Lukasz Zaluska. Before halftime, Celtic regained the lead thanks to Stefan Johansen, who seized on a defensive mix-up to fire home. At the break, Deila made sweeping changes, introducing youth and experienced players alike — including Adam Matthews, Beram Kayal, and Leigh Griffiths. Five minutes into the second half, 20-year-old Callum McGregor — fresh off a successful loan at Notts County — sealed the win with a composed side-foot finish from a Matthews cross. Despite Krasnodar’s late pressure, substitute goalkeeper Leo Fasan made several critical stops to preserve the 3-1 victory. Deila remained composed throughout, even as temperatures soared. 'I didn’t feel any nerves,' Deila said afterward. 'We gave away dangerous chances, but the attitude was excellent. The young lads showed promise. We’re at the beginning of something.' He acknowledged the result may have flattered Celtic — 'We didn't deserve to win,' he admitted — but praised the team’s resilience and the potential within the squad. 'There are good players here. In a year, you’ll see a different picture.' Next up: a clash with Rapid Vienna on Sunday, as Celtic continue their four-match tour of Austria.

Ini awal yang menjanjikan bagi masa jabatannya, meskipun Deila tahu ujian sebenarnya masih di depan. Stadion Hofmaninger yang kecil, dipenuhi sekitar 200 penonton, sangat berbeda dengan panggung megah Liga Champions yang diharapkan Celtic capai musim ini. Namun di sinilah Deila memulai persiapan untuk kualifikasi penting melawan KR Reykjavik dalam waktu 11 hari lagi. Dengan memasang susunan pemain yang sama sekali berbeda di setiap babak, Deila memanfaatkan pertandingan ini untuk mengevaluasi skuadnya. Gol pertamanya datang dari serangan apik: Mikael Lustig mengirim umpan silang tepat dari sisi kanan, membiarkan Stokes melewati pertahanan lawan dan menyelesaikan tendangannya dengan tenang. Krasnodar, yang finis kelima di liga Rusia musim lalu, merespons dengan gol penyama kedudukan yang cermat setelah 19 menit, memanfaatkan umpan buruk dari Kris Commons yang membuat Charlie Mulgrew terlambat bereaksi. Odil Akhmedov memanfaatkan peluang itu dan mengalahkan kiper Lukasz Zaluska. Sebelum jeda, Celtic kembali unggul berkat Stefan Johansen, yang memanfaatkan kekeliruan pertahanan untuk melepaskan tembakan akurat. Saat istirahat, Deila melakukan pergantian besar-besaran, memperkenalkan pemain muda dan pemain berpengalaman seperti Adam Matthews, Beram Kayal, dan Leigh Griffiths. Lima menit setelah babak kedua dimulai, Callum McGregor, 20 tahun, yang baru saja menyelesaikan masa pinjaman sukses di Notts County, mengamankan kemenangan dengan tendangan sisi yang apik dari umpan Matthews. Meskipun Krasnodar semakin menekan di babak kedua, kiper pengganti Leo Fasan membuat beberapa penyelamatan krusial untuk menjaga skor 3-1. Deila tetap tenang sepanjang pertandingan, bahkan saat suhu sangat panas. 'Saya tidak gugup,' kata Deila setelah pertandingan. 'Kami memberi lawan banyak peluang berbahaya, tapi sikap pemain luar biasa. Para pemain muda menunjukkan potensi. Kami baru di awal perjalanan ini.' Dia mengakui hasil ini mungkin terlalu memihak Celtic — 'Kami tidak pantas menang,' akunya — tetapi memuji ketahanan tim dan potensi yang dimiliki skuad. 'Ada banyak pemain bagus di sini. Dalam satu tahun, Anda akan melihat gambaran yang berbeda.' Langkah selanjutnya: laga melawan Rapid Vienna pada Minggu, saat Celtic melanjutkan tur empat pertandingan mereka di Austria.

article_content: (CNN) — Spanish and European champions Barcelona took a break from their preparations for the FIFA Club World Cup semifinals to meet children displaced by Japan’s devastating 2011 tsunami. The club, which defeated archrivals Real Madrid 3-1 on Saturday, is in Japan for the tournament and faces Qatari side Al Sadd in their semifinal on Thursday. Before a training session in Yokohama, Barcelona’s stars—including FIFA World Player of the Year Lionel Messi—met 11 children who previously lived near the Fukushima nuclear power plant, devastated by the March 2011 earthquake and tsunami that killed an estimated 15,000 people. Many of the children, aged nine to 18, lost family members in the disaster and now reside in a Tokyo school. Each child received a personalized Barcelona jersey bearing their name on the back. Barcelona won the Club World Cup in 2009, and defender Gerard Piqué urged his teammates to seize the opportunity to become the best club team in the world for a second time. 'We can’t miss out on chances like this,' the former Manchester United player told the club’s official website. 'We haven’t yet adjusted to the time difference or recovered from our long journey. We trained harder today, and tomorrow we’ll train even harder.' Piqué said Saturday’s 3-1 victory over Real Madrid in the famed 'El Clasico'—which lifted Pep Guardiola’s side to the top of Spain’s La Liga—had boosted the team’s confidence. 'We’re very happy with our performance and result. We left feeling we’re on the right track. The team knew we could win there.' For Al Sadd, the winners of the Asian Champions League, facing Barcelona is a reward for their controversial quarterfinal win over Tunisian side Esperance, which was marred by crowd disturbances. Defender Nadir Belhadj, who previously played for French club Lyon, said the team is eager to test themselves against the world’s best. 'We should treat this match as a celebration,' he told FIFA’s official website. 'We’ll be well prepared to give a strong performance, but our main goal is to enjoy it. We’ll need to stick together.' 'This Barcelona side is the best in the world—as we saw again in their impressive El Clasico win over Real Madrid,' Belhadj added. He admitted Al Sadd must be at their absolute best to contain Argentine striker Messi, who has scored 17 league goals in 16 matches this season. 'Lionel Messi and Barcelona are on another planet. We’ll use the resources we have and rely on a group that’s already achieved great things. Just facing Barcelona is incredibly satisfying. You can predict what Messi will do—but actually stopping him? That’s another challenge altogether.'

Klub yang mengalahkan rival abadi mereka, Real Madrid, 3-1 pada Sabtu ini berada di Jepang untuk turnamen tersebut dan akan menghadapi tim Qatar, Al Sadd, di semifinal pada Kamis. Sebelum sesi latihan di Yokohama, para bintang Barcelona—termasuk Pemain Terbaik Dunia FIFA Lionel Messi—bertemu 11 anak yang sebelumnya tinggal dekat Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Nuklir Fukushima, yang hancur akibat gempa dan tsunami Maret 2011 yang menewaskan sekitar 15.000 orang. Banyak dari anak-anak berusia sembilan hingga 18 tahun itu kehilangan anggota keluarga dalam bencana tersebut dan kini tinggal di sebuah sekolah di Tokyo. Setiap anak menerima jersey Barcelona pribadi dengan nama mereka di belakangnya. Barcelona memenangkan Piala Dunia Antarklub pada 2009, dan bek Gerard Piqué mendesak rekan-rekannya untuk memanfaatkan kesempatan menjadi tim klub terbaik di dunia untuk kedua kalinya. 'Kita tidak bisa melewatkan kesempatan seperti ini,' kata mantan pemain Manchester United itu di situs resmi klub. 'Kami belum sepenuhnya menyesuaikan diri dengan perbedaan waktu atau pulih dari perjalanan panjang. Kami berlatih lebih keras hari ini, dan besok kami akan berlatih lebih keras lagi.' Piqué mengatakan kemenangan 3-1 atas Real Madrid dalam laga legendaris 'El Clasico'—yang mengantarkan tim asuhan Pep Guardiola ke puncak La Liga Spanyol—telah meningkatkan kepercayaan diri tim. 'Kami sangat senang dengan performa dan hasil kami. Kami pergi dengan perasaan bahwa kami berada di jalur yang tepat. Tim tahu kami mampu menang di sana.' Bagi Al Sadd, juara Liga Champion Asia, menghadapi Barcelona adalah imbalan atas kemenangan kontroversial mereka atas tim Tunisia, Esperance, di babak perempat final yang disertai kerusuhan penonton. Bek Nadir Belhadj, yang sebelumnya bermain untuk klub Prancis Lyon, mengatakan timnya antusias menguji kemampuan mereka melawan yang terbaik di dunia. 'Kami harus memperlakukan pertandingan ini sebagai sebuah perayaan,' katanya di situs resmi FIFA. 'Kami akan siap memberikan performa terbaik, tetapi tujuan utama kami adalah menikmatinya. Kami harus saling bersatu.' 'Tim Barcelona ini adalah yang terbaik di dunia—seperti yang kita lihat lagi dalam kemenangan impresif mereka atas Real Madrid dalam El Clasico,' tambah Belhadj. Ia mengakui Al Sadd harus berada di puncak performa terbaik untuk menahan ancaman striker Argentina Messi, yang telah mencetak 17 gol dalam 16 pertandingan liga musim ini. 'Lionel Messi dan Barcelona berada di level lain. Kami akan memanfaatkan sumber daya yang ada dan bergantung pada sekelompok pemain yang sudah membawa kami meraih pencapaian besar. Hanya menghadapi Barcelona saja sudah sangat memuaskan. Anda bisa menebak apa yang akan dilakukan Messi—tetapi benar-benar menghentikannya? Itu tantangan lain sama sekali.'

article_content: Scientists have found that Earth’s North Pole is drifting faster and in a new direction — and climate change is the main culprit. While the planet has always experienced a natural wobble known as the Chandler wobble, discovered in 1891 by astronomer Seth Carlo Chandler, recent shifts since 2005 are far more dramatic. That year, the pole abruptly changed course, moving eastward toward Greenland instead of its previous south-southeast path toward Canada. Over the next two decades, it traveled roughly 1.2 meters in this new direction. Using data from NASA’s GRACE satellites, researchers at the University of Texas determined that 90% of this shift stems from melting ice. Greenland alone is shedding about 250 billion tonnes of ice each year, Antarctica loses 180 billion tonnes, and mountain glaciers add another 194 billion tonnes. As this ice melts, water flows into oceans, redistributing Earth’s mass and subtly altering its rotation — much like how a spinning top wobbles when weight shifts. This redistribution doesn’t just affect the poles — it changes the planet’s gravitational balance. The team found that these mass changes matched the pole’s movement almost perfectly. Their discovery offers a novel way to track ice loss: by simply observing where the North Pole moves. The Chandler wobble still exists — causing the pole to wander up to 30 feet over 14 months — but it’s separate from the recent acceleration. Scientists now believe human-driven global warming is overriding the natural rhythm, pushing the pole farther and faster than ever recorded. The findings, presented at the American Geophysical Union, highlight how deeply interconnected our climate system is with even the most fundamental aspects of Earth’s behavior.

Pada tahun itu, kutub berubah arah secara mendadak, bergerak ke timur menuju Greenland alih-alih jalur sebelumnya ke tenggara menuju Kanada. Dalam dua dekade berikutnya, ia berpindah sejauh sekitar 1,2 meter ke arah baru ini. Menggunakan data dari satelit GRACE NASA, para peneliti di Universitas Texas menentukan bahwa 90% pergeseran ini berasal dari pencairan es. Greenland saja kehilangan sekitar 250 miliar ton es setiap tahun, Antartika kehilangan 180 miliar ton, dan gletser pegunungan menambahkan lagi 194 miliar ton. Ketika es ini mencair, air mengalir ke lautan, mendistribusikan ulang massa Bumi dan secara halus mengubah rotasinya — mirip seperti bagaimana atas yang berputar bergoyang ketika bobotnya berpindah. Distribusi ulang ini tidak hanya memengaruhi kutub — tetapi juga mengubah keseimbangan gravitasi planet ini. Tim menemukan bahwa perubahan massa ini hampir sempurna sesuai dengan pergerakan kutub. Penemuan ini menawarkan cara baru untuk melacak kehilangan es: cukup dengan mengamati ke mana Kutub Utara bergerak. Guncangan Chandler masih ada — menyebabkan kutub bergerak hingga 30 kaki dalam periode 14 bulan — tetapi ini terpisah dari percepatan terbaru. Para ilmuwan percaya bahwa pemanasan global akibat aktivitas manusia sedang mengalahkan irama alami, mendorong kutub lebih jauh dan lebih cepat daripada yang pernah tercatat. Temuan ini, yang disajikan di American Geophysical Union, menyoroti betapa eratnya keterkaitan sistem iklim kita dengan aspek paling mendasar dari perilaku Bumi.

article_content: The allegations against Revlon’s CEO, Lorenzo Delpani, are deeply troubling — yet on Twitter, some users are turning the scandal into dark comedy. According to the New York Post, former company scientist Alan Meyers has filed a lawsuit claiming Delpani made derogatory remarks about Jews, Black individuals, and Americans. Meyers alleges Delpani claimed he could 'smell a Black person when they walked into a room,' asserted that 'Jews stick together,' and described Americans as 'small-minded' and 'dirty.' Revlon has pushed back, calling the lawsuit a retaliation tactic from a disgruntled former employee. The company stated Meyers was terminated due to repeated poor judgment and failure to meet performance standards. Revlon Chairman Ronald O. Perelman publicly defended Delpani, saying he's one of the least prejudiced people he’s ever met. Meanwhile, social media has exploded with satirical takes. Hashtag #ShadesofRevlon went viral, with users inventing absurd product names like 'Dirty Americans Perfume,' 'Black Room Cologne,' and 'Yiddish Smell of Success.' One user joked about 'Malcolm X-foliating cream.' The backlash has been sharp: a Twitter user named The Kitchenista summed it up plainly: 'Not ever.' Many feel the company won’t easily win back trust — especially among those who see the jokes as more than just humor.

article_content: Jerusalem (CNN) — Israeli Foreign Minister Avigdor Liberman announced on Friday that he would resign from his post, one day after the Ministry of Justice revealed it would charge him with breach of trust and fraud. In a statement, Liberman said he must step down 'in light of the circumstances of the case and the details of the indictment.' He maintained that he has 'not violated any laws.' His resignation comes five weeks before Israel’s parliamentary elections, scheduled for January 22. Initially, after the charges were announced, Liberman said he intended to remain in office. But within 24 hours, he reversed his decision after consulting with legal and campaign advisers. A major figure in Israel’s current political landscape, Liberman recently formed a coalition with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his Likud party. Yet his statement suggested he hopes to resolve the legal matter before the election. 'I am doing this because I believe the citizens of Israel deserve to vote after this issue is legally resolved — so that a judicial ruling is reached before the elections,' he said. 'This will allow me to continue serving the state and its people as part of a strong, unified leadership capable of addressing Israel’s security, diplomatic, and economic challenges.' Liberman’s party, Yisrael Beiteinu, confirmed he will remain on the ballot for the upcoming elections. The charges relate to a 2009 incident in which prosecutors allege Liberman pressured the Israeli ambassador to Belarus to be reassigned after the diplomat reportedly leaked confidential information tied to a police investigation involving Liberman. However, Attorney General Yehuda Weinstein announced Thursday that Liberman would not face more serious charges — such as money laundering or witness tampering — due to insufficient evidence. This decision effectively closes a decade-long investigation that once involved alleged transfers of hundreds of millions of dollars through foreign businessmen to companies owned by Liberman during his time as a Knesset member and minister. Liberman has consistently denied all allegations. 'I have always operated according to the law and have no reason to worry,' he said last year. He has faced international criticism for his hard-line views toward Israel’s Arab minority populations. His ultra-nationalist party, the second-largest in the governing coalition, enjoys strong support among immigrants from the former Soviet Union, where Liberman was born and raised. CNN’s Pierre Meilhan and Laura Smith-Spark contributed to this report.
translated_content: Yerusalem (CNN) — Menteri Luar Negeri Israel Avigdor Liberman mengumumkan pada hari Jumat bahwa ia akan mengundurkan diri dari jabatannya, satu hari setelah Kementerian Kehakiman mengungkapkan rencana menuduhnya atas pelanggaran kepercayaan dan penipuan. Dalam sebuah pernyataan, Liberman mengatakan ia harus mundur 'mengingat keadaan kasus ini dan rincian dakwaan.' Ia menegaskan bahwa ia 'tidak melanggar hukum apa pun.' Pengunduran dirinya datang lima minggu sebelum pemilihan parlemen Israel yang dijadwalkan pada 22 Januari. Awalnya, setelah dakwaan diumumkan, Liberman menyatakan berniat tetap bertahan di jabatan. Namun dalam waktu kurang dari 24 jam, ia berubah pikiran setelah berkonsultasi dengan penasihat hukum dan tim kampanyenya. Tokoh utama dalam peta politik Israel saat ini, Liberman baru-baru ini membentuk koalisi dengan Perdana Menteri Benjamin Netanyahu dan partainya, Likud. Namun pernyataannya menyiratkan ia berharap dapat menyelesaikan masalah hukum sebelum pemilu. 'Saya melakukan ini karena saya percaya warga Israel berhak memilih setelah masalah ini diselesaikan secara hukum — sehingga putusan pengadilan dicapai sebelum pemilu,' katanya. 'Dengan demikian, saya dapat terus melayani negara dan rakyatnya sebagai bagian dari kepemimpinan yang kuat dan bersatu yang mampu mengatasi tantangan keamanan, diplomasi, dan ekonomi Israel.' Partai Liberman, Yisrael Beiteinu, mengonfirmasi bahwa ia akan tetap maju sebagai calon dalam pemilu mendatang. Dakwaan tersebut terkait insiden tahun 2009 di mana jaksa menuduh Liberman mendesak duta besar Israel di Belarus untuk dipindahkan setelah duta tersebut diduga mengungkap informasi rahasia terkait penyelidikan polisi yang melibatkan Liberman. Namun, Jaksa Agung Yehuda Weinstein mengumumkan pada hari Kamis bahwa Liberman tidak akan menghadapi tuduhan lebih serius — seperti pencucian uang atau mengintimidasi saksi — karena bukti yang tidak mencukupi. Keputusan ini secara efektif menutup penyelidikan selama lebih dari satu dekade yang dulunya melibatkan dugaan transfer ratusan juta dolar melalui pengusaha asing ke perusahaan yang dimiliki Liberman selama masa jabatannya sebagai anggota Knesset dan menteri. Liberman secara konsisten membantah semua tuduhan. 'Saya selalu bertindak sesuai hukum dan tidak punya alasan untuk khawatir,' katanya tahun lalu. Ia telah menghadapi kritik internasional atas pandangan kerasnya terhadap populasi minoritas Arab di Israel. Partai ultra-nasionalisnya, yang merupakan partai terbesar kedua dalam koalisi pemerintah, sangat populer di kalangan imigran dari bekas Uni Soviet, tempat Liberman dilahirkan dan dibesarkan. article_content: Former First Lady Barbara Bush has been discharged from Methodist Hospital in Houston after being treated for a respiratory infection. Admitted on Monday, she returned home on Saturday, her family spokesperson Jim McGrath confirmed. Now recovering, the 88-year-old matriarch has endured multiple serious health episodes in recent years: surgery for a perforated ulcer in 2008, heart valve repair in 2009, and a recurrence of Graves’ disease in 2010. Her husband, former President George H.W. Bush, 89, has also faced ongoing health struggles — he spent nearly two months at the same hospital in early 2013 battling a persistent bronchitis-related cough and has since largely withdrawn from public life. Despite these challenges, the couple continues to be admired for their remarkable 69-year marriage, with their anniversary approaching on January 6. President Barack Obama and former President Bill Clinton extended warm wishes for her recovery, messages that were acknowledged by the Bush family through a tweet from McGrath. McGrath had earlier called Barbara Bush 'a national treasure' — a tribute that resonates deeply with many.

McGrath sebelumnya menyebut Barbara Bush sebagai 'kekayaan nasional' — sebuah penghargaan yang sangat berarti bagi banyak orang.

article_content: Topshop tycoon Sir Philip Green has put the struggling high street retailer BHS up for sale following a sales decline and a pre-tax loss of £69.6 million. The billionaire’s decision to auction the chain—home to more than 185 stores—signals the potential dismantling of one of Britain’s most iconic high street empires. According to filings at Companies House, BHS sales dropped 3.5% to £675.7 million in 2013, while its pre-tax loss stood at £69.6 million. Despite a nearly 1% rise in total group sales to £2.7 billion, BHS continued to lose money, and the Arcadia Group, which includes Topshop, Dorothy Perkins, Miss Selfridge, Wallis, and Burton, did not pay a dividend for the ninth consecutive year. Senior city sources told the Sunday Times that Green had received multiple serious offers in recent months—some reportedly meeting his price expectations—for the first time. Potential bidders include rival retailers like Primark, American hedge fund Apollo, and Hilco, the firm that revived HMV. One proposal even came from a grocery retailer, given that BHS operates 150 stores licensed to sell food. Green acquired BHS—then called British Home Stores—in 2000 for £200 million, turning it into the foundation of his retail empire. He later expanded through the purchase of Arcadia, which brought together over 2,000 UK stores. His most ambitious venture was the £10 billion attempted takeover of Marks & Spencer in 2004, which ultimately failed. In recent years, Green has shifted focus to Topshop, expanding it internationally with seven standalone U.S. stores—including a flagship on New York’s Fifth Avenue—and 52 concessions in Nordstrom. He also partnered with supermodel Kate Moss, whose clothing line significantly elevated Topshop’s fashion profile. Born in Croydon, south London, in 1952 to a Jewish property developer, Green began his career as a shoe warehouse apprentice before launching his own jeans import business at age 23. He now commutes from Monaco via private jet and is known for hosting lavish parties attended by celebrities including Beyoncé, Jennifer Lopez, and George Michael. Green was unavailable for comment.

Menurut laporan di Companies House, penjualan BHS turun 3,5% menjadi £675,7 juta pada tahun 2013, dengan kerugian sebelum pajak mencapai £69,6 juta. Meskipun terjadi kenaikan hampir 1% dalam total penjualan kelompok menjadi £2,7 miliar, BHS terus mengalami kerugian, dan Grup Arcadia, yang mencakup Topshop, Dorothy Perkins, Miss Selfridge, Wallis, dan Burton, tidak membayar dividen selama sembilan tahun berturut-turut. Sumber kota senior mengatakan kepada Sunday Times bahwa Green menerima beberapa tawaran serius dalam beberapa bulan terakhir—beberapa dilaporkan memenuhi harapan harganya—untuk pertama kalinya. Calon pembeli potensial meliputi pesaing seperti Primark, dana hedge Amerika Apollo, dan Hilco, perusahaan yang mengambil alih HMV. Satu tawaran bahkan datang dari retailer grosir, mengingat BHS mengoperasikan 150 toko yang berlisensi menjual makanan. Green mengakuisisi BHS—yang saat itu bernama British Home Stores—pada tahun 2000 senilai £200 juta, menjadikannya fondasi kekaisaran ritelnya. Ia kemudian memperluas bisnisnya melalui pembelian Arcadia, yang menggabungkan lebih dari 2.000 toko di Inggris. Usahanya yang paling ambisius adalah upaya pengambilalihan Marks & Spencer senilai £10 miliar pada tahun 2004, yang akhirnya gagal. Dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, Green beralih fokus ke Topshop, memperluasnya secara internasional dengan tujuh toko mandiri di AS—termasuk flagship di Fifth Avenue, New York—dan 52 konsesi di Nordstrom. Ia juga bermitra dengan supermodel Kate Moss, yang lini pakaian-nya secara signifikan meningkatkan profil Topshop di dunia mode tinggi. Lahir di Croydon, London Selatan, pada tahun 1952 dari seorang pengembang properti Yahudi yang sukses, Green memulai karier sebagai asisten gudang sepatu sebelum mendirikan bisnis impor dan penjualan jins sendiri pada usia 23 tahun. Kini ia bepergian dari Monaco menggunakan jet pribadi dan dikenal karena mengadakan pesta mewah yang dihadiri selebriti seperti Beyoncé, Jennifer Lopez, dan George Michael. Green tidak tersedia untuk berkomentar.

article_content: According to a recent report by Amnesty International, Indian authorities in Jammu and Kashmir have been routinely detaining hundreds of individuals each year without formal charges or trials, using the Public Safety Act (PSA) as a legal shield. The law permits detention for up to two years without judicial review — a practice human rights advocates say undermines basic legal protections. Between 2003 and 2023, Amnesty estimates that between 8,000 and 20,000 people were held under the PSA, with 322 detained during the first nine months of 2023 alone, amid widespread anti-government protests. Among those detained are political leaders, journalists, lawyers, student activists, and even minors — many held in secret, without access to family or legal counsel. Sam Zarifi, Amnesty’s Asia-Pacific director, criticized the system as a 'revolving door,' designed to sideline critics rather than prosecute them fairly. He warned that such detentions increase the risk of abuse, including torture. While the state’s Chief Minister Omar Abdullah disputed these figures, claiming only 28 people remained in custody under the PSA, a senior police official acknowledged around 250 detentions in the past year, with some later released. Critics like Khurram Parvez argue the PSA contradicts India’s own democratic values, allowing indefinite detention based on suspicion alone. The broader context includes decades of unrest in Kashmir, rooted in the region’s contested status since the 1947 partition, with many locals seeking self-determination. India maintains that Pakistan fuels the violence, but human rights groups insist the real issue lies in the erosion of civil liberties under emergency laws like the PSA.
translated_content: Menurut laporan terbaru dari Amnesty International, otoritas India di Jammu dan Kashmir secara rutin menahan ratusan individu setiap tahun tanpa tuduhan resmi atau sidang, menggunakan Undang-Undang Keamanan Publik (PSA) sebagai pelindung hukum. Undang-undang ini memungkinkan penahanan hingga dua tahun tanpa tinjauan yudisial — praktik yang menurut para aktivis hak asasi manusia merusak perlindungan hukum dasar. Antara tahun 2003 dan 2023, Amnesty memperkirakan antara 8.000 hingga 20.000 orang ditahan di bawah PSA, dengan 322 orang ditahan selama sembilan bulan pertama tahun 2023 saja, di tengah protes anti-pemerintah yang meluas. Di antara mereka yang ditahan adalah pemimpin politik, jurnalis, pengacara, aktivis mahasiswa, dan bahkan anak-anak — banyak yang ditahan secara rahasia tanpa akses ke keluarga atau pengacara. Sam Zarifi, direktur Asia-Pasifik Amnesty, mengkritik sistem ini sebagai 'pintu berputar', dirancang untuk menjauhkan kritikus daripada mengadili mereka secara adil. Ia memperingatkan bahwa penahanan semacam itu meningkatkan risiko pelecehan, termasuk penyiksaan. Sementara Menteri Besar negara bagian Omar Abdullah membantah angka-angka tersebut, menyatakan hanya 28 orang yang masih ditahan di bawah PSA, seorang petugas polisi senior mengakui sekitar 250 penahanan dalam setahun terakhir, dengan beberapa di antaranya kemudian dilepaskan. Para kritikus seperti Khurram Parvez berpendapat bahwa PSA bertentangan dengan nilai-nilai demokrasi India, memungkinkan penahanan tanpa batas berdasarkan dugaan belaka. Konteks luasnya mencakup ketidakstabilan berkepanjangan di Kashmir, yang berakar pada status kontroversial wilayah itu sejak pemisahan 1947, dengan banyak penduduk lokal yang menginginkan otonomi. India berpendapat bahwa Pakistan memicu kekerasan, tetapi kelompok hak asasi manusia bersikeras bahwa masalah utama terletak pada melemahnya kebebasan sipil di bawah undang-undang darurat seperti PSA.
