article_content: A retired Army sergeant, Clark Bartholomew, has reached an out-of-court settlement with Burger King after claiming he found two needles in a Triple Stacker sandwich he purchased in 2010 at a franchise located on Schofield Barracks in Honolulu. One needle reportedly pierced his tongue, and the other became lodged in his small intestine, leading to hospitalization. Although the settlement resolves his claims against Burger King and the food service company that supplied the meat, a trial is still scheduled to proceed against the U.S. Army and Air Force Exchange (AAFES), which operates the franchise on the military base. The specific terms of the agreement remain confidential, but Bartholomew’s attorney, Paul Saccoccio, confirmed that the settlement releases Burger King and its supplier from further legal liability. Saccoccio stated the move was made for 'judicial economy'—to streamline the case and focus on the remaining defendant. This is not the first attempt to settle the case. Bartholomew previously faced nearly $8,500 in court sanctions after failing to attend a settlement conference. Government attorneys have argued that since the injury occurred while Bartholomew was on active duty, liability should rest with the military—not Burger King. However, a judge has declined to dismiss the case. Bartholomew, now living in Chantilly, Virginia, and his family will need to return to Hawaii for the upcoming federal trial. Medical professionals who treated him are expected to testify, including details about the nine-day journey of the needle through his body. Bartholomew himself is also expected to testify about his experience.

Satu jarum dilaporkan menembus lidahnya, dan yang lainnya tersangkut di usus kecilnya, menyebabkan ia dirawat di rumah sakit. Meskipun kesepakatan ini menyelesaikan tuntutan terhadap Burger King dan perusahaan penyedia daging, sidang masih dijadwalkan akan berlangsung melawan U.S. Army and Air Force Exchange (AAFES), yang mengelola gerai tersebut di pangkalan militer. Ketentuan spesifik dari kesepakatan tetap rahasia, tetapi pengacara Bartholomew, Paul Saccoccio, memastikan bahwa kesepakatan tersebut melepaskan Burger King dan pemasoknya dari tanggung jawab hukum lebih lanjut. Saccoccio menyatakan langkah ini diambil demi 'ekonomi peradilan'—untuk menyederhanakan kasus dan memfokuskan pada tergugat yang tersisa. Ini bukan upaya pertama untuk menyelesaikan kasus ini. Bartholomew sebelumnya dihukum denda hampir $8.500 karena gagal hadir dalam konferensi penyelesaian. Jaksa pemerintah berpendapat bahwa karena cedera terjadi saat Bartholomew sedang bertugas aktif, tanggung jawab seharusnya berada pada militer—bukan Burger King. Namun, hakim menolak untuk menghentikan kasus ini. Bartholomew, yang kini tinggal di Chantilly, Virginia, dan keluarganya harus kembali ke Hawaii untuk sidang federal mendatang. Para profesional medis yang merawatnya diharapkan bersaksi, termasuk rincian tentang perjalanan sembilan hari satu jarum melalui tubuhnya. Bartholomew sendiri juga diharapkan bersaksi tentang pengalaman yang ia alami.

article_content: King Charles III welcomed South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol and First Lady Kim Keon Hee to the United Kingdom to commemorate 140 years of diplomatic relations between the two nations. On November 22, during a state banquet at Buckingham Palace, the King awarded the K-pop group BLACKPINK honorary MBEs in recognition of their advocacy for the COP26 Summit in Glasgow and their continued support for the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. The evening marked the start of President Yoon’s three-day official visit, attended by over 170 international guests, including Queen Camilla, Prince William, Princess Catherine, Prime Minister Rishi Sunak, and his wife Akshata Murty. In his opening address, King Charles, 75, made a deliberate effort to speak Korean, greeting the guests with: 'Yeong-gug-e osin geos-eul hwan-yeonghabnida' — 'Welcome to Britain.' The King highlighted the profound global impact of Hallyu — the Korean Wave — noting how Korean cinema, music, and television have reshaped the British cultural landscape. He drew parallels between Korean and British cultural icons, stating, 'Korea has matched Danny Boyle with Bong Joon-ho, James Bond with Squid Game, and the Beatles’ 'Let It Be' with BTS’s 'Dynamite.' Charles also praised South Korea’s leadership in renewable energy and climate innovation, particularly commending the younger generation. He specifically honored BLACKPINK — Jennie, Jisoo, Lisa, and Rosé — not only as global superstars but as influential ambassadors for environmental sustainability. The monarch reflected on his previous visits to Korea, including a 1992 trip with the late Princess Diana and a brief encounter with President Yoon at Queen Elizabeth II’s funeral reception. He acknowledged that Yoon’s absence during the Queen’s lying-in-state was widely discussed, noting that logistical challenges, including traffic, may have contributed to the decision. Cultural references extended beyond entertainment: Charles cited the poetry of Yun Dong-ju, a revered Korean writer and resistance figure, quoting his verse: 'While the wind keeps blowing, My feet stand upon a rock. While the river keeps flowing, My feet stand upon a hill.' This poetic tribute underscored Korea’s enduring resilience amid rapid change. BLACKPINK’s historic performances at BST Hyde Park and Coachella — as the first all-female Asian act to headline both — were noted as milestones in global music history. The King also playfully referenced Psy’s 'Gangnam Style,' joking about his own lack of dance skills during his earlier visit to Seoul.

Malam itu menandai dimulainya kunjungan resmi tiga hari Presiden Yoon, yang dihadiri lebih dari 170 tamu internasional, termasuk Ratu Camilla, Pangeran William, Putri Catherine, Perdana Menteri Rishi Sunak, dan istrinya Akshata Murty. Dalam pidato pembukaannya, Raja Charles, 75 tahun, dengan sengaja mencoba berbicara dalam bahasa Korea, menyapa para tamu dengan: 'Yeong-gug-e osin geos-eul hwan-yeonghabnida' — 'Selamat datang di Britania.' Raja menyoroti dampak global yang mendalam dari Hallyu — Gelombang Korea — dengan mencatat bagaimana sinema, musik, dan televisi Korea telah mengubah lanskap budaya Inggris. Ia membandingkan ikon budaya Korea dan Inggris, mengatakan, 'Korea telah menyamakan Danny Boyle dengan Bong Joon-ho, James Bond dengan Squid Game, dan 'Let It Be' dari The Beatles dengan 'Dynamite' milik BTS.' Charles juga memuji kepemimpinan Korea Selatan dalam energi terbarukan dan inovasi iklim, khususnya memuji generasi muda. Ia secara khusus menghormati BLACKPINK — Jennie, Jisoo, Lisa, dan Rosé — bukan hanya sebagai bintang global, tetapi juga sebagai duta yang berpengaruh untuk keberlanjutan lingkungan. Raja merefleksikan kunjungan sebelumnya ke Korea, termasuk perjalanan tahun 1992 bersama Almarhumah Putri Diana dan pertemuan singkat dengan Presiden Yoon di acara pemakaman Ratu Elizabeth II. Ia mengakui bahwa ketidakhadiran Yoon selama persemayaman jenazah Ratu banyak dibahas, dan mencatat bahwa tantangan logistik, termasuk kemacetan, mungkin menjadi penyebabnya. Referensi budaya melampaui hiburan: Charles mengutip puisi Yun Dong-ju, seorang penulis Korea yang dihormati dan tokoh perlawanan, dengan mengutip baitnya: 'Saat angin terus bertiup, kakiku berdiri di atas batu. Saat sungai terus mengalir, kakiku berdiri di atas bukit.' Ucapan puitis ini menekankan ketahanan abadi Korea di tengah perubahan cepat. Penampilan bersejarah BLACKPINK di BST Hyde Park dan Coachella — sebagai kelompok perempuan Asia pertama yang menjadi headliner di kedua acara tersebut — dicatat sebagai tonggak sejarah dalam sejarah musik global. Raja juga secara lucu menyebut lagu 'Gangnam Style' oleh Psy, bercanda tentang kurangnya keterampilan dansanya saat kunjungan sebelumnya ke Seoul.

article_content: CNN) — President Barack Obama took his campaign to New York on Thursday, headlining three back-to-back fundraisers where he emphasized his progressive record, including support for equal rights for same-sex couples. Obama kicked off the evening with a $35,800-per-plate dinner at Daniel, Chef Daniel Boulud’s upscale Upper East Side restaurant. He then traveled several blocks south to the LGBT Leadership Council gala at the Sheraton Hotel in Midtown Manhattan. There, after condemning discrimination based on sexual orientation or gender identity, he drew loud applause when addressing same-sex couples. 'I believe that gay couples deserve the same rights as every couple in this country,' Obama said. Although he had previously opposed same-sex marriage during his 2008 campaign—supporting civil unions instead—he avoided using the word 'marriage' in his remarks. His comments came amid growing frustration among LGBTQ+ advocates who felt Obama had not moved quickly or boldly enough on gay rights—even after helping to repeal the military’s 'Don’t Ask, Don’t Tell' policy. In his speech, Obama acknowledged that meaningful change is rarely swift or easy. 'I did not run for president to do easy things,' he said. 'It was time for us to do hard things—the big things—even if it would take time.' About 600 guests paid $1,250 each to attend the gala, including actress Jane Lynch and host Neil Patrick Harris of 'How I Met Your Mother.' Before the event, the Republican National Committee released a sarcastic email titled 'Legen—Wait for it,' referencing Harris’s popular show and mocking the celebrity-heavy fundraiser. It added: 'Obama heads to the Big Apple for a round of celebrity-studded fundraisers while Americans are desperate for economic leadership.' The third event was a performance of 'Sister Act' at the Broadway Theatre, attended by hundreds—including Whoopi Goldberg—with tickets starting at $100. Earlier Thursday, RNC spokesman Ryan Tronovitch accused Obama of evading accountability for failing economic policies: 'While President Obama tries to escape the pressures of his failed economic policies with a fundraiser in New York, millions remain out of work and are beginning to realize that the only job our president is concerned about is his own.' The Democratic National Committee swiftly rebutted: 'Republicans are getting hammered in their districts across the country for embracing a plan that eliminates Medicare and for offering zero job-creation proposals in the past six months. They’d do better to focus on real solutions instead of cheap political tricks,' said DNC Communications Director Brad Woodhouse. Proceeds from the events will benefit the Obama Victory Fund, which shares funds between Obama’s re-election campaign and the DNC. This marked Obama’s second night of fundraising this week—he also headlined two events in Washington, D.C., on Monday. Vice President Joe Biden led a fundraiser in Chicago on Tuesday. Democratic sources say the Obama Victory Fund aims to raise $60 million by the end of the second quarter, which concludes at month’s end. While many recall Obama raised nearly $750 million in 2008, fewer remember he raised $59 million for his 2008 campaign during the first half of 2007.
translated_content: (CNN) — Presiden Barack Obama datang ke New York pada hari Kamis, memimpin tiga acara penggalangan dana berturut-turut di mana ia menekankan rekam jejak progresifnya, termasuk dukungan terhadap hak-hak setara bagi pasangan sesama jenis. Obama memulai malam itu dengan makan malam seharga $35.800 per piring di restoran Daniel milik koki Daniel Boulud di Upper East Side yang bergengsi. Kemudian ia berpindah beberapa blok ke selatan ke acara gala LGBT Leadership Council di Sheraton Hotel di Midtown Manhattan. Di sana, setelah mengutuk diskriminasi berdasarkan orientasi seksual atau identitas gender, ia mendapat tepuk tangan meriah saat membahas pasangan sesama jenis. 'Saya percaya bahwa pasangan gay berhak atas hak yang sama seperti setiap pasangan di negara ini,' kata Obama. Meskipun sebelumnya ia menentang pernikahan sesama jenis selama kampanye 2008—mendukung serikat sipil alih-alih—ia menghindari menggunakan kata 'pernikahan' dalam pidatonya. Pernyataannya muncul di tengah kekecewaan yang semakin besar dari para aktivis LGBTQ+ yang merasa Obama belum bergerak cukup cepat atau berani dalam mendukung hak-hak gay—bahkan setelah membantu mencabut kebijakan militer 'Jangan Tanya, Jangan Katakan'. Dalam pidatonya, Obama mengakui bahwa perubahan bermakna jarang terjadi cepat atau mudah. 'Saya tidak mencalonkan diri sebagai presiden untuk melakukan hal-hal yang mudah,' katanya. 'Saatnya bagi kita untuk melakukan hal-hal sulit—hal-hal besar—meskipun butuh waktu.' Sekitar 600 tamu membayar $1.250 masing-masing untuk menghadiri gala tersebut, termasuk aktris Jane Lynch dan tuan rumah Neil Patrick Harris dari 'How I Met Your Mother.' Sebelum acara, Komite Nasional Republik merilis email sarkastik berjudul 'Legen—Tunggu sebentar,' yang merujuk pada acara populer Harris dan mengejek acara penggalangan dana yang penuh selebritas. Hasil dari acara-acara tersebut akan digunakan untuk Dana Kemenangan Obama, yang membagi dana antara kampanye pencalonan ulang presiden dan DNC. Ini adalah malam kedua dalam seminggu di mana Obama memimpin acara penggalangan dana—ia juga memimpin dua acara di Washington, D.C., pada hari Senin. article_content: Human colonization of Mars might face an unexpected obstacle: basic biology. Experiments conducted in space reveal that reproduction could be severely disrupted by low gravity and cosmic radiation. In a 1979 Soviet mission, male and female rats sent into orbit refused to mate entirely — a troubling sign for future human missions. Yet other findings suggest sperm may become more motile in zero-G, growing longer tails and swimming faster. Meanwhile, experts warn that prolonged exposure to space radiation could harm reproductive organs. At the American Society for Reproductive Medicine’s annual meeting in Honolulu, Dr. Joseph Tash from the University of Kansas emphasized that testes and ovaries are among the most radiation-sensitive tissues in the human body. Eyes rank second in vulnerability — which helps explain why nearly all astronauts return from space needing corrective lenses. Although Mars remains the most Earth-like planet in our solar system, and figures like Stephen Hawking have envisioned its eventual settlement, practical challenges remain immense. The Dutch company Mars One once proposed sending teams of four on one-way trips every two years starting in 2024, arguing that raising children on Mars would eventually be necessary for a sustainable colony. But they acknowledge that early settlers won’t be able to bring or raise kids due to minimal medical resources and tiny population size. Crucially, no one yet knows whether humans can conceive in Martian gravity, or if a fetus could develop normally under such conditions. Mars One admits this is a critical knowledge gap — and one that must be solved before humanity can truly call Mars home.

Eksperimen yang dilakukan di luar angkasa menunjukkan bahwa reproduksi bisa sangat terganggu oleh gravitasi rendah dan radiasi kosmik. Dalam misi Uni Soviet tahun 1979, tikus jantan dan betina yang dikirim ke orbit sama sekali menolak untuk kawin — sebuah tanda mengkhawatirkan untuk misi manusia di masa depan. Namun, temuan lain menunjukkan bahwa sperma mungkin menjadi lebih motil di nol-gravitasi, tumbuh ekor yang lebih panjang dan berenang lebih cepat. Sementara itu, para ahli memperingatkan bahwa paparan jangka panjang terhadap radiasi luar angkasa dapat merusak organ reproduksi. Pada pertemuan tahunan Masyarakat Amerika untuk Kedokteran Reproduktif di Honolulu, Dr. Joseph Tash dari Universitas Kansas menekankan bahwa testis dan ovarium adalah di antara jaringan paling sensitif terhadap radiasi dalam tubuh manusia. Mata berada di peringkat kedua dalam kerentanan — yang membantu menjelaskan mengapa hampir semua astronot kembali dari luar angkasa membutuhkan kacamata. Meskipun Mars tetap menjadi planet paling mirip Bumi di tata surya kita, dan tokoh-tokoh seperti Stephen Hawking membayangkan pemukimannya suatu hari nanti, tantangan praktis tetap sangat besar. Perusahaan Belanda Mars One pernah mengusulkan mengirim tim empat orang dalam perjalanan satu arah setiap dua tahun mulai tahun 2024, berargumen bahwa membesarkan anak-anak di Mars pada akhirnya diperlukan untuk koloni yang berkelanjutan. Tetapi mereka mengakui bahwa pendatang awal tidak akan bisa membawa atau membesarkan anak karena sumber daya medis yang minim dan ukuran populasi yang sangat kecil. Yang sangat penting, belum ada yang tahu apakah manusia bisa hamil di gravitasi Mars, atau apakah janin bisa berkembang secara normal dalam kondisi tersebut. Mars One mengakui ini adalah kesenjangan pengetahuan yang kritis — dan satu yang harus dipecahkan sebelum umat manusia benar-benar bisa menyebut Mars sebagai rumah.

article_content: Drivers across the U.S. are breathing easier this Memorial Day weekend as gas prices have dipped to an average of $3.71 per gallon — a 23-cent drop from the April peak of $3.94. While consumers celebrate relief at the pump, politicians are still fighting over who deserves credit — or blame — for the swings in fuel costs. Earlier this year, as prices climbed toward projections of $5 or $6 per gallon, Republicans made energy policy a central campaign issue. House Speaker John Boehner warned that rising fuel costs were crushing American families and small businesses. Mitt Romney demanded the firing of top officials at the Energy, Interior, and EPA departments, accusing them of stifling domestic production. Critics also slammed President Obama’s temporary halt to the Keystone XL pipeline, calling it a missed chance to boost jobs and lower prices. Now, with prices falling, the GOP hasn’t backed down. House Majority Leader Eric Cantor visited an offshore oil rig in the Gulf — a symbolic gesture meant to highlight what they see as the administration’s reluctance to expand drilling. Meanwhile, the House Oversight Committee plans hearings next week focused on 'regulations that hinder oil, gas, and coal production.' But Democrats say the GOP’s strategy has lost steam. One senior Senate aide noted that even before prices fell, many Americans saw Republican critiques as politically opportunistic rather than substantive. A late-March CNN/ORC poll found that while 20% of respondents named gas prices as the nation’s top issue, most blamed oil companies — not the White House — for the hikes. Congress and foreign oil producers received nearly equal blame. Experts agree: short-term price shifts are driven by global market dynamics, not U.S. policy. Tom Kloza, a leading oil analyst, explained that recent declines stem from investors overreacting to fears about Iran and Europe’s economy — not from drilling permits or pipeline decisions. He added that meaningful impacts from policy changes, like improved fuel efficiency or offshore drilling, would take five to ten years. CNN’s polling director Keating Holland put it plainly: Americans fear gas shortages more than high prices. The energy crises of the 1970s that hurt presidents were defined by long lines and rationing — not expensive fuel. As long as gas remains available, even at $3.70, most voters won’t see it as a crisis. And as Kloza says, 'Nobody can take credit — and nobody can take blame.'

Sementara konsumen merayakan keringanan di pompa bensin, para politisi masih berdebat tentang siapa yang patut mendapat pujian atau disalahkan atas fluktuasi biaya bahan bakar. Awal tahun ini, saat harga naik menuju proyeksi $5 atau $6 per galon, partai Republik menjadikan kebijakan energi sebagai isu utama kampanye. Ketua DPR John Boehner memperingatkan bahwa biaya bahan bakar yang meningkat menghancurkan keluarga dan usaha kecil Amerika. Mitt Romney menuntut pemecatan pejabat tinggi di Departemen Energi, Dalam Negeri, dan EPA, menuduh mereka menekan produksi domestik. Kritikus juga mengkritik keputusan Presiden Obama untuk menghentikan sementara pipa Keystone XL, menyebutnya sebagai peluang yang terlewat untuk menciptakan lapangan kerja dan menurunkan harga. Sekarang, dengan harga yang turun, GOP tidak mundur. Ketua Mayoritas DPR Eric Cantor mengunjungi rig minyak lepas pantai di Teluk — sebuah gerakan simbolis yang dimaksudkan untuk menyoroti apa yang mereka anggap sebagai ketidaksediaan pemerintah untuk memperluas pengeboran. Sementara itu, Komite Pengawasan DPR berencana mengadakan sidang minggu depan yang berfokus pada 'aturan yang menghambat produksi minyak, gas, dan batu bara.' Namun, para Demokrat mengatakan strategi GOP telah kehilangan daya dorongnya. Seorang staf senior Senat mencatat bahwa bahkan sebelum harga turun, banyak warga Amerika melihat kritik Republikan sebagai oportunisme politik, bukan substansial. Survei CNN/ORC akhir Maret menemukan bahwa meskipun 20% responden menyebut harga bensin sebagai isu utama negara, sebagian besar menyalahkan perusahaan minyak — bukan Gedung Putih — atas kenaikan tersebut. Kongres dan produsen minyak asing menerima tuduhan hampir sama besarnya. Para ahli sepakat: perubahan jangka pendek harga dipicu oleh dinamika pasar global, bukan kebijakan AS. Tom Kloza, analis minyak terkemuka, menjelaskan bahwa penurunan baru-baru ini berasal dari reaksi berlebihan investor terhadap kekhawatiran tentang Iran dan ekonomi Eropa — bukan dari izin pengeboran atau keputusan pipa. Ia menambahkan bahwa dampak signifikan dari perubahan kebijakan, seperti efisiensi bahan bakar atau pengeboran lepas pantai, akan membutuhkan waktu lima sampai sepuluh tahun. Direktur polling CNN Keating Holland mengatakannya dengan jelas: Warga Amerika lebih takut akan kekurangan bensin daripada harga tinggi. Krisis energi tahun 1970-an yang merugikan presiden ditandai oleh antrean panjang dan ransum — bukan harga yang mahal. Selama bensin tetap tersedia, bahkan dengan harga $3,70, kebanyakan pemilih tidak akan menganggapnya sebagai krisis. Dan seperti kata Kloza, 'Tidak ada yang bisa mengklaim kredit — dan tidak ada yang bisa disalahkan.'

article_content: A year after the launch of Tesco’s hugely popular Hudl tablet, the retail giant has released its next-generation model: the Hudl2. Unveiled at an event in London, the Hudl2 features an 8.3-inch screen—an increase from the original 7-inch model—and runs on Android KitKat 4.4.2. It will be available in Tesco stores and online from 9 October for £129. Clubcard customers can also purchase the Hudl2 through Clubcard Boost, a scheme that doubles the value of Clubcard vouchers, reducing the price to £65. The original Hudl launched on 1 September 2013 and sold over 35,000 units within its first two days. In total, Tesco claims to have sold more than 750,000 devices in the past 12 months. The price of the original Hudl has since been reduced from £129 to £99. In addition to the larger screen, the Hudl2 features upgraded cameras: a 5MP rear camera and a 1.2MP front camera, compared to the original’s 3MP rear and 2MP front. This places its camera performance in direct competition with Google’s Nexus 7 (2013) and Apple’s iPad mini with Retina Display. The resolution has been increased to 1920 x 1200 from the original’s 1400 x 900. However, due to the larger screen size, the pixel-per-inch (PPI) density is only marginally improved—from 237 to 272. PPI is a key indicator of image sharpness, clarity, and color vibrancy. The Hudl2 offers an 8-hour battery life when watching videos—matching the original—and comes with 16GB of onboard storage, expandable to 48GB via microSD. It is powered by an Intel Atom quad-core processor. Tesco has partnered with The Parent Zone to integrate a built-in parental control app, enabling families to create up to seven personalized profiles. Each profile can be customized by age and suitability, including setting daily time limits for children’s usage. The Hudl2 is available in eight vibrant colors: Jazzy Blue, Zesty Orange, Slate Black, Rocket Red, Tropical Turquoise, Dreamy White, Perky Purple, and Bubblegum Pink. Additionally, every Hudl2 comes with £25 in free blinkbox credit for movies, books, and music; £10 off F&F clothing when spending £50; £10 off Tesco Direct when spending £50; £15 off Tesco.com when spending £60; and 10 free prints when purchasing 50 photos at Tesco Photo. Michael Comish, Group Digital Officer at Tesco, said: 'We know customers want easy, accessible technology that the whole family can use—whether working, shopping, gaming, learning, or just taking some time out. Cutting-edge technology doesn’t have to come with a big price tag. The Hudl2 may be affordable, but we’ve cut no corners when it comes to performance—this is our best tablet offering yet.'

article_content: I’ve always been a huge fan of commuter e-bikes—they cut car use and turn boring errands into something enjoyable. But electric mountain bikes? Honestly, I used to think they were overkill. For someone physically capable, adding a motor felt like cheating—and I worried they’d wreck trails, scare off animals, and be less safe than regular mountain bikes. Still, I was surprised to find that two of those concerns don’t hold up. A 2022 study by the Federal Highway Administration’s Western Federal Lands Highway Division and the DOT’s Volpe Center found that e-MTBs don’t cause more soil displacement or wildlife disruption than traditional bikes—though data on wildlife reactions remains limited. As for safety, while injury patterns between e-bikes and regular bikes are broadly similar, e-bike riders do face a higher risk of brain injuries and are over three times more likely to collide with pedestrians. I’m old enough to respect my brain, but young enough to still chase speed and joy. And honestly? That’s why people ride e-MTBs: because they’re fun. REI’s new DRT e3.1 is clearly built to meet that demand. Beyond recreation, these bikes help those who can’t ride traditional ones, assist emergency teams reaching remote zones, give hunters a quieter alternative to ATVs, and let mountain dwellers conquer steep climbs quickly so they can enjoy longer descents. Curious, I put aside my doubts and tested the DRT e3.1. It impressed me: a Class 1 pedal-assist bike with a Bosch mid-drive motor, 625Wh battery hidden in the downtube, 140mm front and 130mm rear suspension, SRAM SX Eagle 12-speed gearing, and beefy 2.5-inch Kenda Nevegal tires. Small frames get 27.5-inch wheels; medium to XL get 29-inchers. Even the olive-green matte finish looks premium.

Bagi seseorang yang sehat secara fisik, menambahkan motor terasa seperti curang—dan saya khawatir sepeda ini akan merusak jalur, membuat satwa liar ketakutan, serta kurang aman dibanding sepeda gunung biasa. Namun, saya terkejut menemukan bahwa dua dari kekhawatiran itu tidak benar. Sebuah studi tahun 2022 oleh Divisi Jalan Federal Wilayah Barat Administrasi Jalan Federal dan Pusat Volpe Departemen Transportasi AS menemukan bahwa sepeda gunung listrik tidak menyebabkan perpindahan tanah atau gangguan pada satwa liar lebih banyak daripada sepeda gunung konvensional—meskipun data tentang reaksi satwa liar masih terbatas. Mengenai keselamatan, pola cedera antara sepeda listrik dan sepeda biasa secara umum serupa, tetapi pengendara sepeda listrik memiliki risiko cedera otak yang lebih tinggi dan tiga kali lebih mungkin bertabrakan dengan pejalan kaki. Saya cukup tua untuk menghargai otak saya, tapi cukup muda untuk tetap mengejar kecepatan dan kesenangan. Dan jujur? Itulah alasan orang naik sepeda gunung listrik: karena mereka menyenangkan. Sepeda DRT e3.1 baru dari REI jelas dirancang untuk memenuhi permintaan itu. Di luar rekreasi, sepeda-sepeda ini membantu mereka yang tidak bisa mengendarai sepeda gunung biasa, membantu tim darurat mencapai daerah terpencil, memberi para pemburu alternatif yang lebih tenang daripada ATV, serta memungkinkan penduduk pegunungan menaklukkan tanjakan curam dengan cepat agar bisa menikmati turunan yang lebih panjang. Penasaran, saya menyingkirkan keraguan saya dan menguji DRT e3.1. Sepeda ini membuat saya terkesan: sepeda kelas 1 dengan sistem bantuan pedal, motor mid-drive Bosch, baterai 625Wh yang tersembunyi di tabung bawah, suspensi depan 140mm dan belakang 130mm, transmisi SRAM SX Eagle 12-percepatan, serta ban Kenda Nevegal lebar 2,5 inci yang siap tubeless. Ukuran kecil dilengkapi roda 27,5 inci; ukuran sedang hingga XL menggunakan roda 29 inci. Bahkan finishing matte hijau zaitunnya terlihat elegan.

article_content: In January 2014, Hull City midfielder Tom Huddlestone ended a 2.5-year pledge to grow out his afro hairstyle — a personal vow made until he scored a goal. After netting in a 6-0 victory over Fulham, he underwent a highly publicized haircut at the KC Stadium, marking the end of an unusual personal campaign. His shorn hair, described as 'fluffy' and with 'one previous owner,' was auctioned on eBay, fetching an astonishing £6,300 from an anonymous bidder. Combined with other donations through his JustGiving page, Huddlestone raised over £36,000 for Cancer Research UK. The haircut was performed by professional barber Lance Lowe in the team dressing room, with assistance from club physio Rob Price. Teammates including Jake Livermore, David Meyler, and Robbie Brady watched the event and contributed financially — with Meyler and Brady each donating £2,000. Huddlestone opted for a clean mohican style, declining more flamboyant suggestions like a Mr. T-inspired look. He admitted the long hair had become impractical but expressed pride in turning his personal challenge into meaningful support for cancer research. The campaign, dubbed 'Huddlefro,' gained viral attention for its blend of humor, dedication, and philanthropy. Fans could purchase small pieces of his hair as memorabilia. Huddlestone’s ultimate fundraising target remains £75,000.

Setelah mencetak gol dalam kemenangan 6-0 atas Fulham, ia menjalani potongan rambut yang sangat dipublikasikan di KC Stadium, menandai berakhirnya kampanye pribadi yang tidak biasa. Target penggalangan dana akhir Huddlestone tetap Rp1,4 miliar (setara £75.000).

article_content: A 20-year-old woman, Victoria Henderson, tragically died after being thrown from a snowmobile operated by her friend Nicholas Krenz, 21, on Frozen Bone Lake, Wisconsin. The accident occurred around 10 p.m. on Wednesday when Krenz allegedly swerved to avoid an ice shack, ejecting Henderson, who struck the structure and sustained fatal head injuries. Ironically, Henderson — originally from Luck, Wisconsin, and formerly of Little Rock, Arkansas — had chosen to ride with Krenz over her boyfriend, Thomas Mergens, because she believed he drove more cautiously. Mergens, who was following behind on another snowmobile, witnessed the crash and rushed to assist. Despite wearing a helmet, Henderson could not be revived. Krenz, who was unharmed, was arrested at the scene on suspicion of operating a vehicle while intoxicated. Henderson worked as a server at the Thirsty Otter Tavern and Resort, where she was deeply cherished. The establishment has since launched a fundraiser to support her family, describing her as 'an employee, friend, and part of our Otter Family.' Community members are invited to honor her memory and celebrate her life.

Kecelakaan itu terjadi sekitar pukul 10 malam pada Rabu ketika Krenz diduga berbelok untuk menghindari gubuk es, melemparkan Henderson yang kemudian menabrak struktur tersebut dan mengalami cedera kepala yang menyebabkan kematian. Ironisnya, Henderson — yang berasal dari Luck, Wisconsin, dan sebelumnya dari Little Rock, Arkansas — memilih untuk naik bersama Krenz daripada pacarnya, Thomas Mergens, karena dia percaya Krenz mengemudi lebih hati-hati. Mergens, yang mengikuti di belakang dengan snowmobile lain, menyaksikan kecelakaan itu dan segera datang membantu. Meskipun mengenakan helm, Henderson tidak dapat diselamatkan. Krenz, yang tidak terluka, ditangkap di tempat kejadian atas dugaan mengemudi dalam keadaan mabuk. Henderson bekerja sebagai pelayan di Thirsty Otter Tavern and Resort, tempat ia sangat dicintai. Tempat tersebut telah meluncurkan penggalangan dana untuk mendukung keluarganya, menggambarkannya sebagai 'seorang karyawan, teman, dan bagian dari Keluarga Otter kami.' Masyarakat diundang untuk menghormati kenangannya dan merayakan kehidupannya.

article_content: Kaitlin Nootbaar, valedictorian of Prague High School in Oklahoma, was denied her diploma after using the word 'hell' in her graduation speech — a change she made spontaneously from the pre-approved 'heck'. Appearing on NBC's Today Show, the 18-year-old stated she has no intention of apologizing, asserting that she earned her diploma through four years of straight A's and does not need it to validate her achievements. Her speech, inspired by a scene from 'The Twilight Saga: Eclipse', included the line: 'How the hell do I know? I’ve changed my mind so many times.' She consulted classmates before the ceremony, who encouraged her to use the stronger word. Her father, David Nootbaar, a military veteran, stood by her side, questioning why she should surrender her First Amendment rights when others risk their lives to defend them. Although the school demanded a formal apology before releasing her diploma, Kaitlin declined — but later expressed regret for the distress her case caused school staff, who faced an influx of harassing phone calls. Despite the denial, Kaitlin has secured a full scholarship to Southwestern Oklahoma State University and will begin her freshman year this fall. Her parents argue the punishment is disproportionate: she met all academic requirements, and the speech was neither offensive nor disruptive — it received laughter and applause from her peers.
translated_content: Kaitlin Nootbaar, siswa peringkat teratas di Prague High School, Oklahoma, ditolak diploma-nya setelah menggunakan kata 'hell' dalam pidato wisudanya — perubahan yang dia buat secara spontan dari kata 'heck' yang sebelumnya disetujui. Dalam penampilannya di Today Show NBC, remaja berusia 18 tahun itu menyatakan tidak berniat meminta maaf, menegaskan bahwa ia telah mendapatkan diploma melalui empat tahun nilai A semua dan tidak membutuhkannya untuk membuktikan pencapaiannya. Pidatonya, terinspirasi oleh adegan dari 'The Twilight Saga: Eclipse', mencakup kalimat: 'Bagaimana saya tahu? Saya sudah berganti pikiran begitu banyak kali.' Dia berkonsultasi dengan teman-teman sekelas sebelum upacara, yang mendorongnya untuk menggunakan kata yang lebih kuat. Ayahnya, David Nootbaar, seorang veteran militer, berdiri di sampingnya, bertanya mengapa ia harus melepaskan hak Konstitusi pertamanya ketika banyak orang lain mempertaruhkan nyawa demi melindungi hak-hak tersebut. Meskipun sekolah menuntut surat permintaan maaf resmi sebelum menyerahkan diplomasnya, Kaitlin menolak — tetapi kemudian menyatakan penyesalan atas keresahan yang dialami staf sekolah akibat serangan telepon berantai yang menghujani mereka. Meski diplomasnya ditolak, Kaitlin telah mendapatkan beasiswa penuh ke Southwestern Oklahoma State University dan akan memulai tahun pertamanya kuliah musim gugur ini. Orang tuanya berpendapat hukuman ini tidak proporsional: ia memenuhi semua persyaratan akademik, dan pidatonya tidak menyinggung atau mengganggu — bahkan mendapat tawa dan tepuk tangan dari rekan-rekannya.

article_content: Sharon Ball, a 25-year-old mother from Scotland, has been sentenced to two years in prison after crashing her car into her childhood friend Sean Clements while severely intoxicated. The incident occurred in July last year in Viewpark, Lanarkshire, when Ball — with a blood alcohol level of 88mcgs (more than twice the legal limit of 35mcgs) — lost control of her Peugeot 307, veered off the road, and struck Clements and another friend, Steven Millar, who were sitting on a grassy roadside verge. Clements, then 24, was pinned beneath the vehicle, suffering third-degree burns from the spinning tires, a bruised lung, scalp lacerations, and extensive trauma. Bystanders rushed to lift the car off him, saving his life. He spent a month in hospital and underwent multiple skin graft surgeries. Today, he continues to receive therapy for post-traumatic stress and is unable to return to work. Ball admitted to drinking heavily before driving and expressed sincere remorse during court proceedings. Her defence argued that her young child would be profoundly impacted by incarceration, and the judge took this into account, reducing what could have been a 30-month sentence. In court, Clements spoke emotionally about how easily he could have died that night — recalling only seeing headlights moments before impact. He said he never imagined the person responsible would be someone he once considered a close friend. The prosecutor highlighted that Ball ignored pleas to slow down, drove recklessly, and nearly caused a fatality. Sheriff Vincent Smith condemned her actions as far beyond mere dangerous driving, calling them reckless and life-endangering. Despite the tragedy, Clements expressed cautious satisfaction with the outcome, stating, 'Two years is better than nothing.'
translated_content: Sharon Ball, seorang ibu berusia 25 tahun dari Skotlandia, telah dihukum dua tahun penjara setelah menabrak teman masa kecilnya, Sean Clements, sambil mengemudi dalam kondisi mabuk. Kejadian itu terjadi pada Juli tahun lalu di Viewpark, Lanarkshire, ketika Ball — dengan kadar alkohol darah 88mcgs (lebih dari dua kali batas hukum 35mcgs) — kehilangan kendali mobil Peugeot 307-nya, keluar dari jalan, dan menabrak Clements serta temannya yang lain, Steven Millar, yang sedang duduk di tepi rumput. Clements, yang saat itu berusia 24 tahun, terperangkap di bawah mobil, mengalami luka bakar derajat tiga akibat ban yang berputar, paru-paru memar, luka di kulit kepala, dan cedera serius lainnya. Warga sekitar bergegas mengangkat mobil itu untuk menyelamatkan nyawanya. Ia menjalani perawatan selama sebulan di rumah sakit dan menjalani beberapa operasi cangkok kulit. Kini, ia terus menerima terapi untuk stres pasca-trauma dan belum bisa kembali bekerja. Ball mengaku telah minum alkohol berlebihan sebelum mengemudi dan menunjukkan penyesalan yang tulus selama persidangan. Tim pembela berargumen bahwa anak kecilnya akan sangat terdampak jika ia dipenjara, dan hakim mempertimbangkan hal ini, sehingga mengurangi hukuman dari 30 bulan menjadi 24 bulan. Di pengadilan, Clements berbicara secara emosional tentang betapa mudahnya ia bisa meninggal malam itu — ia hanya ingat melihat lampu mobil mendekat sebelum kejadian. Ia mengatakan tidak pernah menyangka pelakunya adalah seseorang yang pernah ia anggap sebagai teman dekat. Jaksa menyoroti bahwa Ball mengabaikan permintaan untuk melambat, mengemudi secara sembrono, dan nyaris menyebabkan kematian. Hakim Vincent Smith mengutuk tindakannya sebagai jauh melampaui mengemudi berbahaya, menyebutnya gegabah dan membahayakan nyawa. Meskipun tragedi itu terjadi, Clements menyatakan kepuasan yang hati-hati atas hasilnya, dengan berkata, 'Dua tahun lebih baik daripada tidak ada hukuman.'

article_content: By Paul Donnelley for MailOnline. It’s supposed to be the happiest time of your life — when you and your loved one enjoy a wonderful honeymoon and want to share those memories with friends, family, and, increasingly, the world through social media. That’s what a Neapolitan woman thought when she posted photos from her honeymoon on Facebook. But after a marital dispute, her husband demanded the photos be removed, claiming he never gave permission — and even took her to court to enforce the request. Now, a Naples court has sided with the husband. The wife may be required to pay him damages. The photos, taken during their honeymoon ten years ago, showed the couple cuddling and kissing. In her defense, the wife’s lawyer argued that social media platforms like Facebook function similarly to private photo albums. But the court disagreed, stating that publishing a photo online is 'significantly worse' than any other form of distribution because privacy cannot be controlled by the user. The court ruled that the woman violated Article 10 of Italy’s Civil Code and breached her husband’s right to privacy. She also broke provisions from a 1941 Italian law prohibiting the display, reproduction, or sale of someone’s portrait without their consent. The husband’s lawyer, Ciro Renino, welcomed the decision, calling it 'unprecedented' and a crucial reference point for future Facebook users.
translated_content: Oleh Paul Donnelley untuk MailOnline. Ini seharusnya menjadi waktu paling bahagia dalam hidup Anda — ketika Anda dan pasangan Anda menikmati bulan madu yang indah dan ingin berbagi kenangan itu dengan teman, keluarga, dan semakin sering, dunia melalui media sosial. Itulah yang dipikirkan seorang wanita Neapolitan ketika ia memposting foto-foto bulan madunya di Facebook. Namun, setelah perselisihan pernikahan, suaminya menuntut foto-foto tersebut dihapus, mengklaim ia tidak pernah memberikan izin — bahkan membawanya ke pengadilan untuk menegakkan permintaannya. Kini, Pengadilan Napoli memihak suami itu. Istri itu mungkin harus membayar ganti rugi. Foto-foto tersebut, diambil selama bulan madu mereka sepuluh tahun lalu, menunjukkan pasangan itu berpelukan dan berciuman. Dalam pembelaannya, pengacara istri berargumen bahwa platform media sosial seperti Facebook berfungsi mirip dengan album foto pribadi. Tetapi pengadilan tidak setuju, menyatakan bahwa mempublikasikan foto secara daring jauh lebih buruk daripada bentuk distribusi lainnya karena privasi tidak dapat dikendalikan oleh pengguna. Pengadilan memutuskan bahwa wanita itu melanggar Pasal 10 Kitab Undang-Undang Hukum Perdata Italia dan melanggar hak privasi suaminya. Ia juga melanggar ketentuan undang-undang tahun 1941 yang melarang tampilan, reproduksi, atau penjualan potret seseorang tanpa persetujuan subjek. Pengacara suami, Ciro Renino, menyambut baik keputusan ini, menyebutnya 'belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya' dan sebagai acuan penting bagi pengguna Facebook di masa depan.

article_content: The trial of Manuel Edmundo Guzman Jr., 19, is set to conclude this week with closing arguments in the case of a 2011 murder allegedly motivated by a 'thrill kill.' Prosecutors claim Guzman created a fake Facebook profile under the name Rebecca Santhiago, using a photograph of a curvy, seductive East Coast internet model to lure men online. In May 2011, 23-year-old professional boxer Eddie Leal responded to messages from the fictional persona and agreed to meet her at a park in San Jacinto, California, around 2 a.m. According to prosecutors, Guzman shot Leal multiple times upon arrival, leaving him dead in his Toyota Corolla on Roanoke Street. Investigators traced the fake profile and chat logs to a computer at Guzman’s mother’s home, where he resided. Forensic expert Tony Pelato stated he had 'no doubt' the messages were typed on Guzman’s device. Copies of the Facebook page and conversations were also found on Leal’s own computer. Guzman, who was 17 at the time of the killing, was arrested on April 10, 2012. He was already on probation for a prior juvenile offense. He now faces charges of first-degree murder, lying in wait, use of a firearm, and causing great bodily injury — all of which could result in life imprisonment without parole if convicted. The defense contends the case relies heavily on circumstantial evidence. They point out that no DNA from Guzman was found on the five shell casings recovered at the scene, and there is no direct evidence linking him to firing the weapon. Attorneys argue the prosecution has failed to prove beyond a reasonable doubt that Guzman committed the act.
translated_content: Sidang Manuel Edmundo Guzman Jr., 19 tahun, akan berakhir minggu ini dengan argumen penutup dalam kasus pembunuhan tahun 2011 yang diduga dilakukan demi 'kesenangan'. Jaksa menuduh Guzman membuat profil Facebook palsu atas nama Rebecca Santhiago, menggunakan foto seorang model internet dari Pantai Timur yang berbadan proporsional dan menggoda untuk menjaring pria secara daring. Pada Mei 2011, petinju profesional berusia 23 tahun, Eddie Leal, merespons pesan dari persona fiktif itu dan sepakat bertemu dengannya di sebuah taman di San Jacinto, California, sekitar pukul 02.00. Menurut jaksa, Guzman menembak Leal beberapa kali saat tiba, meninggalkannya tewas di dalam Toyota Corollanya di Jalan Roanoke. Para penyelidik melacak profil palsu dan log obrolan ke komputer di rumah ibu Guzman, tempat ia tinggal. Ahli forensik komputer Tony Pelato menyatakan ia 'tidak ragu sama sekali' bahwa pesan tersebut diketik di komputer Guzman. Salinan halaman Facebook dan percakapan juga ditemukan di komputer korban. Guzman, yang berusia 17 tahun pada saat kejadian, ditangkap pada 10 April 2012. Ia sudah berada dalam masa percobaan karena vonis remaja sebelumnya. Kini ia menghadapi tuduhan pembunuhan tingkat pertama, bersembunyi untuk menyerang, penggunaan senjata api, dan menyebabkan cedera serius — semua tuduhan yang bisa mengakibatkan hukuman seumur hidup tanpa kemungkinan pembebasan bersyarat jika terbukti bersalah. Pihak pembela berpendapat bahwa kasus ini sangat bergantung pada bukti tidak langsung. Mereka menunjukkan bahwa tidak ada jejak DNA Guzman yang ditemukan pada lima selongsong peluru yang ditemukan di tempat kejadian, dan tidak ada bukti langsung yang menghubungkannya dengan penembakan. Pengacara berargumen bahwa jaksa gagal membuktikan di luar keraguan yang masuk akal bahwa Guzman melakukan tindakan tersebut.

article_content: New York (CNN) — Gigi Jordan sat expressionless as a New York prosecutor described the harrowing final moments of her 8-year-old autistic son, Jude Mirra. Assistant District Attorney Matt Bogdanos told jurors that Jordan allegedly mixed a deadly blend of painkillers and anti-inflammatories, then forcibly administered it to the child. 'Two fresh bruises on his nose, chin, and chest suggest she pinned him down — perhaps while he slept — and injected the poison,' Bogdanos said, demonstrating the motion to the jury. 'His fate was sealed. He didn’t die quickly. His organs shut down, one by one, over hours.' But on the first day of Jordan’s highly publicized second-degree murder trial, her defense attorney, Allan Brenner, offered a radically different narrative. He portrayed Jordan as a mother pushed to the brink by fear and trauma — convinced that killing her son was the only way to protect him from his biological father, a man she accused of repeated sexual and physical abuse. Police discovered Jude’s body on February 5, 2010, at the luxury Peninsula Hotel in Manhattan. An autopsy revealed four undigested drugs in his stomach, mixed with orange juice and vodka. Prosecutors noted that shortly before his death, Jordan emailed a financial advisor to transfer her son’s $125,000 trust fund into her personal account. They also highlighted that she had recently moved $8 million from savings to checking and checked into the hotel without a reservation, paying in cash. Brenner countered that Jordan had intended to die alongside her son in a suicide pact. She had reportedly gathered the drugs not to murder Jude, but to end both their lives — and survived only because the dose wasn’t fatal to her. According to Brenner, Jordan’s terror stemmed from two former husbands. Her first husband, a former business partner, allegedly threatened to kill her and take custody of Jude. She claimed he had stolen millions from their joint ventures and abused Jude. Though she filed a civil lawsuit against him in 2012, he has denied the abuse allegations and sued Jordan for defamation in 2013. Jordan also feared her son’s biological father — a yoga instructor and undocumented immigrant she had married to help him obtain legal status — would gain custody. Brenner said Jude, who had limited speech due to autism, repeatedly whispered, 'Dad bad, Dad bad,' indicating ongoing abuse. Jordan reportedly told a therapist and sought help from a national child-exploitation expert in Wyoming, only to be labeled delusional and temporarily separated from her son. Though the abuse claims were reported to authorities, no investigation led to charges. The biological father has never been criminally charged and denies all allegations. Jordan now faces 15 years to life in prison if convicted. She is expected to testify in her own defense.
translated_content: New York (CNN) — Gigi Jordan duduk tanpa ekspresi saat jaksa New York menggambarkan momen-momen terakhir yang mengerikan bagi putranya yang berusia 8 tahun, Jude Mirra, yang autistik. Jaksa Penuntut Umum Matt Bogdanos mengatakan kepada juri bahwa Jordan diduga mencampur campuran mematikan obat penghilang rasa sakit dan antiinflamasi, lalu memaksa anak itu menelannya. 'Dua lebam segar di hidung, dagu, dan dada menunjukkan ia menekan tubuh anak itu — mungkin saat tidur — dan menyuntikkan racun itu,' kata Bogdanos, mendemonstrasikan gerakan tersebut kepada juri. 'Nasibnya sudah ditentukan. Ia tidak mati cepat. Organ-organ tubuhnya gagal satu per satu, selama berjam-jam.' Namun pada hari pertama persidangan pembunuhan tingkat dua yang sangat dipantau publik, pengacara pembela Allan Brenner menyajikan narasi yang sangat berbeda. Ia menggambarkan Jordan sebagai seorang ibu yang terdorong hingga batasnya oleh ketakutan dan trauma — yakin bahwa membunuh putranya adalah satu-satunya cara melindunginya dari ayah kandungnya, seorang pria yang dituduhnya telah melakukan pelecehan seksual dan fisik berulang kali. Polisi menemukan mayat Jude pada 5 Februari 2010 di Hotel Peninsula, Manhattan. Otopsi mengungkapkan empat jenis obat yang belum tercerna di perutnya, dicampur dengan jus jeruk dan vodka. Jaksa menyoroti bahwa tak lama sebelum kematiannya, Jordan mengirim email ke penasihat keuangannya untuk mentransfer dana amanat senilai $125.000 milik putranya ke rekening pribadinya. Mereka juga menekankan bahwa ia baru-baru ini memindahkan $8 juta dari tabungan ke rekening giro, serta check-in tanpa reservasi dan membayar tunai. Brenner membantah bahwa Jordan berniat bunuh diri bersama putranya. Ia mengatakan Jordan mengumpulkan obat-obatan bukan untuk membunuh Jude, tetapi untuk mengakhiri hidup mereka berdua — dan bertahan hidup karena dosisnya tidak mematikan baginya. Menurut Brenner, ketakutan Jordan berasal dari dua mantan suaminya. Suami pertamanya, mitra bisnisnya, diduga mengancam akan membunuhnya dan merebut hak asuh Jude. Ia mengklaim suami itu telah mencuri jutaan dolar dari usaha bersama mereka dan melecehkan Jude. Meskipun ia mengajukan gugatan perdata melawan suami itu pada 2012, pria itu membantah tuduhan pelecehan dan justru menggugat Jordan atas pencemaran nama baik pada 2013. Meskipun tuduhan pelecehan itu dilaporkan ke otoritas setempat, tidak ada penyelidikan yang menghasilkan dakwaan. Ayah kandung Jude belum pernah didakwa secara pidana dan membantah semua tuduhan. Jordan kini menghadapi hukuman 15 tahun sampai seumur hidup jika terbukti bersalah. Ia diharapkan akan bersaksi demi dirinya sendiri.

article_content: A major new $6 million kitchen is set to open at the John Morony Correctional Complex near Sydney, designed to become the central hub for feeding tens of thousands of inmates across New South Wales. This initiative builds on a decades-old program that began in 2001, where prisoners grow vegetables, raise cattle, bake bread, and process milk—all while earning valuable food-handling certifications. Last year alone, NSW prisons produced over 338,000 kilograms of vegetables, 1.5 million loaves of bread, 1.4 million litres of fresh milk, and 130,000 kilograms of beef, helping to cut food costs by more than $4 million since 2012/13. With annual prison food expenses nearing $18 million, these savings are substantial. The new facility will feature advanced ‘cook-freeze’ technology, allowing meals to be stored safely for weeks instead of just a few days, dramatically reducing waste and logistical strain. Around 85 inmates will work in the kitchen, learning professional culinary and food safety skills under strict supervision. The program isn’t just about saving money—it’s about giving people behind bars real, transferable job skills. Nearly 600 inmates completed food-related training last year, a critical step toward reducing reoffending. Research shows that meaningful employment after release is one of the strongest predictors against returning to crime. While only minimum-security inmates handle livestock or work outdoors, even those in medium and maximum-security units can take part in supervised food preparation tasks. Commissioner Peter Severin emphasizes that investing in these programs isn’t just smart economics—it’s a smarter path to safer communities. The kitchen is scheduled to begin operations mid-next year, marking a turning point in how NSW prisons support rehabilitation through practical, purpose-driven work.

Inisiatif ini membangun program lama yang dimulai pada tahun 2001, di mana para tahanan menanam sayuran, memelihara sapi, membuat roti, dan mengolah susu—semua sambil mendapatkan sertifikasi penting dalam penanganan makanan. Tahun lalu saja, penjara-penjara di NSW memproduksi lebih dari 338.000 kilogram sayuran, 1,5 juta lembar roti, 1,4 juta liter susu segar, dan 130.000 kilogram daging sapi, yang membantu mengurangi biaya makanan sebesar lebih dari $4 juta sejak 2012/13. Dengan biaya makanan tahanan tahunan yang mendekati $18 juta, penghematan ini sangat signifikan. Fasilitas baru ini akan dilengkapi teknologi canggih 'cook-freeze', yang memungkinkan makanan disimpan dengan aman selama berminggu-minggu, bukan hanya beberapa hari, sehingga secara dramatis mengurangi limbah dan beban logistik. Penelitian menunjukkan bahwa pekerjaan yang bermakna setelah keluar dari penjara adalah salah satu prediktor terkuat dalam mencegah kembali terlibat kejahatan. article_content: Islamabad, Pakistan (CNN) — A series of explosions in western Pakistan killed four people on Sunday, including a young boy, authorities said. Fourteen others were wounded. In Pakistan’s volatile Balochistan province, a blast killed three members of the country’s security forces and wounded two more, military and police officials said. The victims were part of a convoy escorting civilians through the Zain Koh area of Dera Bugti, according to police official Ghulam Muhammad Baloch. In the provincial capital of Quetta, militants threw a hand grenade at a shop, wounding nine people before fleeing the scene. No deaths were reported, but one person remained in critical condition, said police official Nazir Kurd. The attacks came just two days after an explosion outside the home of a former lawmaker in Quetta killed 13 people. On the same day, a 7-year-old boy died in a roadside bombing in Pakistan’s tribal Bajaur agency, said government official Islam Zeb. Three others were injured in that attack. Journalists Wajahat S. Khan and Saboor Khattak contributed to this report.

Di provinsi Balochistan yang tidak stabil di Pakistan, sebuah ledakan menewaskan tiga anggota keamanan negara dan melukai dua orang lagi, menurut pejabat militer dan polisi. Korban merupakan bagian dari konvoi yang mengawal warga sipil di daerah Zain Koh, Dera Bugti, menurut petugas polisi Ghulam Muhammad Baloch. Di ibu kota provinsi Quetta, para militan melemparkan granat tangan ke sebuah toko, melukai sembilan orang sebelum melarikan diri dari lokasi kejadian. Tidak ada korban jiwa yang dilaporkan, tetapi satu orang masih dalam kondisi kritis, kata petugas polisi Nazir Kurd. Serangan-serangan ini terjadi hanya dua hari setelah ledakan di luar rumah mantan anggota parlemen di Quetta yang menewaskan 13 orang. Pada hari yang sama, seorang bocah laki-laki berusia tujuh tahun tewas dalam ledakan bom pinggir jalan di wilayah suku Bajaur Pakistan, kata pejabat pemerintah Islam Zeb. Tiga orang lainnya terluka dalam serangan itu. Jurnalis Wajahat S. Khan dan Saboor Khattak memberikan kontribusi pada laporan ini.

article_content: Hurricane Sandy took my home — in one devastating moment, I lost nearly everything that gave my life meaning. A year later, my neighbors and I are still stuck in limbo. My music group, The Planotones, was scheduled to perform on a cruise ship carrying 3,000 passengers celebrating 1950s and '60s music. We were set to board in Puerto Rico on October 31. Days before, organizers urged us to arrive early, fearing Hurricane Sandy’s path up the East Coast. They arranged a hotel stay for us while we waited. I packed my bag, slipped on my Planotones hat, left food in the garage for my feral cat, called a cab, and locked the back door — a routine I’d followed for decades. My house on the beach in Rockaway, New York, was built in 1916 — 22 years before the first bridge connected the Rockaway Peninsula to Brooklyn and Queens. It had weathered countless storms over its century of existence — and through my 40 years living there. To me, it wasn’t just a house; it was my sanctuary, my friend, my refuge after long tours. In its basement sat my music studio: thousands of 45s, hundreds of albums, microphones, amps, a drum kit, my upright piano from the Brill Building, 24-track tapes from 'Saturday Night Live,' 'Eddie and the Cruisers,' and 'Animal House,' plus decades-worth of demos and a vintage guitar collection. From my hotel room, I watched Hurricane Sandy’s path on the Weather Channel. Alarmed, I called a neighbor on the next block. He told me water was surging up the street — and that books and records from my house were floating past. I lay awake, dreading the worst — but couldn’t believe it would happen. Early the next morning, I called him again. He was walking toward my house. Silence. Then, quietly: 'It’s gone. Your house… it’s gone.' When the cruise ended four days later, my friend Dave met me at the airport. He’d moved my car to higher ground — saving it. The drive back was surreal. The bridges were closed. Towns along the peninsula were unrecognizable: sand, debris, uprooted trees, homes reduced to ash and splinters. When we reached my street, I saw it: no house. No foundation. No driveway. Just rubble — as if a bomb had hit. Reality vanished. Where would I sleep? My clothes? My bed? My glasses? Family photos? The memories my grandchildren would never see? For three months, I lived in a hotel in Staten Island — navigating FEMA paperwork, endless calls, and bureaucratic maze. Eventually, FEMA covered my stay. All I owned were the clothes in my suitcase, so I bought winter gear and performance suits. With local businesses destroyed, even simple tasks became daily struggles. I was lucky — many weren’t. The hotel became suffocating. I longed to return to Rockaway, to the place I loved for four decades. But rentals were scarce. Most homes were flooded, mold-infested. Finally, I found one — clean, empty. I rented beds, TVs, sofas, kitchenware — everything — to make it feel like home. Today, I’m still there. Still sorting through insurance claims, dealing with red tape, deciding what to do with the ruins of my old house. Touring helps me regain normalcy. One night, fans surprised me with a collection of old recordings and memorabilia — I wept with gratitude. Many of us in Rockaway are still waiting — for new insurance rates, updated building codes — holding our breath before rebuilding. But my spirit remains. Life goes on. Obstacles come for a reason. We climb them — however steep — until we reach the other side. — Kenny Vance
translated_content: Hurricane Sandy menghancurkan rumah saya — dalam satu momen yang mengerikan, saya kehilangan hampir semua yang memberi makna hidup saya. Satu tahun kemudian, tetangga saya dan saya masih terjebak dalam ketidakpastian. Grup musik saya, The Planotones, dijadwalkan tampil di kapal pesiar yang membawa 3.000 penumpang untuk merayakan musik tahun 1950-an dan 1960-an. Kami dijadwalkan naik di Puerto Rico pada 31 Oktober. Beberapa hari sebelumnya, penyelenggara mendesak kami untuk datang lebih awal, khawatir terhadap jalur Hurricane Sandy yang menuju Pantai Timur. Mereka mengatur akomodasi hotel bagi kami sambil menunggu. Saya packing tas saya, memakai topi The Planotones, meninggalkan makanan di garasi untuk kucing liar saya, memesan taksi, dan mengunci pintu belakang — rutinitas yang telah saya lakukan selama puluhan tahun. Rumah saya di pantai Rockaway, New York, dibangun pada tahun 1916 — 22 tahun sebelum jembatan pertama menghubungkan Semenanjung Rockaway ke Brooklyn di satu ujung dan Queens di ujung lainnya. Rumah itu telah bertahan melalui banyak badai selama seratus tahun keberadaannya — dan selama 40 tahun saya tinggal di sana. Bagi saya, ini bukan hanya rumah; ini tempat persembunyian saya, teman saya, pelarian saya setelah tur panjang. Di ruang bawah tanahnya terdapat studio musik saya: ribuan lagu 45 rpm, ratusan album, mikrofon, amplifier, drum kit, piano vertikal saya dari Brill Building, pita 24-track dari 'Saturday Night Live,' 'Eddie and the Cruisers,' dan 'Animal House,' ditambah koleksi demo dan gitar antik yang dikumpulkan selama puluhan tahun. Dari kamar hotel saya, saya memantau jalur Hurricane Sandy di saluran cuaca. Khawatir, saya menelepon tetangga di blok sebelah. Dia mengatakan air sedang mengalir deras di jalan — dan bahwa buku-buku serta rekaman dari rumah saya mengapung lewat. Saya terbangun sepanjang malam, takut yang terburuk terjadi — tapi tidak bisa percaya itu benar-benar akan terjadi. Pagi harinya, saya meneleponnya lagi. Dia sedang berjalan menuju rumah saya. Sunyi. Lalu, dengan suara pelan: 'Hilang. Rumahmu... hilang.' Ketika tur berakhir empat hari kemudian, teman saya Dave menjemput saya di bandara. Dia telah memindahkan mobil saya ke tempat lebih tinggi — menyelamatkannya. Perjalanan pulang terasa seperti mimpi buruk. Jembatan-jembatan ditutup. Kota-kota kecil di sepanjang semenanjung tak terkenali: pasir, puing, pohon tumbang, rumah-rumah hancur menjadi abu dan serpihan. Ketika kami sampai di jalan saya, saya melihatnya: tidak ada rumah. Tidak ada fondasi. Tidak ada jalan masuk. Hanya puing-puing — seolah-olah ada bom yang meledak. Realitas lenyap. Di mana saya akan tidur? Pakaian saya? Tempat tidur saya? Kacamata saya? Foto keluarga? Kenangan yang tak akan pernah dilihat cucu-cucu saya tentang kakek-nenek mereka? Selama tiga bulan, saya tinggal di hotel di Staten Island — menghadapi dokumen FEMA, panggilan tak berujung, dan birokrasi yang rumit. Akhirnya, FEMA menanggung biaya penginapan saya. Semua yang saya miliki adalah pakaian dalam koper, jadi saya membeli pakaian musim dingin dan setelan pertunjukan. Dengan bisnis lokal hancur, bahkan tugas sederhana menjadi masalah sehari-hari. Saya beruntung — banyak yang tidak seberuntung saya. Hotel itu menjadi menyiksa. Saya rindu kembali ke Rockaway, tempat yang saya cintai selama empat dekade. Tetapi hunian sewa sangat langka. Sebagian besar rumah rusak akibat banjir dan berjamur. Akhirnya, saya menemukan satu — bersih, kosong. Saya menyewa tempat tidur, TV, sofa, perlengkapan dapur — semuanya — agar terasa seperti rumah. Hari ini, saya masih di sana. Masih mengurus klaim asuransi, menghadapi birokrasi, memutuskan apa yang harus dilakukan dengan reruntuhan rumah lama saya. Tur membantu saya kembali ke rutinitas normal. Suatu malam, para penggemar mengejutkan saya dengan koleksi rekaman dan kenangan lama — saya menangis karena bersyukur. Banyak dari kami di Rockaway masih menunggu — menanti tarif asuransi baru dan kode bangunan yang diperbarui — menahan napas sebelum membangun kembali. Tapi semangat saya tetap utuh. Hidup harus berlanjut. Hambatan datang karena suatu alasan. Kita memanjatnya — seberapa pun sulitnya — sampai kita mencapai sisi lainnya. — Kenny Vance

article_content: Xabi Alonso has carved out one of football’s most respected careers—moving from Real Sociedad to Liverpool, then Real Madrid, and now Bayern Munich. In his first interview with an English outlet since joining Germany, he opened up to former teammate Jamie Carragher in a candid, often funny conversation. He described his move to Bayern not as a step down, but as a deliberate, personal choice: 'I needed a fresh start. This could be my last ride.' His journey—from the best in England to the best in Spain, now the best in Germany—feels like a storybook ending. When Liverpool drew Real Madrid in the Champions League, Alonso was mid-medical at Bayern. 'I came out of the scan and saw it... oh my gosh!' he laughed. He also noted why English sides keep stumbling in Europe: 'They’ve changed too much. Only now is Chelsea looking solid. City win leagues but lack that European mentality.' Alonso stressed adaptability—not betrayal of identity. 'You need to be comfortable with three, even four systems. At Liverpool, we tailored every game. Here, we’ve played with three, four, five defenders. It’s not disloyalty—it’s smart football.' On Ronaldo: 'Of course he’s the best I’ve played with. After you, Jamie!' He added that while Neuer deserves recognition for the World Cup, Ronaldo’s individual brilliance this season makes him equally worthy of the Ballon d’Or. He criticized youth academies for overvaluing tackling and shooting. 'A 12-year-old told me his strengths were tackling and shooting. I thought—shouldn’t it be awareness? Decision-making?' Pep Guardiola’s philosophy, he explained, is all about stillness. 'Don’t run! Stay there! The ball will come to you.' He showed the team videos of Götze standing still for 10 seconds—because movement isn’t always the answer. Reflecting on Spain’s golden generation, he said: 'We weren’t about one-on-one stars. We had five midfielders, short passes, and then Villa or Torres finished it.' He recalled jokingly teasing Carragher after the 2009 Euro qualifier: 'Spain? Can’t run!'—mimicking his Liverpool accent. 'You got the loudest player award!' As for his future? 'Maybe coaching. Maybe punditry? I’ve got ideas. But I won’t rush it. Football gave me everything—I need to listen before I give back.'
translated_content: Xabi Alonso telah membangun karier sepak bola yang paling dihormati—beralih dari Real Sociedad ke Liverpool, lalu Real Madrid, dan sekarang Bayern Munich. Dalam wawancara pertamanya dengan media Inggris sejak bergabung ke Jerman, ia berbicara terbuka kepada mantan rekan setimnya, Jamie Carragher, dalam percakapan yang jujur dan penuh humor. Ia menggambarkan pindah ke Bayern bukan sebagai langkah turun, tapi pilihan sadar dan pribadi: 'Saya butuh awal baru. Ini mungkin perjalanan terakhir saya.' Perjalanannya—from yang terbaik di Inggris ke yang terbaik di Spanyol, sekarang yang terbaik di Jerman—terasa seperti akhir cerita indah. Ketika Liverpool menghadapi Real Madrid di Liga Champions, Alonso sedang menjalani pemeriksaan medis di Bayern. 'Saya keluar dari scan dan melihatnya... oh my gosh!' tertawanya. Ia juga mencatat mengapa tim-tim Inggris terus kesulitan di Eropa: 'Mereka berubah terlalu banyak. Baru sekarang Chelsea terlihat solid. City menang liga tapi tidak punya mentalitas Eropa.' Alonso menekankan adaptabilitas—bukan pengkhianatan identitas. 'Anda harus nyaman dengan tiga, bahkan empat sistem. Di Liverpool, kami menyesuaikan setiap pertandingan. Di sini, kami main dengan tiga, empat, lima bek. Ini bukan pengkhianatan—ini sepak bola cerdas.' Tentang Ronaldo: 'Tentu saja dia pemain terbaik yang pernah saya main bersama. Setelah kamu, Jamie!' Ia menambahkan bahwa meskipun Neuer pantas diakui karena Piala Dunia, kecemerlangan individu Ronaldo musim ini membuatnya sama layak meraih Ballon d'Or. Ia mengkritik akademi muda karena terlalu menilai tackle dan shooting. 'Seorang anak 12 tahun bilang kekuatannya adalah tackle dan shooting. Saya pikir—bukankah seharusnya kesadaran? Pengambilan keputusan?' Filosofi Pep Guardiola, jelasnya, tentang ketenangan. 'Jangan lari! Tetap di sana! Bola akan datang padamu.' Ia menunjukkan video Götze diam selama 10 detik—karena gerakan tidak selalu jawabannya. Merefleksikan generasi emas Spanyol, ia berkata: 'Kami bukan tentang bintang satu lawan satu. Kami punya lima gelandang, umpan pendek, lalu Villa atau Torres yang menyelesaikan.' Ia mengingat candaan lucu pada Carragher setelah kualifikasi Euro 2009: 'Spanyol? Tidak bisa lari!'—menirukan aksen Liverpool-nya. 'Kamu dapat penghargaan pemain paling berisik!' Untuk masa depannya? 'Mungkin pelatih. Mungkin komentator? Saya punya ide. Tapi saya tidak akan terburu-buru. Sepak bola memberi saya segalanya—saya perlu mendengar dulu sebelum memberi kembali.'

article_content: Unlike Woody in Toy Story, who was sidelined but still kept in the closet, Monopoly’s classic tokens face real exile. Hasbro, the company behind the iconic board game, is retiring one of its eight longtime playing pieces — the shoe, top hat, wheelbarrow, iron, battleship, race car, thimble, or Scottie dog — and replacing it with a symbol more reflective of today’s players. Fans are invited to vote daily on Facebook until February 5 to choose which token stays and which gets removed. The five new candidates are a diamond ring, a guitar, a toy robot, a cat, and a helicopter. First released by Parker Brothers in 1935 during the Great Depression, Monopoly has been played by over a billion people worldwide across 111 countries and 43 languages. Some tokens have already disappeared over the years, including the lantern, cannon, and rocking horse. The winning token will debut in mid- to late 2013. The one receiving the fewest votes will be quietly phased out — possibly leaving the humble shoe to wander the board’s edges, reminiscing about better days. Hasbro confirms that the original set with all eight tokens is still available for purchase while supplies last. Online reactions have been spirited: one fan joked that removing the iron would give the Scottie dog something fun to chase; another remembered swallowing the top hat as a child and voted for the robot. As of Wednesday night, the Scottie dog led in popularity, followed by the race car, while the wheelbarrow hovered near elimination.
translated_content: Berbeda dengan Woody di Toy Story yang hanya digantikan tetapi masih disimpan di lemari, token-token klasik Monopoly kini menghadapi pengusiran nyata. Hasbro, perusahaan di balik permainan papan ikonik ini, akan menghapus salah satu dari delapan token lama — sepatu, topi tinggi, gerobak, setrika, kapal perang, mobil balap, jarum jahit, atau anjing Scottie — dan menggantinya dengan simbol yang lebih mencerminkan pemain zaman sekarang. Para penggemar diajak untuk memilih setiap hari di Facebook hingga 5 Februari untuk menentukan token mana yang tetap bertahan dan mana yang harus pergi. Lima kandidat baru adalah cincin berlian, gitar, robot mainan, kucing, dan helikopter. Dirilis pertama kali oleh Parker Brothers pada tahun 1935 di tengah Depresi Besar, Monopoly telah dimainkan oleh lebih dari satu miliar orang di 111 negara dan 43 bahasa. Beberapa token sudah tidak lagi diproduksi seiring waktu, seperti lentera, meriam, dan kuda goyang. Token pemenang akan resmi meluncur pada pertengahan hingga akhir 2013. Yang mendapat suara terendah akan diberhentikan secara diam-diam — mungkin meninggalkan sepatu sederhana itu berkeliling di tepi papan, merenungkan masa kejayaannya. Hasbro menegaskan bahwa versi asli dengan semua delapan token masih bisa dibeli selama stok tersedia. Reaksi di media sosial sangat hangat: seorang penggemar bercanda bahwa menghilangkan setrika akan memberi anjing Scottie sesuatu yang seru untuk dikejar; yang lain ingat pernah menelan topi tinggi saat kecil dan memilih robot. Hingga Rabu malam, anjing Scottie memimpin perolehan suara, diikuti mobil balap, sementara gerobak hampir tereliminasi.

article_content: A devastating avalanche on Mount Everest claimed the lives of 13 Nepali Sherpas and left three others critically injured. The tragedy struck around 6:30 a.m. local time on Friday, April 18, 2014, when the team was securing ropes along a steep section of the mountain known locally as the 'popcorn field,' just below Camp 2 at 5,900 meters. They were preparing the route for hundreds of climbers planning to summit in May. Among the survivors is Dawa Tashi Sherpa, whose image has been shared publicly as he receives intensive care at Grandi International Hospital in Kathmandu. Two other survivors remain in critical condition. Twelve bodies have been recovered; four Sherpas are still missing and presumed dead — marking what officials call the deadliest single incident in Everest’s history. The victims worked for various trekking companies, including those supporting the NBC Everest Expedition and Everest Chinese Expedition 2014. In response, Nepal’s Ministry of Tourism and Aviation confirmed it will provide £400 in compensation to each deceased climber’s family. Rescue operations were suspended due to dangerous weather conditions. The Nepalese government released a list of the deceased: Mingma Nuru Sherpa, Dorji Sherpa, Ang Tshiri Sherpa, Nima Sherpa, Phurba Ongyal Sherpa, Lakpa Tenjing Sherpa, Chhiring Ongchu Sherpa, Dorjee Khatri, Then Dorjee Sherpa, Phur Temba Sherpa, Pasang Karma Sherpa, and Asman Tamang. Efforts to improve safety and reduce overcrowding on Everest this season included stationing officials at Base Camp (17,380 ft) and enforcing a new rule requiring all climbers above Base Camp to bring down at least 8kg of waste — a measure aimed at tackling decades of accumulated garbage, from oxygen tanks to human remains, that have turned the mountain into an open-air landfill.

Mereka sedang mempersiapkan rute bagi ratusan pendaki yang berencana mencapai puncak pada bulan Mei. Di antara para penyintas adalah Dawa Tashi Sherpa, yang fotonya telah dirilis saat ia menerima perawatan intensif di Rumah Sakit Grandi International di Kathmandu. Dua penyintas lainnya masih dalam kondisi kritis. Dua belas jenazah telah ditemukan; empat Sherpa masih hilang dan diduga tewas — menandai insiden tunggal paling mematikan dalam sejarah Everest. Para korban bekerja untuk berbagai perusahaan pendakian, termasuk yang mendukung Ekspedisi NBC Everest dan Ekspedisi China Everest 2014. Sebagai tanggapan, Kementerian Pariwisata dan Penerbangan Nepal memastikan akan memberikan kompensasi sebesar £400 kepada keluarga setiap korban yang meninggal. Operasi pencarian dan penyelamatan dihentikan karena kondisi cuaca yang berbahaya. Pemerintah Nepal merilis daftar korban tewas: Mingma Nuru Sherpa, Dorji Sherpa, Ang Tshiri Sherpa, Nima Sherpa, Phurba Ongyal Sherpa, Lakpa Tenjing Sherpa, Chhiring Ongchu Sherpa, Dorjee Khatri, Then Dorjee Sherpa, Phur Temba Sherpa, Pasang Karma Sherpa, dan Asman Tamang. Upaya untuk meningkatkan keselamatan dan mengurangi kemacetan di Everest musim ini mencakup penempatan petugas di Base Camp (17.380 kaki) serta penerapan aturan baru yang mewajibkan semua pendaki di atas Base Camp membawa turun minimal 8 kg sampah — langkah yang bertujuan mengatasi akumulasi sampah selama puluhan tahun, mulai dari tabung oksigen hingga sisa-sisa manusia, yang telah menjadikan gunung ini seperti tempat pembuangan terbuka.

article_content: A 19-year-old trainee hairdresser, Charlie Dunne, died six days after injecting herself with insulin belonging to her diabetic boyfriend, Terence Rhoden. Authorities believe she may have attempted to use the hormone to lose weight — a dangerous misconception sometimes shared in social circles. Rhoden, who has lived with diabetes for seven years and requires four daily insulin injections, was at a hospital appointment when Dunne took his unused insulin pen. He returned home to find her unconscious on the sofa, the empty pen resting near the cushions. The pen’s packaging had been discarded. Dunne, described as bubbly and active in her local Methodist church — even named ‘Rose Queen’ for her charity work — was otherwise fit and healthy. She had no diagnosed medical conditions. Yet, she had experienced mood swings and previously attempted to overdose on pills during an earlier relationship. She also expressed fears about infertility, though no medical evidence supported them. Her family claimed Rhoden admitted to having injected her with insulin twice before to help her lose weight. He denied this, stating he only discussed insulin’s effects with her and her uncle, but never administered it to her. Police reviewed her phone records and found no signs of abuse or coercion. Doctors at Royal Bolton Hospital detected dangerously low blood sugar levels. Despite emergency treatment, Dunne suffered severe brain damage and passed away on December 23. Coroner Alan Walsh concluded the death was a tragic case of misadventure: likely an impulsive act intended as a cry for help, with devastating consequences. He emphasized that non-diabetics often have no awareness of insulin’s lethal potential. Both Dunne’s parents and Rhoden stressed she was deeply opposed to drugs and would never have taken her own life. Her family believes her actions stemmed from emotional pain, not malice or intent to die.
translated_content: Seorang gadis remaja berusia 19 tahun, Charlie Dunne, meninggal enam hari setelah menyuntikkan dirinya dengan insulin milik pacarnya yang menderita diabetes, Terence Rhoden. Otoritas percaya ia mungkin mencoba menggunakan hormon ini untuk menurunkan berat badan — sebuah kesalahpahaman berbahaya yang terkadang beredar di kalangan sosial. Rhoden, yang telah hidup dengan diabetes selama tujuh tahun dan membutuhkan empat suntikan insulin sehari, sedang di rumah sakit ketika Dunne mengambil pena insulin yang belum digunakan. Ia kembali ke rumah dan menemukan kekasihnya tidak sadarkan diri di sofa, pena insulin kosong tergeletak di sela bantal. Kemasan pena itu telah dibuang. Dunne, yang digambarkan sebagai sosok ceria dan aktif di gereja Metodis setempat — bahkan dinobatkan sebagai 'Ratu Mawar' karena kerja amalnya — sebelumnya sehat dan tidak memiliki kondisi medis apa pun. Namun, ia pernah mengalami perubahan suasana hati dan sebelumnya mencoba overdosis pil dalam hubungan sebelumnya. Ia juga menyatakan takut tidak bisa memiliki anak, meski tidak ada bukti medis yang mendukung kekhawatirannya. Keluarganya mengklaim Rhoden mengaku pernah menyuntikkan insulin kepadanya dua kali sebelumnya untuk membantunya menurunkan berat badan. Ia membantah klaim itu, menyatakan bahwa ia hanya membahas efek insulin dengannya dan pamannya, tetapi tidak pernah memberinya suntikan. Polisi memeriksa catatan ponselnya dan tidak menemukan tanda-tanda kekerasan atau paksaan. Dokter di Rumah Sakit Royal Bolton mendeteksi kadar gula darah yang sangat rendah. Meskipun mendapat perawatan darurat, Dunne mengalami kerusakan otak parah dan meninggal pada 23 Desember. Hakim jenazah Alan Walsh menyimpulkan kematian itu adalah kasus kecelakaan tragis: kemungkinan tindakan impulsif yang dimaksudkan sebagai permintaan bantuan, dengan konsekuensi yang mengerikan. Ia menekankan bahwa orang non-diabetik sering tidak menyadari potensi mematikan insulin. Baik orang tua Dunne maupun Rhoden menekankan bahwa ia sangat menentang obat-obatan dan tidak akan pernah mengakhiri hidupnya sendiri. Keluarganya percaya tindakannya berasal dari rasa sakit emosional, bukan niat jahat atau ingin mati.
