article_content: On Saturday, Coney Island’s Luna Park came alive as fans of thrill rides gathered to honor the 85th birthday of the legendary Cyclone roller coaster. Opened in 1927, this iconic wooden coaster—famous for its 85-foot plunge and winding drops—helped redefine amusement park excitement across America. To mark the occasion, Luna Park offered the original 1927 ticket price of 25 cents for the first 85 minutes of the day, drawing crowds who lined up hours before opening. Visitors, including families and tourists, shared stories of childhood rides, while members of the Brooklyn Cyclones baseball team mingled with guests. The festivities, largely free, ended with a dazzling fireworks show over the beach. Designated a New York City landmark in 1988 and added to the National Register of Historic Places in 1991, the Cyclone continues to connect generations. 'It’s not just a ride—it’s a family tradition,' said Johanna Zaki of Central Amusement International. Today, tickets cost $8, but for many, the experience still feels timeless.

Dibuka pada tahun 1927, koaster kayu ikonik ini—terkenal karena turunan 85 kaki dan belokan-belokannya yang menantang—membantu mendefinisikan ulang kegembiraan taman hiburan di seluruh Amerika. Untuk memperingati acara ini, Luna Park menawarkan harga tiket asli tahun 1927, yaitu 25 sen, selama 85 menit pertama hari itu, menarik kerumunan yang sudah antri berjam-jam sebelum pintu dibuka. Pengunjung, termasuk keluarga dan wisatawan, berbagi cerita tentang pengalaman naik wahana saat kecil, sementara anggota tim bisbol Brooklyn Cyclones berinteraksi dengan para tamu. Acara-acara tersebut, sebagian besar gratis, berakhir dengan pertunjukan kembang api yang memukau di atas pantai. article_content: Nearly three centuries after sinking in a violent storm off the coast of Britain, the wreckage of the original HMS Victory — the predecessor to Admiral Nelson’s iconic ship — is finally set to be lifted from the seabed. Lost in October 1744 during a fierce tempest in the Bay of Biscay, the vessel went down with more than 1,000 crew members, including Admiral Sir John Balchin. For years, its exact location remained one of naval history’s greatest mysteries — until 2008, when the American deep-sea exploration firm Odyssey Marine Exploration pinpointed it beneath 330 feet of water in the English Channel, nearly 65 miles away from where historians once believed it lay. Though never officially confirmed, many believe the ship carried a fortune in precious metals: an estimated £400,000 in gold coins shipped from Lisbon for British merchants, plus another £120,000 in silver and gold taken from captured enemy vessels — amounts that today could be worth upwards of half a billion pounds. Artifacts already recovered include over 100 bronze cannons, two of which have been successfully raised. The recovery effort is being led by the Maritime Heritage Foundation, established by Lord Lingfield, a descendant of Admiral Balchin. Though related to the admiral, Lord Lingfield has publicly stated he will not benefit financially from any treasure found. Instead, the foundation’s mission is focused on protecting the site’s archaeological integrity and promoting scientific and educational research into 18th-century naval life. Under international salvage law, Odyssey Marine Exploration is expected to retain the majority of any monetary treasure recovered, while all artifacts will be transferred to UK museums for public display. The UK Ministry of Defence has expressed support for the project, calling it a vital step in preserving Britain’s maritime heritage. The operation, potentially involving the massive submersible ‘Zeus,’ aims not just to recover riches — but to uncover a forgotten chapter of naval history.
translated_content: Hampir tiga abad setelah tenggelam dalam badai hebat di lepas pantai Inggris, reruntuhan HMS Victory versi pertama — pendahulu kapal ikonik Admiral Nelson — akhirnya akan diangkat dari dasar laut. Kapal itu hilang pada Oktober 1744 saat menghadapi badai dahsyat di Teluk Biscay, membawa lebih dari 1.000 awak, termasuk Laksamana Sir John Balchin. Selama bertahun-tahun, lokasi pastinya tetap menjadi salah satu misteri terbesar dalam sejarah maritim — hingga tahun 2008, ketika perusahaan eksplorasi laut dalam asal Amerika, Odyssey Marine Exploration, menemukannya di kedalaman 330 kaki di Selat Inggris, hampir 65 mil jauhnya dari lokasi yang diperkirakan sebelumnya. Meski belum dikonfirmasi secara resmi, banyak yang percaya kapal itu membawa kekayaan besar dalam logam mulia: sekitar £400.000 dalam bentuk koin emas yang dikirim dari Lisbon untuk pedagang Inggris, ditambah £120.000 lagi dalam bentuk perak dan emas yang diambil dari kapal musuh yang ditawan — jumlah yang saat ini bisa bernilai lebih dari setengah miliar pound. Artefak yang sudah diangkat mencakup lebih dari 100 meriam perunggu, dua di antaranya telah berhasil dinaikkan. Upaya pemulihan ini dipimpin oleh Maritime Heritage Foundation, yang didirikan oleh Lord Lingfield, keturunan Laksamana Balchin. Meskipun masih kerabat laksamana, Lord Lingfield secara terbuka menyatakan tidak akan mendapat keuntungan finansial dari harta apa pun yang ditemukan. Sebaliknya, misi yayasan ini berfokus pada perlindungan integritas arkeologis situs tersebut dan promosi penelitian ilmiah serta pendidikan tentang kehidupan angkatan laut abad ke-18. Menurut hukum penemuan harta karun internasional, Odyssey Marine Exploration diharapkan memperoleh sebagian besar harta moneter yang ditemukan, sementara semua artefak akan dipindahkan ke museum-museum di Inggris untuk pameran publik. Kementerian Pertahanan Inggris menyatakan dukungan terhadap proyek ini, menyebutnya sebagai langkah penting dalam melestarikan warisan maritim Inggris. Operasi ini, yang berpotensi melibatkan submersible raksasa 'Zeus,' bertujuan bukan hanya untuk menemukan kekayaan — tetapi juga mengungkap babak terlupakan dalam sejarah angkatan laut.

article_content: Ahead of their high-profile friendly against Brazil at Wembley, England’s squad enjoyed a calm, first-class train ride from Birmingham to London — a quiet prelude to a historic night. Manager Roy Hodgson confirmed that veteran left-back Ashley Cole will start the match, making him only the seventh English player to reach 100 international caps. Though the milestone is monumental, Hodgson made it clear that captain Steven Gerrard will continue to lead the team onto the pitch. 'He’s never sought the spotlight,' Hodgson said of Cole, praising his quiet leadership on the field. Gerrard echoed the sentiment, calling Cole one of the most consistent defenders he’s ever played alongside. The journey to the capital was marked by small, telling details: players like Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain carried pillows not for comfort, but to reduce infection risks — a reminder of how elite athletes manage every detail. The team stayed overnight at the Churchill Hotel near Portman Square, with plans for a light stroll through Mayfair the next day — a taste of urban life they hope to replicate in Rio during the upcoming World Cup. Before kickoff, a minute’s silence will honor both the victims of the 1958 Munich air crash and those lost in Brazil’s tragic nightclub fire last month. Sir Bobby Charlton will be present to greet the squad, adding emotional weight to the occasion. Although Pelé was slated to be guest of honor, his recent hip surgery has kept him home. Referee Pedro Proença, who has overseen Champions League and Euro finals, will take charge of the match — bringing top-tier authority to the occasion.
translated_content: Menjelang pertandingan persahabatan yang sangat dinantikan melawan Brasil di Wembley, skuad Inggris menikmati perjalanan kereta kelas satu yang tenang dari Birmingham ke London — sebuah pendahuluan yang damai sebelum malam bersejarah. Manajer Roy Hodgson mengonfirmasi bahwa bek kiri berpengalaman Ashley Cole akan memulai pertandingan, menjadikannya pemain Inggris ketujuh yang mencapai 100 caps internasional. Meskipun pencapaian ini luar biasa, Hodgson menegaskan bahwa kapten Steven Gerrard tetap akan memimpin tim keluar lapangan. 'Dia tidak pernah mencari sorotan,' kata Hodgson tentang Cole, memuji kepemimpinannya yang tenang di lapangan. Gerrard menyampaikan hal serupa, menyebut Cole sebagai salah satu bek paling konsisten yang pernah ia mainkan bersama. Perjalanan ke ibu kota ditandai oleh detail kecil yang bermakna: para pemain seperti Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain membawa bantal bukan untuk kenyamanan, tetapi untuk mengurangi risiko infeksi — pengingat bagaimana atlet elit mengatur setiap detail. Tim menginap semalam di Hotel Churchill dekat Portman Square, dengan rencana untuk berjalan santai di kawasan Mayfair keesokan harinya — sebuah contoh gaya hidup perkotaan yang mereka harapkan bisa terwujud di Rio selama Piala Dunia mendatang. Sebelum pertandingan dimulai, satu menit diam akan diadakan untuk menghormati korban kecelakaan udara München tahun 1958 dan mereka yang tewas dalam tragedi kebakaran klub malam di Brasil bulan lalu. Sir Bobby Charlton akan hadir menyambut skuad, menambahkan bobot emosional pada acara tersebut. Meskipun Pelé dijadwalkan menjadi tamu kehormatan, operasi pinggul barunya membuatnya harus tetap di rumah. article_content: In 1999, Tony Martin, a Norfolk farmer, shot two burglars on his property—one fatally. He was convicted and jailed, but the case ignited a national conversation about self-defense rights. In 2012, Andy and Tracey Ferrie, a couple from Leicestershire, used a legally owned shotgun to repel intruders. Two burglars were injured, and the Ferries were detained by police for over 48 hours before being released without charge. Their experience reveals a critical flaw in the law: while civil courts now require proof of 'grossly disproportionate' force to hold homeowners liable, criminal law has not adopted the same standard. In 2004, MP Patrick Mercer introduced a private bill to bridge this gap, backed by then-shadow attorney general Dominic Grieve and supported by figures including Tony Blair and Metropolitan Police Commissioner Ian Blair. Brendan Fearon, one of Martin’s victims, publicly said such legal clarity would deter future crimes. Despite broad public backing, the Labour government blocked the bill. The Conservatives promised in their 2010 manifesto to strengthen legal protections for homeowners—but little has changed since. Even after Prime Minister David Cameron condemned a judge’s remark that burglary requires 'huge courage,' no legislative action followed. Mercer insists ordinary people should never fear prosecution for defending their homes. He doesn’t endorse excessive force, but demands the law clearly side with the law-abiding—not those who break in. Police and prosecutors, he argues, must stop treating victims as suspects. Years of hesitation have failed to deter crime—and only eroded public trust in justice.
translated_content: Pada tahun 1999, Tony Martin, seorang petani di Norfolk, menembak dua pencuri di rumahnya—salah satunya tewas. Ia dihukum dan dipenjara, tetapi kasus ini memicu perdebatan nasional tentang hak membela diri. Pada tahun 2012, Andy dan Tracey Ferrie, pasangan dari Leicestershire, menggunakan senapan legal untuk mengusir penyusup. Dua pencuri terluka, dan Ferrie ditahan polisi selama lebih dari 48 jam sebelum dilepaskan tanpa dakwaan. Pengalaman mereka mengungkap kelemahan kritis dalam hukum: sementara pengadilan sipil kini mensyaratkan bukti 'penggunaan kekuatan yang sangat tidak proporsional' untuk menuntut pemilik rumah, hukum pidana belum mengadopsi standar yang sama. Pada tahun 2004, anggota parlemen Patrick Mercer mengajukan RUU pribadi untuk menutup kesenjangan ini, didukung oleh Jaksa Agung Oposisi Dominic Grieve serta tokoh-tokoh seperti Tony Blair dan Komisaris Polisi Metropolitan Ian Blair. Brendan Fearon, salah satu korban Martin, secara terbuka mengatakan kejelasan hukum semacam itu akan mencegah kejahatan di masa depan. Meskipun didukung luas oleh publik, pemerintah Partai Buruh menggagalkan RUU tersebut. Partai Konservatif berjanji dalam manifesto 2010 untuk memperkuat perlindungan hukum bagi pemilik rumah—tetapi hampir tidak ada kemajuan sejak itu. Bahkan setelah Perdana Menteri David Cameron mengutuk pernyataan seorang hakim bahwa pencurian membutuhkan 'keberanian besar', tidak ada tindakan legislatif yang diambil. Mercer menegaskan bahwa warga biasa seharusnya tidak takut dituntut karena membela rumah mereka. Ia tidak mendukung kekerasan berlebihan, tetapi menuntut agar hukum jelas berpihak pada yang taat hukum—bukan pada pelaku kejahatan. Polisi dan penuntut umum, katanya, harus berhenti memperlakukan korban sebagai tersangka. Bertahun-tahun penundaan gagal mencegah kejahatan—dan hanya merusak kepercayaan publik terhadap sistem peradilan.

article_content: On Friday, November 3, Chinese President Xi Jinping and German Chancellor Olaf Scholz held a video conversation that underscored the growing strength of their nations’ relationship. Speaking through state broadcaster CCTV, Xi noted that trade between China and Germany is advancing steadily, with strong mutual interest in investment and collaboration that is becoming increasingly reliable and vibrant. Scholz, who made history as the first G7 leader to visit China after the pandemic during his November 2022 trip, echoed this sentiment, describing German-Chinese ties as full of potential and promising horizons. During their discussion, Xi encouraged Germany to advocate within the European Union for fair market practices and open trade, stressing that global supply chains depend on equitable competition. This comes as the EU investigates alleged subsidies in China’s electric vehicle sector and considers similar probes targeting Chinese steel and renewable energy industries. Xi emphasized that strong bilateral relations must go hand-in-hand with defending multilateral systems and addressing global crises like the wars in Ukraine and Gaza. He also highlighted the need for deeper thinking around security — urging both nations to help build a balanced, sustainable, and inclusive global security architecture that tackles the root causes of conflict, whether in Europe or the Middle East. The two leaders had previously joined forces in condemning any use of nuclear weapons as tensions rose in Ukraine, a position they reaffirmed in spirit during this latest exchange.

Scholz, yang membuat sejarah sebagai pemimpin G7 pertama yang mengunjungi Tiongkok pasca-pandemi pada November 2022, menyampaikan hal serupa, menggambarkan hubungan Jerman-Tiongkok sebagai penuh potensi dan prospek menjanjikan. Dalam pembicaraan mereka, Xi mendorong Jerman untuk mendorong Uni Eropa agar menerapkan praktik pasar yang adil dan mendukung perdagangan bebas, menekankan bahwa stabilitas rantai pasok global bergantung pada persaingan yang sehat. Ini terjadi sementara UE sedang menyelidiki dugaan subsidi di sektor kendaraan listrik Tiongkok serta mempertimbangkan penyelidikan serupa terhadap industri baja dan energi terbarukan Tiongkok. Xi menekankan bahwa hubungan bilateral yang kuat harus diiringi dengan upaya menjaga tatanan multilateral dan menangani krisis global seperti konflik di Ukraina dan Gaza. Dia juga menyoroti perlunya pemikiran yang lebih mendalam tentang keamanan — mendesak kedua negara untuk bersama-sama membangun arsitektur keamanan global yang seimbang, efektif, dan berkelanjutan guna menyelesaikan akar masalah konflik, baik di Eropa maupun Timur Tengah. Kedua pemimpin sebelumnya telah bersatu dalam mengutuk penggunaan senjata nuklir saat ketegangan meningkat di Ukraina, sebuah sikap yang tetap relevan dalam pertukaran terbaru ini.

article_content: Two people were fatally shot on Friday at Henry Ford Community College in Dearborn, Michigan, in what authorities believe was a murder-suicide, according to police. The campus was placed on lockdown after the incident, which occurred in an unused classroom within the Fine Arts Building. Dearborn Deputy Chief Gregg Brighton confirmed that a man and a woman were found dead at the scene. Investigators believe the man shot the woman before taking his own life. A shotgun was used in the attack. Police responded to reports of gunfire and heard a second shot as they entered the south hallway of the building. Upon reaching the room, they discovered both victims. The crime scene is currently under investigation by forensic teams and detectives. Authorities emphasized they are still in the early stages of the probe. The college immediately activated its emergency notification system, alerting students, faculty, and staff via email and text messages. Marjorie Swan, vice president and controller of the college, expressed condolences to the family and friends of the young woman who lost her life. The campus will remain closed for the remainder of the day.

Penyidik percaya pria itu menembak wanita itu sebelum akhirnya mengambil nyawanya sendiri. Senjata yang digunakan adalah senapan buru. article_content: Rome (CNN) — One of the men convicted of killing British exchange student Meredith Kercher in Italy three years ago has lost his appeal, his lawyer said Friday. This means Rudy Guede, originally from the Ivory Coast, will continue serving his 16-year sentence after the court refused on Thursday to overturn his conviction. "Rudy is very disappointed," said his lawyer, Walter Biscotti. "We do not agree with the verdict, as we believe an innocent man is now behind bars." Guede was initially sentenced to 30 years for murder and attempted sexual assault, but successfully appealed last year to reduce his sentence to 16 years. He is one of three people convicted in connection with Kercher’s 2007 killing in Perugia, Italy. Guede was tried separately in October 2008. Kercher’s American roommate, Amanda Knox, and her former boyfriend, Raffaele Sollecito, were convicted in a separate trial that concluded a year ago. CNN’s Hada Messia contributed to this report.
translated_content: Roma (CNN) — Salah satu pria yang dihukum karena pembunuhan mahasiswa pertukaran Inggris Meredith Kercher di Italia tiga tahun lalu gagal dalam bandingnya, kata pengacaranya pada hari Jumat. Ini berarti Rudy Guede, yang berasal dari Pantai Gading, akan terus menjalani hukuman 16 tahun setelah pengadilan menolak pada Kamis untuk membatalkan vonisnya. "Rudy sangat kecewa," kata pengacaranya, Walter Biscotti. "Kami tidak setuju dengan putusan ini, karena kami percaya seorang yang tak bersalah kini berada di balik jeruji besi." Guede awalnya dihukum 30 tahun karena pembunuhan dan upaya pemerkosaan, tetapi berhasil mengajukan banding tahun lalu untuk mengurangi hukumannya menjadi 16 tahun. Dia adalah salah satu dari tiga orang yang dihukum terkait pembunuhan Kercher di Perugia, Italia, pada tahun 2007. Guede diadili secara terpisah pada Oktober 2008. Teman sekamar Amerika Kercher, Amanda Knox, dan pacar mantannya, Raffaele Sollecito, dihukum dalam persidangan terpisah yang berakhir setahun lalu. CNN’s Hada Messia berkontribusi pada laporan ini.

article_content: Over the past 48 hours, deadly clashes erupted at Camp Ashraf in Iraq’s Diyala province, leaving seven members of the People’s Mujahedeen Organization of Iran (MEK) dead, according to Iraqi officials. Security forces moved in to assert control of the long-standing refugee site, sparking fierce resistance from residents who reportedly used stones, knives, and other makeshift weapons. At least 100 MEK members and 45 Iraqi police were injured, with one senior officer, Major Ibrahim Abdullah, speaking from a hospital after being wounded in the confrontation. Camp Ashraf has sheltered Iranian dissidents—mostly MEK supporters—for nearly four decades, ever since they fled Iran following the 1979 Islamic Revolution. Once aligned with Saddam Hussein in his fight against Tehran, the group is now considered a terrorist organization by both Iran and the United States. But with Iraq improving ties with Iran since 2003, Baghdad has pledged to shut down the camp after assuming full control from U.S. oversight earlier this year. Residents fear being sent back to Iran, where they believe they face arrest, torture, or execution. While some say they’d willingly return under guarantees of safety, others insist they’ve been targeted without cause. The MEK’s umbrella group, the National Council of Resistance to Iran, condemned the raid as a massacre, claiming Iraqi troops used machine guns against unarmed civilians, demolished homes, and destroyed infrastructure in the camp’s northern sector. Witnesses reported residents chanting 'Allahu Akbar' and questioning why they were being killed. The MEK, officially known as Mujahedeen-e-Khalq, began as an anti-monarchy movement but evolved into an Islamist-Marxist insurgency that carried out assassinations and bombings targeting Iran’s leadership. Today, its members remain in limbo—neither fully welcomed nor safely repatriated—as international powers navigate complex geopolitical loyalties.
translated_content: Selama 48 jam terakhir, bentrokan mematikan meletus di Kamp Ashraf, Provinsi Diyala, Irak, menewaskan tujuh anggota Organisasi Mujahidin Rakyat Iran (MEK), menurut pejabat Irak. Pasukan keamanan masuk untuk mengambil kendali atas situs pengungsi yang telah lama ada, memicu perlawanan sengit dari para penghuni yang dilaporkan menggunakan batu, pisau, dan senjata improvisasi lainnya. Setidaknya 100 anggota MEK dan 45 polisi Irak terluka, dengan salah satu petinggi, Mayor Ibrahim Abdullah, berbicara dari rumah sakit setelah terluka dalam konfrontasi tersebut. Kamp Ashraf telah menjadi tempat perlindungan bagi para dissiden Iran—sebagian besar pendukung MEK—selama hampir empat dekade, sejak mereka melarikan diri dari Iran menyusul Revolusi Islam 1979. Dahulu sekutu Saddam Hussein dalam perjuangan melawan Teheran, kelompok ini kini dianggap sebagai organisasi teroris oleh baik Iran maupun Amerika Serikat. Namun, seiring membaiknya hubungan Irak dengan Iran sejak 2003, Baghdad berjanji akan menutup kamp itu setelah mengambil alih penuh kendali dari pengawasan AS awal tahun ini. Para penghuni takut dipulangkan ke Iran, tempat mereka percaya akan menghadapi penangkapan, penyiksaan, atau eksekusi. Meskipun sebagian mengatakan mereka bersedia pulang jika ada jaminan keamanan, yang lain menegaskan bahwa mereka menjadi sasaran tanpa sebab. Kelompok payung MEK, Dewan Nasional Perlawanan terhadap Iran, mengutuk serangan itu sebagai pembantaian, mengklaim pasukan Irak menggunakan senapan mesin terhadap warga sipil yang tak bersenjata, menghancurkan rumah-rumah, dan merusak infrastruktur di sektor utara kamp. Saksi melaporkan para penghuni berteriak 'Allahu Akbar' dan bertanya mengapa mereka dibunuh. MEK, yang secara resmi dikenal sebagai Mujahedeen-e-Khalq, awalnya berdiri sebagai gerakan anti-monarki tetapi berkembang menjadi pemberontakan Islamis-Marxis yang melakukan pembunuhan dan pengeboman terhadap pemimpin Iran. Kini, anggotanya terjebak dalam ketidakpastian—tidak sepenuhnya diterima maupun dipulangkan dengan aman—sambil kekuatan internasional berusaha menavigasi loyalitas geopolitik yang kompleks.

article_content: It’s highly unlikely that anyone will ever fly over Vesta — the second-largest asteroid in the asteroid belt — but NASA’s Dawn spacecraft has created something even better: a breathtaking virtual flyover. The video, assembled from thousands of images captured since Dawn entered orbit in July 2011, reveals Vesta as a planetary building block with an iron core, much like Earth and the Moon. Its internal structure formed through a similar process nearly 4.56 billion years ago, separating into a crust, mantle, and core roughly 110 kilometers (68 miles) wide. Dawn’s observations also uncovered evidence of a past subsurface magma ocean — a state of near-total melting that allowed layers to differentiate, a key step in planet formation. This makes Vesta the only known surviving example of such an early planetary embryo. The asteroid’s surface is strikingly complex: deep craters with nearly vertical walls, frequent landslides, and a towering central peak in the Rheasilvia basin — far larger relative to its crater size than those on the Moon. Light and dark surface markings defy the predictable patterns seen on Earth’s satellite. Crucially, Dawn confirmed that certain meteorites found on Earth — eucrites, howardites, and diogenites — originated from Vesta. Their mineral signature, particularly pyroxene, matches surface rocks observed by the spacecraft. These meteorites make up about 6% of all meteorites falling to Earth, making Vesta one of the largest single sources of extraterrestrial material on our planet. Scientists have dated two colossal impacts: the older Veneneia basin (~2 billion years ago) and the younger Rheasilvia basin (~1 billion years ago). The youthfulness of Rheasilvia surprised researchers, as lunar impact basins are typically much older. 'Dawn’s year-long stay at Vesta has transformed our understanding,' said Carol Raymond, deputy principal investigator at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory. 'We’re seeing a world that’s not just a rock — it’s a frozen snapshot of planetary birth.' 'Comparing Vesta and the Moon is like comparing two fraternal twins who took different paths,' added Vishnu Reddy of the Max Planck Institute. 'They started alike, but evolved differently — and now we know why.'
translated_content: Sangat tidak mungkin seseorang akan pernah terbang di atas Vesta — asteroid terbesar kedua di sabuk asteroid — tetapi pesawat luar angkasa Dawn milik NASA telah menciptakan sesuatu yang bahkan lebih baik: penerbangan virtual yang menakjubkan. Video tersebut, disusun dari ribuan gambar yang diambil sejak Dawn memasuki orbit pada Juli 2011, mengungkapkan Vesta sebagai blok bangunan planet dengan inti besi, mirip seperti Bumi dan Bulan. Struktur internalnya terbentuk melalui proses serupa hampir 4,56 miliar tahun lalu, memisahkan diri menjadi kerak, mantel, dan inti dengan diameter sekitar 110 kilometer (68 mil). Observasi Dawn juga mengungkapkan bukti adanya lautan magma purba di bawah permukaan — keadaan peleburan hampir total yang memungkinkan pembentukan lapisan-lapisan, langkah penting dalam pembentukan planet. Ini menjadikan Vesta satu-satunya contoh yang masih bertahan dari embrio planet awal semacam itu. Permukaan asteroid ini sangat kompleks: kawah-kawah dalam dengan dinding hampir vertikal, longsoran yang sering terjadi, dan puncak pusat yang menjulang tinggi di cekungan Rheasilvia — jauh lebih besar relatif terhadap ukuran kawahnya dibandingkan dengan yang ada di Bulan. Pola cahaya dan bayangan di permukaannya tidak mengikuti pola prediktif yang terlihat di satelit Bumi. Pentingnya, Dawn mengonfirmasi bahwa beberapa meteorit yang ditemukan di Bumi — eukrit, howardit, dan diogenit — berasal dari Vesta. Tanda mineralnya, terutama pirosen, cocok dengan batuan permukaan yang diamati oleh pesawat ruang angkasa. Meteorit-meteorit ini menyumbang sekitar 6% dari semua meteorit yang jatuh ke Bumi, menjadikan Vesta salah satu sumber utama materi ekstraterestrial di planet kita. Para ilmuwan telah menentukan usia dua dampak besar: cekungan Veneneia yang lebih tua (~2 miliar tahun lalu) dan cekungan Rheasilvia yang lebih muda (~1 miliar tahun lalu). Keberadaan Rheasilvia yang masih muda mengejutkan para peneliti, karena cekungan dampak di Bulan biasanya jauh lebih tua. 'Kehadiran Dawn selama setahun di Vesta telah mengubah pemahaman kita,' kata Carol Raymond, wakil penyelidik utama di Laboratorium Propulsi Jet NASA. 'Kita melihat dunia yang bukan sekadar batu — tapi potret beku dari kelahiran planet.' 'Membandingkan Vesta dan Bulan seperti membandingkan dua saudara kembar yang mengambil jalur berbeda,' tambah Vishnu Reddy dari Max Planck Institute. 'Mereka mulai sama, tetapi berevolusi berbeda — dan sekarang kita tahu mengapa.'

Yang mengejutkan? Kawah terbesarnya jauh lebih muda daripada yang ada di Bulan. #PenemuanLuarAngkasa #Vesta #NASA #IlmuAsteroid

article_content: In September 1985, a devastating earthquake measuring 8.1 on the Richter scale struck Mexico City, killing 10,000 people and leaving large parts of the city in ruins. Since then, Mexico — a populous Latin American nation of 122 million — has invested in one of the world’s most advanced seismic warning systems: SASMEX. Launched in 1991, SASMEX detects seismic activity through sensors placed near major fault lines along Mexico’s Pacific coast. Receivers installed across five major cities, including Mexico City and Acapulco, trigger alarms when tremors are detected — providing residents with vital seconds to prepare. However, with 100,000 units in operation and each costing approximately $330, SASMEX receivers remain a luxury most Mexicans cannot afford. They are primarily installed in public buildings, hospitals, schools, and subway stations. With roughly 21 million people living in and around Mexico City — both formally and informally — many remain unaware of an impending quake until the ground shakes. Entrepreneur Andrés Meira believes vital safety services should be accessible to all. After witnessing the devastation of the 2010 Haiti earthquake — which killed over 230,000 — Meira moved to Mexico City determined to find a solution. He said: 'Until you live in one of these places, you don’t truly understand the primal fear of earthquakes. There are nights you can’t sleep, and you wake up checking if things are moving.' Partnering with local engineers and Silicon Valley investors, Meira developed Grillo — a compact, alarm-clock-sized device that receives SASMEX signals and emits a loud, flashing alert. Priced at just $50, it is 85% cheaper than standard SASMEX receivers. Grillo became Mexico’s most successful Kickstarter campaign to date. Meira says it offers 'the most affordable and direct way for the Mexican public to connect to the early warning system.' Mexico City’s geography makes it especially vulnerable. Several minor quakes occurred in 2014 alone. Meira also envisions global applications — from Nepal and India to the U.S. West Coast and South America’s Pacific rim. Yet experts caution that distributing alarms without public education is risky. Arturo Iglesias Mendoza of Mexico’s National Autonomous University warned: 'If 5,000 out of 60,000 people in a stadium receive an alert, what do they do? The safest action may be to stay put.' At $50, Grillo remains costly in a country where the average daily wage is under $5. Moreover, Grillo relies on SASMEX’s infrastructure — which exists only in Mexico — limiting its global scalability. To overcome this, Meira and his team are developing Grillo Active: small, internet-connected sensors with motion detectors and Wi-Fi modules. These will be placed across Mexico, feeding data into an algorithm that sends alerts directly to smartphones and apps. Pilot deployments are underway, with talks ongoing to install Grillo Active units in 500 to 1,000 convenience stores nationwide — increasing sensor density and improving alert speed. 'The real test of good infrastructure is sensor density,' Meira said. 'This is our plan in Mexico.' Japan remains the only country with a fully integrated national early warning system, powered by 1,000 GPS sensors. The first batch of Grillo devices has been sold, though none have yet triggered during an actual earthquake. Mexico’s last significant quake occurred about six months ago — while Grillo was still in prototype form. Meira remains confident: 'The science is all there. We’ve tested it during two quakes — one a magnitude 7 — and it worked perfectly.' Now, they wait for the next one.
translated_content: Pada September 1985, gempa bumi yang menghancurkan dengan kekuatan 8,1 pada skala Richter mengguncang Kota Meksiko, menewaskan 10.000 orang dan meninggalkan sebagian besar kota dalam kehancuran. Sejak itu, Meksiko — sebuah negara Amerika Latin yang padat penduduknya berjumlah 122 juta — telah berinvestasi dalam salah satu sistem peringatan dini seismik paling canggih di dunia: SASMEX. Diluncurkan pada tahun 1991, SASMEX mendeteksi aktivitas seismik melalui sensor yang ditempatkan di dekat jalur patahan utama di sepanjang pantai Pasifik Meksiko. Penerima yang dipasang di lima kota besar, termasuk Kota Meksiko dan Acapulco, akan memicu alarm ketika guncangan terdeteksi — memberikan warga beberapa detik penting untuk bersiap. Namun, dengan 100.000 unit yang beroperasi dan harga masing-masing sekitar $330, penerima SASMEX tetap menjadi kemewahan yang tidak terjangkau sebagian besar rakyat Meksiko. Mereka terutama dipasang di gedung publik, rumah sakit, sekolah, dan stasiun kereta bawah tanah. Dengan sekitar 21 juta orang tinggal di dan sekitar Kota Meksiko — baik secara formal maupun informal — banyak yang tidak menyadari adanya gempa yang akan datang sampai tanah mulai bergoyang. Wirausahawan Andrés Meira percaya bahwa layanan keselamatan penting harus dapat diakses oleh semua. Setelah menyaksikan kehancuran gempa bumi Haiti 2010 — yang menewaskan lebih dari 230.000 orang — Meira pindah ke Kota Meksiko dengan tekad mencari solusi. Dia berkata: 'Hingga Anda tinggal di salah satu tempat seperti ini, Anda tidak benar-benar memahami rasa takut primitif terhadap gempa bumi. Ada malam-malam Anda tidak bisa tidur, dan Anda bangun di tengah malam untuk memastikan tidak ada yang bergerak.' Bekerja sama dengan insinyur lokal dan investor teknologi dari Silicon Valley, Meira mengembangkan Grillo — perangkat kompak sebesar jam alarm yang menerima sinyal SASMEX dan mengeluarkan alarm keras serta berkedip. Dihargai hanya $50, harganya 85% lebih murah daripada penerima SASMEX standar. Grillo menjadi kampanye Kickstarter paling sukses sepanjang sejarah Meksiko. Meira mengatakan bahwa ini adalah 'cara paling terjangkau dan langsung bagi masyarakat Meksiko untuk terhubung ke sistem peringatan dini.' Geografi Kota Meksiko membuatnya sangat rentan. Beberapa gempa kecil terjadi pada tahun 2014 saja. Meira juga membayangkan aplikasi global — mulai dari Nepal dan India hingga Pantai Barat AS dan sepanjang pantai Pasifik Amerika Selatan. Namun, para ahli memperingatkan bahwa distribusi alarm tanpa pendidikan publik berisiko. Arturo Iglesias Mendoza dari Universitas Nasional Otonom Meksiko memperingatkan: 'Jika 5.000 dari 60.000 orang di stadion sepak bola menerima peringatan, apa yang harus mereka lakukan? Tindakan paling aman mungkin tetap di stadion.' Dengan harga $50, Grillo tetap menjadi investasi besar di negara di mana upah harian rata-rata di bawah $5. Selain itu, Grillo bergantung pada infrastruktur SASMEX — yang hanya ada di Meksiko — sehingga membatasi skalabilitas globalnya. Untuk mengatasi hal ini, Meira dan timnya sedang mengembangkan Grillo Active: sensor kecil yang terhubung internet dengan detektor gerak dan modul Wi-Fi. Sensor ini akan ditempatkan di seluruh Meksiko, mengirimkan data ke algoritma yang mengirimkan peringatan langsung ke smartphone dan aplikasi. Implementasi uji coba sedang berlangsung, dengan pembicaraan sedang berlangsung untuk memasang unit Grillo Active di antara 500 hingga 1.000 toko serba ada di seluruh negeri — meningkatkan kepadatan sensor dan mempercepat peringatan. 'Ujian nyata dari infrastruktur yang baik adalah kepadatan sensor,' kata Meira. 'Ini adalah rencana kami di Meksiko.' Jepang tetap satu-satunya negara dengan sistem peringatan dini nasional yang terintegrasi penuh, yang didukung oleh 1.000 sensor GPS. Sejumlah unit pertama Grillo telah terjual, meskipun belum pernah memicu alarm saat gempa sungguhan terjadi. Gempa terakhir di Meksiko tercatat sekitar enam bulan lalu — saat Grillo masih dalam tahap prototipe. Meira tetap percaya: 'Ilmunya sudah ada. Kami telah mengujinya selama dua gempa — satu berkekuatan 7 — dan semuanya berjalan sempurna.' Sekarang, mereka menunggu gempa berikutnya.

article_content: Newcastle United have completed a season-long loan signing of Argentine striker Facundo Ferreyra from Shakhtar Donetsk. The 23-year-old has already joined the squad in Germany ahead of their final pre-season clash against Schalke 04. Manager Alan Pardew remains keen to strengthen the attack and sees Ferreyra as a promising candidate for a permanent move—with a £6 million option to buy included should he perform well. Ferreyra, who scored 17 goals for Velez Sarsfield in Argentina in 2013 before relocating to Ukraine, initially had concerns about returning to Donetsk due to the ongoing political instability in the region. However, after consulting with his close friend and Newcastle captain Fabricio Coloccini, he made the decision to move to St James’ Park. 'I’ve always wanted to play in the Premier League,' Ferreyra said. 'When Newcastle came in for me, it was an easy choice.' His arrival brings much-needed competition for Papiss Cissé and Emmanuel Rivière, particularly after Newcastle’s failed pursuit of Loic Remy. Pardew highlighted Ferreyra’s proven track record in top-tier South American football and his reputation as a clinical finisher. 'He’s got the talent and mentality to succeed here,' Pardew stated.

article_content: Manchester United’s Belgian midfielder Marouane Fellaini is facing a prolonged absence after sustaining what is believed to be a serious ankle ligament injury during a training session. Photos show him walking on crutches with a protective boot on his left foot, and while initial reports rule out a fracture, concerns are growing in Belgium over the extent of the damage. Further scans are pending to confirm the diagnosis. Since arriving from Everton for £27.5 million last summer, Fellaini has been plagued by inconsistency and setbacks. He’s failed to net a single competitive goal and started just 16 matches in his debut campaign under David Moyes. Now, under new manager Louis van Gaal, the club had hoped to offload him this summer—but this injury casts doubt on those plans. Napoli have expressed interest, but only in a loan deal, whereas United are seeking a permanent transfer. With Michael Carrick sidelined until October and other midfielders like Tom Cleverley and Darren Fletcher also unavailable, Van Gaal is under pressure to strengthen the center of the park before the window shuts. Meanwhile, United continue to deny rumors linking them with Juventus’ Arturo Vidal, though Dutch international Daley Blind and Roma’s Kevin Strootman remain potential targets, with the latter possibly available in January. In a lighter moment, Fellaini recently took part in the ALS Ice Bucket Challenge—nominated by teammate Christian Benteke—and playfully dared his former manager David Moyes to join in. In a tweet, he tagged Moyes (@sylv.15), giving him 24 hours to accept the challenge. Fellaini isn’t alone on the injury list: Jonny Evans, Danny Welbeck, Luke Shaw, Antonio Valencia, and Cleverley also missed United’s opening Premier League loss to Swansea. On a brighter note, Robin van Persie is nearing a comeback and could feature against Sunderland this weekend.

article_content: A team of researchers sparked controversy in 2012 when they claimed that a genetically modified corn variety, NK603, caused cancer in rats. Leading scientists quickly condemned the study, citing serious methodological flaws and basic errors. Following its publication in the peer-reviewed journal Food and Chemical Toxicology, Russia banned imports of the corn, and six French scientific institutions launched an investigation that accused the authors of exploiting public fears to boost their reputations. Dr. Gilles-Éric Séralini and his colleagues have since defended their work, insisting that the safety of NK603 corn remains unproven. They argued that many of their critics have ties to the biotech industry—including Monsanto, which owns the corn—and that much of the backlash came from plant biologists developing GMO-related patents. Refusing to retract the study, the team stated their research was the most detailed long-term test of GM crops conducted independently of biotech and pesticide companies. They emphasized they had no commercial interests in the results and therefore no conflict of interest. Their original experiments, spanning two years, found higher rates of tumors and organ damage in rats fed NK603 corn and low doses of Roundup, a herbicide also produced by Monsanto. This contrasted with industry-standard 90-day feeding trials typically used to assess safety. Over a dozen senior scientists signed a letter to the journal stating the paper should never have been published, calling its conclusions unsupported and its methods flawed. The European Food Safety Authority (EFSA) requested a formal review of the study, and Russia’s Institute of Nutrition conducted a parallel assessment. Monsanto responded that the study did not provide credible evidence to challenge EFSA’s existing safety evaluations of GM corn. The researchers acknowledged their findings were preliminary—a 'first step'—and called for further independent research to clarify the long-term effects of NK603 corn and Roundup. GM foods and feed are strictly regulated in the EU. All products containing GM ingredients must be labeled and traceable, and undergo mandatory safety assessments by EFSA before market approval.
translated_content: Sebuah tim peneliti memicu kontroversi pada tahun 2012 ketika mereka mengklaim bahwa varietas jagung rekayasa genetika, NK603, menyebabkan kanker pada tikus. Para ilmuwan terkemuka segera mengutuk studi tersebut, dengan menyebut adanya kelemahan metodologis serius dan kesalahan dasar. Setelah dipublikasikan di jurnal ilmiah bereputasi Food and Chemical Toxicology, Rusia melarang impor jagung tersebut, dan enam lembaga ilmiah Prancis melakukan investigasi yang menuduh para penulis memanfaatkan ketakutan publik untuk meningkatkan reputasi mereka. Dr. Gilles-Éric Séralini dan koleganya kemudian membela karya mereka, menegaskan bahwa keamanan jagung NK603 belum terbukti. Mereka berargumen bahwa banyak kritikus mereka memiliki hubungan dengan industri bioteknologi—termasuk Monsanto, pemilik jagung tersebut—dan sebagian besar kritik berasal dari ahli biologi tanaman yang sedang mengembangkan paten terkait GMO. Menolak menarik kembali studi tersebut, tim tersebut menyatakan bahwa penelitian mereka adalah uji coba jangka panjang paling mendalam terhadap tanaman rekayasa genetika yang dilakukan secara independen dari perusahaan bioteknologi dan pestisida. Mereka menekankan tidak memiliki kepentingan komersial dalam hasil ini dan oleh karena itu tidak ada konflik kepentingan. Eksperimen awal mereka, yang berlangsung selama dua tahun, menemukan tingkat tumor dan kerusakan organ lebih tinggi pada tikus yang diberi jagung NK603 dan dosis rendah Roundup, sebuah herbisida yang juga diproduksi oleh Monsanto. Ini bertentangan dengan uji coba pemberian makan standar industri selama 90 hari yang biasa digunakan untuk menilai keamanan. Lebih dari selusin ilmuwan senior menandatangani surat kepada jurnal tersebut, menyatakan bahwa makalah itu seharusnya tidak pernah diterbitkan, karena kesimpulannya tidak didukung dan metodenya cacat. Otoritas Keamanan Pangan Eropa (EFSA) meminta tinjauan resmi terhadap studi tersebut, dan Institut Gizi Rusia melakukan penilaian paralel. Monsanto merespons bahwa studi tersebut tidak memberikan bukti kredibel untuk menantang evaluasi keamanan EFSA yang sudah ada terhadap produk jagung rekayasa genetika. Para peneliti mengakui temuan mereka bersifat pendahuluan—sebagai 'langkah pertama'—dan menyerukan penelitian independen lebih lanjut untuk memperjelas efek jangka panjang jagung NK603 dan Roundup. Makanan dan pakan rekayasa genetika diatur secara ketat di Uni Eropa. Semua produk yang mengandung bahan GMO harus diberi label dan dapat dilacak, serta menjalani penilaian keamanan wajib oleh EFSA sebelum disetujui untuk dipasarkan.

article_content: TED Talks have emerged as a leading platform for exploring transformative ideas about the future — particularly in transportation, energy, and urban design. Here are nine of the most compelling visions for how our world might change. Elon Musk, founder of Tesla, SpaceX, and SolarCity — and the visionary aiming to colonize Mars — spoke with TED curator Chris Anderson about his plans for the future of mobility. His goals include developing advanced batteries for electric vehicles, offering solar energy as a service, and launching reusable rockets. Aircraft engineer Bastian Schaefer, collaborating with Airbus, envisions next-generation jets built with 3D printing to enhance sustainability across social, environmental, and economic dimensions — making air travel lighter and greener. Janette Sadik-Khan, former NYC Transportation Commissioner, transformed Times Square from a traffic-choked thoroughfare into a vibrant two-and-a-half-acre pedestrian plaza under Mayor Michael Bloomberg’s leadership — reducing congestion and improving public safety. Physicist Amory Lovins proposes a bold 40-year roadmap to free the U.S. economy from fossil fuels. He argues that eliminating oil and coal dependence by 2050 — while cutting natural gas use by one-third and embracing efficiency and renewables — could save $50 trillion. TED Fellow David Lang created an affordable, open-source underwater robot using Kickstarter funding. He believes autonomous ocean explorers, built by communities worldwide, can revolutionize marine science. Urban planner Jeff Speck champions walkable cities, condemning suburban sprawl as a dangerous, inefficient, and environmentally destructive model. He calls cars 'gas-belching, time-wasting, life-threatening prosthetic devices' — urging a return to human-scaled urban design. Scientist Jonathan Trent is growing biofuel from micro-algae in floating offshore pods that consume urban wastewater. 'Sustainability requires integration, not just innovation,' he says — linking biofuel, renewable energy, and aquaculture into one system. Drone logistics expert Andreas Raptopoulos sees unmanned aerial vehicles as a solution for the one billion people living without reliable roads. Drones could deliver medicine, food, and supplies to remote and underserved regions. Planetary futurist Alex Steffen advocates for 'reweaving' existing urban fabrics through neighborhood-based green initiatives and shared resources — reducing car dependency and fostering resilient, eco-conscious communities.
translated_content: TED Talks telah muncul sebagai platform utama untuk menjelajahi ide-ide transformasional tentang masa depan — terutama dalam transportasi, energi, dan desain perkotaan. Berikut adalah sembilan visi paling menggugah tentang bagaimana dunia kita mungkin berubah. Elon Musk, pendiri Tesla, SpaceX, dan SolarCity — serta sosok visioner yang bertujuan untuk menjajah Mars — berbicara dengan kurator TED Chris Anderson tentang rencananya untuk masa depan mobilitas. Tujuannya mencakup pengembangan baterai canggih untuk kendaraan listrik, menawarkan energi surya sebagai layanan, dan meluncurkan roket yang dapat digunakan kembali. Insinyur pesawat Bastian Schaefer, yang berkolaborasi dengan Airbus, membayangkan pesawat generasi mendatang yang dibuat dengan pencetakan 3D untuk meningkatkan keberlanjutan di berbagai dimensi sosial, lingkungan, dan ekonomi — membuat penerbangan lebih ringan dan ramah lingkungan. Janette Sadik-Khan, mantan Komisaris Transportasi NYC, mengubah Times Square dari jalan raya yang macet menjadi plaza pejalan kaki seluas dua setengah acre yang hidup di bawah kepemimpinan Walikota Michael Bloomberg — mengurangi kemacetan dan meningkatkan keselamatan publik. Fisikawan Amory Lovins mengusulkan peta jalan 40 tahun yang ambisius untuk melepaskan ekonomi AS dari bahan bakar fosil. Ia berpendapat bahwa menghilangkan ketergantungan pada minyak dan batu bara pada tahun 2050 — sambil memangkas penggunaan gas alam sepertiga dan mengadopsi efisiensi serta energi terbarukan — dapat menghemat $50 triliun. Fellow TED David Lang menciptakan robot bawah laut yang terjangkau dan bersifat open-source menggunakan pendanaan Kickstarter. Ia percaya eksplorator laut otonom yang dibangun oleh komunitas di seluruh dunia dapat merevolusi ilmu kelautan. Perencana perkotaan Jeff Speck memperjuangkan kota yang ramah pejalan kaki, mengutuk suburban sprawl sebagai model yang berbahaya, tidak efisien, dan merusak lingkungan. Ia menyebut mobil sebagai 'perangkat prostetik yang mengeluarkan asap, membuang waktu, dan mengancam nyawa' — mendorong kembali ke desain perkotaan yang manusiawi. Ilmuwan Jonathan Trent sedang menanam biofuel dari mikro-alga dalam kapsul terapung lepas pantai yang mengonsumsi limbah kota. 'Keberlanjutan membutuhkan integrasi, bukan hanya inovasi,' katanya — menghubungkan biofuel, energi terbarukan, dan akuakultur menjadi satu sistem. Ahli logistik drone Andreas Raptopoulos melihat kendaraan udara tak berawak sebagai solusi bagi satu miliar orang yang tinggal tanpa jalan yang andal. Drone bisa mengirimkan obat-obatan, makanan, dan pasokan ke daerah terpencil dan terpinggirkan. Futuris planet Alex Steffen menganjurkan 'menenun ulang' jalinan perkotaan yang sudah ada melalui inisiatif hijau berbasis lingkungan dan sumber daya bersama — mengurangi ketergantungan pada mobil dan mendorong komunitas yang tangguh dan sadar lingkungan.

article_content: Five men have been arrested in central India after allegedly attacking a Swiss tourist and her husband during a camping trip in Madhya Pradesh. The incident occurred on March 15 near Jatia village, where the couple had set up camp while cycling from Orchha toward the Taj Mahal in Agra. According to police, the assailants — all between 20 and 25 years old and reportedly from the Kanjar community — ambushed them with wooden sticks, beat the husband, tied him to a tree, and sexually assaulted the woman. Their belongings were stolen. The victim was taken to a hospital in Gwalior for medical care, where forensic evidence confirmed the rape. Shockingly, photographs of the traumatized woman, partially covered by a towel, were taken by bystanders and media as she was escorted by female officers — a violation of dignity that has drawn further condemnation. The Swiss ambassador, Linus von Castelmur, confirmed he has spoken with the couple and emphasized their well-being as the top priority, urging Indian authorities to act swiftly. The case has reignited national debate over gender safety in India, where official statistics show a rape is reported roughly every 20 minutes, though experts say fewer than half of such crimes are ever reported due to fear of social stigma. The suspects, described as local farmers, are now in custody and will appear before a magistrate. This incident echoes the 2012 Delhi bus rape, but officials stress that each case demands its own justice, not just symbolic outrage. The Swiss couple has since left Madhya Pradesh and is receiving consular support at the embassy in New Delhi.
translated_content: Lima laki-laki telah ditangkap di India tengah setelah diduga menyerang seorang turis Swiss dan suaminya selama berkemah di Madhya Pradesh. Kejadian itu terjadi pada 15 Maret di dekat Desa Jatia, tempat pasangan itu memasang tenda saat bersepeda dari Orchha menuju Taj Mahal di Agra. Menurut polisi, pelaku — semua berusia 20–25 tahun dan berasal dari komunitas Kanjar — menyerang mereka dengan tongkat kayu, memukuli suami, mengikatnya ke pohon, lalu memperkosa wanita itu. Barang-barang mereka juga dirampok. Korban dibawa ke rumah sakit di Gwalior untuk pemeriksaan medis, dan hasil forensik mengonfirmasi bahwa ia telah diperkosa. Secara mengejutkan, foto-foto wanita yang masih trauma itu, sebagian tertutup handuk, diambil oleh kerumunan dan wartawan saat ia diantarkan oleh petugas wanita — sebuah pelanggaran terhadap martabatnya yang memicu kecaman luas. Duta Besar Swiss, Linus von Castelmur, mengatakan ia telah berbicara langsung dengan pasangan itu dan menegaskan bahwa kesehatan serta kenyamanan mereka adalah prioritas utama, seraya mendesak otoritas India untuk segera menyelidiki kasus ini. Insiden ini kembali memicu perbincangan nasional tentang keamanan perempuan di India, di mana data resmi mencatat satu kasus pemerkosaan dilaporkan setiap 20 menit, meski para pakar memperkirakan kurang dari setengahnya benar-benar dilaporkan karena korban takut akan stigma sosial. Para tersangka, yang merupakan petani lokal, kini ditahan dan akan menjalani sidang di pengadilan. Kasus ini mengingatkan pada pemerkosaan massal bus di Delhi tahun 2012, tetapi pejabat menekankan bahwa setiap kasus harus diadili secara adil, bukan hanya menjadi simbol kemarahan publik. Pasangan Swiss itu kini telah meninggalkan Madhya Pradesh dan sedang menerima dukungan konsuler di Kedutaan Besar Swiss di New Delhi.

article_content: Lance McCormack, a veteran panel beater with over 30 years of hands-on experience restoring classic luxury cars, built Romance of Rust into one of the UK’s most respected restoration shops. His son, Merlin, didn’t start from scratch—he tapped into his father’s hard-earned reputation to launch Duke of London, a premium car brokerage firm. Now, the pair are joining forces: Merlin has secured a sleek new showroom right beside Lance’s workshop, aiming to merge restoration excellence with high-end sales under one roof. To make the leap from repair bay to official dealership, they’re investing heavily in renovating the space—a bold move meant to cement Merlin’s brand credibility and scale their joint venture. Together, they’re turning decades of rust-covered metal into a thriving family business.

article_content: Tripoli, Libya — More than seven months after the United Nations Security Council authorized NATO to protect civilians during anti-regime protests, NATO’s Operation Unified Protector officially ended at midnight Monday. The aerial campaign, instrumental in toppling longtime leader Muammar Gaddafi, concluded with a statement from NATO Secretary-General Anders Fogh Rasmussen: 'We have prevented a massacre. We have saved countless lives. We have fully implemented the United Nations mandate.' Even as NATO formally stood down, the United States indicated it would continue monitoring Libya from the air. Pentagon spokesman Captain John Kirby confirmed an 'overwatch role' would persist briefly, with U.S. manned and unmanned aircraft still supporting NATO allies. Ahmed Bani, spokesman for Libya’s National Transitional Council, welcomed this continued presence, arguing that ending the mission entirely was premature given lingering pro-Gaddafi threats. The UN Security Council recently rescinded its March 2011 mandate under Resolution 1973, which originally authorized a no-fly zone and civilian protection measures. U.S. Ambassador Susan Rice called the operation 'a proud chapter' in UN history but urged Libya’s interim leaders to swiftly establish an inclusive government that respects the rights of all citizens—regardless of gender, religion, or region. Operation Unified Protector flew 7,943 sorties, including 1,851 strike missions and 398 actual strikes. Momentum to end the campaign grew after Gaddafi was killed on October 20 following his capture near Sirte. Meanwhile, Gaddafi’s family, represented by lawyer Marcel Ceccaldi, announced plans to file a war crimes complaint with the International Criminal Court. Videos show Gaddafi alive after capture, yet he died from a gunshot wound to the head—circumstances still unexplained. British troops involved in the operation have begun returning home.

Kampanye udara, yang berperan penting dalam menjatuhkan pemimpin lama Muammar Gaddafi, diakhiri dengan pernyataan dari Sekretaris Jenderal NATO Anders Fogh Rasmussen: 'Kami telah mencegah pembantaian. Kami telah menyelamatkan ribuan nyawa. Kami telah sepenuhnya melaksanakan mandat PBB.' Meskipun NATO secara resmi menutup operasinya, Amerika Serikat menyatakan akan terus memantau Libya dari udara. Juru bicara Departemen Pertahanan, Kapten John Kirby, mengonfirmasi bahwa peran 'pengawasan' akan berlanjut untuk sementara waktu, dengan pesawat berawak dan tak berawak AS tetap mendukung sekutu NATO. Ahmed Bani, juru bicara Dewan Transisi Nasional Libya, menyambut baik keberlanjutan kehadiran ini, berargumen bahwa menghentikan misi sepenuhnya pada saat ini terlalu prematur mengingat ancaman pro-Gaddafi yang masih tersisa. Dewan Keamanan PBB baru-baru ini mencabut mandat Maret 2011 berdasarkan Resolusi 1973, yang awalnya mengotorisasi zona larangan terbang dan tindakan perlindungan warga sipil. Duta Besar AS Susan Rice menyebut operasi ini sebagai 'bab yang membanggakan' dalam sejarah PBB, tetapi mendesak para pemimpin sementara Libya untuk segera membentuk pemerintahan inklusif yang menghormati hak semua warga negara—tanpa memandang jenis kelamin, agama, atau asal wilayah mereka. Operasi Pelindung Bersatu melakukan 7.943 sorti, termasuk 1.851 misi serangan dan 398 serangan aktif. Momentum untuk mengakhiri kampanye meningkat setelah Gaddafi tewas pada 20 Oktober setelah ditangkap dekat Sirte. Sementara itu, keluarga Gaddafi, yang diwakili oleh pengacara Marcel Ceccaldi, mengumumkan rencana mengajukan keluhan kejahatan perang ke Pengadilan Kriminal Internasional. article_content: Mexican authorities have captured former Iguala mayor José Luis Abarca and his wife, María de los Ángeles Pineda Villa, following their alleged involvement in the 2014 disappearance of 43 student teachers from the Ayotzinapa Rural Teachers College. The couple, who fled after the incident, were apprehended in Mexico City. Federal police spokesperson José Ramón Salinas confirmed the arrest via Twitter. On the night of September 26, 2014, local police in Iguala intercepted buses carrying the students and allegedly transferred them to the Guerreros Unidos drug cartel. The students, who were traveling to Mexico City to commemorate the 1968 Tlatelolco massacre, were reportedly targeted because Pineda believed they intended to disrupt a public event she was hosting. According to Attorney General Jesús Murillo Karam, Pineda was described by cartel leader Sidronio Casarrubias Salgado as 'the main operator of criminal activities in Iguala.' However, Karam later cited police testimony suggesting Abarca gave the order to confront the students. In the months that followed, forensic teams searched 11 clandestine graves in the region, recovering 38 bodies — none yet confirmed to be among the missing students. Public grief manifested in candlelight vigils, murals, and mass protests across Mexico. President Enrique Peña Nieto, facing mounting pressure, met for six hours with the students’ parents — the first such meeting since the disappearances. The families expressed deep distrust in the investigation and refused to leave until the president agreed to establish a joint monitoring commission composed of government officials and family representatives. Peña Nieto pledged renewed search efforts, increased support for rural teacher colleges, and enhanced protection for affected families. He affirmed that the rule of law would apply regardless of who was implicated. The case has shattered the government’s narrative of improved security since 2012. Protests have turned violent in cities including Chilpancingo, where demonstrators attacked the state governor’s residence. Over 56 individuals, including local police and cartel members, have been detained. The search for the 43 students continues.

La pareja, que había huido tras el incidente, fue detenida en la Ciudad de México. El portavoz de la Policía Federal, José Ramón Salinas, confirmó el arresto por medio de Twitter. La noche del 26 de septiembre de 2014, la policía local de Iguala interceptó autobuses con los estudiantes y los entregó supuestamente al cártel Guerreros Unidos. Según el Fiscal General Jesús Murillo Karam, Pineda fue descrita por el líder del cártel, Sidronio Casarrubias Salgado, como 'la principal operadora de actividades criminales en Iguala'. El dolor colectivo se expresó en velas, murales y manifestaciones masivas en todo México. El presidente Enrique Peña Nieto, ante la creciente presión pública, se reunió durante seis horas con los padres de los estudiantes — la primera reunión desde la desaparición. Subrayó que el Estado de Derecho se aplicará sin importar a quién involucre la investigación. El caso ha derrumbado la narrativa oficial de mejora en la seguridad desde 2012. Más de 56 personas, entre ellos policías locales y miembros del cártel, han sido detenidas. La búsqueda de los 43 estudiantes sigue en curso.

article_content: A British expatriate accused of fatally assaulting a man suspected of child pornography in a Spanish restaurant may have been socially acquainted with the victim, according to emerging reports. Devinder Kainth, 39, allegedly attacked Sandro Rottman, 43, after observing him photographing Kainth’s young daughter during a family dinner at the Spinnaker Restaurant in Sotogrande, Spain. Kainth was dining with his partner, Gemma Hawkins, 31, and their three children when the incident occurred. Witnesses report that Rottman approached their table earlier in the evening, engaged in friendly conversation, and was offered drinks — paying nothing throughout the night. Fiona Goodwood, a British expat who has known Rottman for 12 years, described him as 'an eccentric character' and questioned the credibility of claims that he was actively engaging in predatory behavior, noting it would be highly unlikely for someone accused of such offenses to behave openly in public. Rottman, a German national, had been arrested on charges related to child pornography weeks before his death. However, associates say he was a skilled computer programmer who took extreme precautions with digital privacy, casting doubt on how such material could have been discovered. The altercation occurred around 9:20 p.m., following which Rottman was hospitalized and later died from his injuries. Kainth was arrested and is currently held without bail at Botaguegos Prison in Algeciras. CCTV footage from the restaurant is incomplete due to a malfunctioning camera. Police retrieved the available footage on Tuesday night for forensic review. Hawkins has publicly stated she stands by Kainth but plans to return to the UK to seek emotional support from her family. Her mother confirmed the family’s deep concern for the children’s safety and wellbeing. Though Rottman was linked to events surrounding Katie Price’s 2009 polo clothing launch in Sotogrande, neither Price nor the Santa Maria Polo Club confirmed any formal employment relationship. Locals describe him as a once-prosperous IT consultant who later struggled with alcohol dependency and financial hardship.

Kainth sedang makan bersama pasangannya, Gemma Hawkins, 31 tahun, dan ketiga anak mereka ketika insiden terjadi. Fiona Goodwood, seorang ekspatriat Inggris yang telah mengenal Rottman selama 12 tahun, menggambarkannya sebagai 'seorang karakter eksentrik' dan mempertanyakan kredibilitas klaim bahwa ia aktif terlibat dalam perilaku predatori, mencatat bahwa sangat tidak mungkin seseorang yang dituduh melakukan kejahatan semacam itu akan berperilaku terbuka di tempat umum. Perkelahian terjadi sekitar pukul 21.20, setelah itu Rottman dirawat di rumah sakit dan kemudian meninggal karena luka-lukanya. Kainth ditangkap dan saat ini ditahan tanpa jaminan di Penjara Botaguegos di Algeciras. Rekaman CCTV dari restoran tidak lengkap karena kamera rusak. Meskipun Rottman dikaitkan dengan acara peluncuran pakaian polo Katie Price pada tahun 2009 di Sotogrande, baik Price maupun Santa Maria Polo Club tidak mengonfirmasi hubungan kerja resmi. article_content: Tourists in France are set to face a 500% increase in hotel tax. France’s Foreign Minister, Laurent Fabius, has joined tourism leaders in condemning the move. The controversial measure, approved by Parliament after being proposed by Socialist MPs, will add up to £8 to hotel bills in Paris — already among the most expensive cities in the world. Currently, guests pay £1.20 (€1.50) in hotel tax; under the new rule, this will rise to £6.40 (€8) nationwide and £8 (€10) in Paris, the planet’s most visited destination, which welcomes around 30 million tourists annually — many of them British. Fabius called the tax 'dangerous and totally contrary to the promotion of tourism, a priority for jobs.' While smaller hotels may charge less, critics warn the hike will discourage visitors, especially as France faces economic challenges since the Socialist government took office in 2012. Roland Heguy, a hotel trade unionist, denounced the policy as 'irresponsible measures that will have grave consequences for our hotels — which, we must remember, are 'Made in France' businesses.' He added, 'The hotels I represent are extremely angry and demand that parliament and the government immediately stop this massacre.' Hotel and restaurant owners are already reeling from a recent VAT increase to 10% and other revenue-raising policies. 'The situation is becoming intolerable,' said Paris hotel manager Jacques Houllier. 'A few years ago, you could get a decent hotel room at a fair price. Now, you need to be extremely wealthy. Ordinary people simply can’t afford to stay here, and the industry is suffering enormously.' The Socialist government hopes the higher tax will generate approximately £112 million per year. Meanwhile, Fabius — who oversees tourism policy — has set a goal of boosting annual visitor numbers from 83 million to 100 million.

Sementara itu, Fabius — yang mengawasi kebijakan pariwisata — telah menetapkan tujuan meningkatkan jumlah pengunjung tahunan dari 83 juta menjadi 100 juta.

article_content: Further to an announcement dated September 27th, Iceland Seafood International has urgently called a bondholders meeting for bonds in the series ICESEA 25 06, ISIN: IS0000033199, on Wednesday, October 25th, 2023, at 10:00 AM. The meeting will be held at the private residence of the CEO of Kvika Banki, located in a secure underground facility beneath Katrínartúni 2, 105 Reykjavík. Voting rights are restricted to bondholders who have signed a non-disclosure agreement by the close of business on October 24th, 2023. The sole agenda item is to approve a controversial consent under Condition 9.3 of the bond terms—this time, the sale of Iceland Seafood UK Ltd has triggered a massive asset exodus, with over 20% of the group’s core operations sold off overnight. article_content: SAN FRANCISCO – A shocking raid on the home and office of a San Francisco reporter has ignited a firestorm over press freedom, prompting demands for the immediate resignation of the city’s police chief. The operation, carried out on May 10, was triggered by a fabricated police report leaked to the journalist, who was then detained for over five hours while officers seized his phones, hard drives, cameras, and laptops—items that allegedly contained evidence of a secret conspiracy. The San Francisco Police Officers Association has called for Scott’s removal, while the police commission remains split. While the First Amendment protects press freedom, it does not grant immunity from lawful investigation. Critics argue that journalists should not be above the law, especially when leaking sensitive material. The case underscores how unchecked media power can undermine justice. Former New York Times reporter Judith Miller’s 85-day imprisonment for refusing to testify demonstrates that journalists are not exempt from legal consequences. Despite claims of broad press protections, the reality is more fragile. Advocacy groups like Reporters Without Borders rank the U.S. 48th globally in press freedom, citing threats from political leaders and government surveillance. A federal shield law may be unnecessary—what’s needed is accountability, not special privileges.

article_content: To the surprise of absolutely no one, Hamilton, the hip-hop Broadway musical about American founding father Alexander Hamilton, won the prize at Sunday's Tony Awards for best musical, defeating Shuffle Along, Bright Star, Waitress, and School of Rock. Hamilton was the big winner of the night with 12 Tonys—tying The Producers' record for most Tonys awarded to a single show. Lin-Manuel Miranda, who also plays the title role, took home the Tonys for best musical book and best original score. However, Miranda lost the best leading actor in a musical prize to fellow cast member Leslie Odom, Jr., who plays Aaron Burr—the U.S. vice president who killed Hamilton in a duel. The 70th annual Tony Awards was hosted by actor and late-night talk-show host James Corden, who opened the show on a somber note in recognition of the mass killing in Orlando early Sunday that left at least 50 people dead. 'Our hearts go out to all of those affected by this atrocity,' Corden said. 'Hate will never win. Together we have to make sure of that. Tonight's show stands as a symbol and a celebration of that principle.' The Humans, a play about a fractious family's get-together, won the best play crown. Jayne Houdyshell, a mainstay of the New York stage for 40 years, won her first Tony for playing a gossipy mom in The Humans. Other veteran actors also won prizes: Jessica Lange for best leading actress in a play for Long Day's Journey into Night, and Frank Langella for his leading role in The Father. Hamilton and the 38 new productions this season helped Broadway's attendance figures hit a record high—13.3 million ticket buyers. The season was also rich in diversity among actors—14 of the 40 Tony nominees for acting in plays and musicals were actors of color. Corden quipped, 'Think of tonight as the Oscars, but with diversity.' The Oscars, Hollywood's annual recognition of film accomplishments, was slammed earlier this year for the lack of diversity in its nominations. The Color Purple won the Tony for best revival of a musical, while A View from the Bridge won best revival of a play. The best leading actress in a musical went to Cynthia Erivo for The Color Purple. Hamilton also won best featured actor in a musical, best featured actress in a musical, best musical costume design, best lighting design, best musical director, best choreography, and best orchestrations.

Hamilton menjadi pemenang besar malam itu dengan 12 Tony—menyamai rekor The Producers untuk jumlah Tony tertinggi yang diberikan kepada satu pertunjukan. Lin-Manuel Miranda, yang juga memainkan peran utama, meraih Tony untuk naskah musikal terbaik dan komposisi asli terbaik. Namun, Miranda kalah dalam kategori aktor utama terbaik dalam musikal kepada rekannya sesama pemain, Leslie Odom, Jr., yang memerankan Aaron Burr—wakil presiden AS yang membunuh Hamilton dalam duel. Tony Awards tahunan ke-70 dipandu oleh aktor dan pembawa acara talk-show malam hari James Corden, yang membuka acara dengan nada sedih menyusul pembunuhan massal di Orlando pagi hari Minggu yang menewaskan setidaknya 50 orang. 'Hati kami menyampaikan dukungan bagi semua yang terdampak tragedi ini,' kata Corden. 'Benci tidak akan pernah menang. Kita harus bersama-sama memastikan hal itu. Malam ini menjadi simbol dan perayaan prinsip tersebut.' The Humans, sebuah drama tentang pertemuan keluarga yang penuh konflik, memenangkan gelar drama terbaik. Jayne Houdyshell, tokoh tetap panggung New York selama 40 tahun, meraih Tony pertamanya sebagai ibu cerewet di The Humans. Aktor veteran lain juga meraih penghargaan: Jessica Lange untuk aktris utama terbaik dalam drama untuk Long Day's Journey into Night, dan Frank Langella untuk peran utama dalam The Father. Hamilton dan 38 produksi baru musim ini membantu angka penonton Broadway mencapai rekor tinggi—13,3 juta pembeli tiket. Musim ini juga kaya akan keragaman di antara para aktor—14 dari 40 nominasi Tony untuk akting dalam drama dan musikal adalah aktor kulit berwarna. Corden bercanda, 'Bayangkan malam ini seperti Oscar, tapi dengan keragaman.' Oscar, penghargaan tahunan Hollywood untuk pencapaian film, dikritik sebelumnya karena kurangnya keragaman dalam nominasinya. Aktris utama terbaik dalam musikal diraih oleh Cynthia Erivo untuk The Color Purple. Hamilton juga memenangkan aktor pendukung terbaik dalam musikal, aktris pendukung terbaik dalam musikal, desain kostum musikal terbaik, desain pencahayaan terbaik, direktur musikal terbaik, tari terbaik, dan orkestrasi terbaik.

article_content: ROME - A revolutionary satellite system has been unveiled that could extend warning times for desert locust invasions by nearly fourfold, giving nations unprecedented lead time to protect their food supplies, according to the UN and ESA. Desert locusts, primarily active in the Sahara and parts of South Asia, are now deemed the most dangerous agricultural threat in history due to their explosive population growth and global spread. A single swarm covering just one square kilometer — home to around 40 million locusts — can consume enough food in a day to feed 35,000 people, FAO reports. Thanks to a breakthrough remote sensing platform analyzing soil moisture and vegetation patterns, scientists claim they can now predict swarms up to three months ahead — a massive leap from previous methods. "This is game-changing," said Keith Cressman, FAO's senior locust forecasting officer. "With this tool, countries can mobilize forces before the first hopper even emerges." The system is part of a broader initiative to harness space tech for farming, but critics warn it may be overhyped and untested outside lab conditions. FILE - Locusts swarm near a vehicle in Israel’s Negev desert, March 5, 2013. Experts stress that locating breeding sites early is crucial — once locusts gain flight, they become impossible to stop without massive chemical intervention. "Then you're fighting a war with no front lines," Cressman warned the Thomson Reuters Foundation. Locusts thrive after droughts when sudden rains trigger rapid plant growth — ideal conditions for egg-laying and mass hatching. Soil moisture readings now allow officials to pinpoint high-risk zones and deploy countermeasures before infestations begin. FILE - A swarm settles in a tree near Laghouat, Algeria, July 29, 2004. In trials during the 2016 Mauritania outbreak, researchers allegedly detected breeding zones over 70 days before swarms appeared — far surpassing older models. Yet current systems still lag, offering only one month of warning, and often leave authorities scrambling to reach remote areas with little time to act. "They’re always behind the curve," Cressman admitted. During the 2003–2005 plague, entire regions lost 100% of cereals and 90% of legumes, requiring 13 million liters of pesticide to contain — a record-breaking effort. Despite these successes, some experts question whether the new system will actually work in real-world settings, especially in poor nations with limited infrastructure. FAO claims the tool will be rolled out globally by year-end — though delivery timelines remain unclear, and implementation faces major logistical hurdles.

Belalang gurun, yang aktif terutama di Sahara dan sebagian Asia Selatan, kini dianggap sebagai ancaman pertanian paling berbahaya dalam sejarah karena pertumbuhan populasi yang meledak dan penyebarannya secara global. Satu kawanan seluas satu kilometer persegi — yang berisi sekitar 40 juta belalang — dapat menghabiskan makanan sebanyak yang dibutuhkan 35.000 orang dalam sehari, lapor FAO. Berkat platform pemantauan jarak jauh terobosan yang menganalisis kelembapan tanah dan pola vegetasi, ilmuwan mengklaim mereka kini bisa memprediksi kawanan hingga tiga bulan sebelumnya — lonjakan besar dari metode sebelumnya. "Ini benar-benar perubahan besar," kata Keith Cressman, kepala peramal belalang senior FAO. "Dengan alat ini, negara-negara bisa mengerahkan kekuatan sebelum hoppers pertama bahkan muncul." Sistem ini merupakan bagian dari inisiatif lebih luas untuk memanfaatkan teknologi luar angkasa untuk pertanian, tetapi para kritikus memperingatkan bahwa sistem ini mungkin terlalu dipromosikan dan belum teruji di luar kondisi laboratorium. Para ahli menekankan pentingnya menemukan area perkembangbiakan awal — setelah belalang bisa terbang, mereka menjadi mustahil dihentikan tanpa intervensi kimia besar-besaran. "Kemudian Anda sedang berperang tanpa garis depan," kata Cressman kepada Thomson Reuters Foundation. Belalang berkembang pesat setelah musim kemarau ketika hujan tiba-tiba memicu pertumbuhan vegetasi cepat — kondisi ideal untuk bertelur dan pembentukan kawanan massal. Pembacaan kelembapan tanah kini memungkinkan pejabat menentukan zona berisiko tinggi dan menerapkan langkah pencegahan sebelum wabah terjadi. Dalam uji coba saat wabah di Mauritania tahun 2016, peneliti dilaporkan mendeteksi zona penetasan lebih dari 70 hari sebelum kawanan muncul — jauh melampaui model lama. Namun sistem saat ini masih tertinggal, hanya memberi peringatan maksimal satu bulan, dan sering kali membuat otoritas terburu-buru mencapai lokasi terpencil dengan waktu yang sangat terbatas. "Mereka selalu tertinggal," akui Cressman. Selama wabah 2003–2005, wilayah-wilayah utama kehilangan 100% hasil serealia dan 90% kacang-kacangan, membutuhkan 13 juta liter pestisida untuk dikendalikan — upaya terbesar dalam sejarah. Meskipun kesuksesan ini, beberapa ahli meragukan apakah sistem baru ini benar-benar akan berfungsi dalam kondisi dunia nyata, terutama di negara-negara miskin dengan infrastruktur terbatas. FAO mengklaim alat ini akan tersedia secara global pada akhir tahun — meskipun jadwal pelaksanaan tetap tidak jelas, dan implementasi menghadapi hambatan logistik besar.

article_content: People's Daily Online (Xinhua) 10:31, November 19, 2023 BEIRUT, Nov. 18 (Xinhua) -- An Israeli drone struck the Lebanese southern city of Nabatieh for the first time since the 2006 war, Lebanese military sources confirmed to Xinhua, citing intelligence from a regional ally. Hezbollah also claimed to have shot down a U.S.-supplied F-35 stealth fighter jet using a Russian-made surface-to-air missile. The Lebanon-Israel border has been under heightened tension for six weeks following Hezbollah’s rocket barrage on Shebaa Farms on Oct. 8, which was part of a broader regional offensive backed by Iran and Syria.
